passes.title: Evolution pass
passes.summary: Skills that stitched both parents' versions together, or made one parent's version stronger, were rewritten so each adds a mechanic of its own.

changes.why: Was Chain Detonation's splash plus Frostfire and Foot of the Mountain's Chill; now one Shock on the target cracks through every primed ally.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The target gains Frostfire; their allies are Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, then the target gains Frostfire. If that Thermal Shocks them, each of their allies with a Fire or Frost debuff is Shocked too.

changes.why: Was the kit's apply-the-opposite trick again (as on Tempering Blow); now a cold opener whose follow-up Ignites, a two-turn Shock the user sets up alone.

before.effect: 15 damage, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill. The target is Chilled for 1 turn, or Ignited if already Chilled.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who is Chilled through the user's next turn. The user gets 1 Focus for their next skill, which also Ignites its targets.

changes.why: Was Blisterblade's burn plus Frost Spines' Frostborn; now the countered enemy carries a Shock that goes off when they next act, so they must choose to act or wait.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains Frostfire, and the user gains Flameborn and Frostborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. Its user gains Frostfire and is Thermal Shocked the next time they use a skill.

changes.why: Was Blazing Fury plus Frostborn; now every hit the user lands flips its target to the other extreme, so any skill they own feeds Thermal Shock.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, Flameborn and Frostborn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and their damaging skills Ignite targets with a Frost debuff and Chill the rest for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Flickerflare with Frostfire in place of Ignite; now it Shocks on its own, but only against targets with no Buffs, borrowing Ice's read from Icelance.

before.effect: 15 damage and Frostfire.

after.effect: 15 damage and Frostfire. If the target has no Buffs, they're also Numbed for 1 turn, Thermal Shocking them.

changes.why: Was Comet Shard with an Ignite added; now the comet falls the moment anyone burns or chills the target, rewarding teammates who follow it up.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 Piercing damage, then Ignites them. Lands instantly if the target is Chilled.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy. If they gain a Fire or Frost debuff first, it lands at once and Thermal Shocks them.

changes.why: Was Hidden Explosives lasting longer plus Frostfire; now Fire's Explosion carries Ice's Chill, so it Shocks every burning enemy at once.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they gain Frostfire and Explode.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, an Explosion is triggered, and it Chills every enemy it hits for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Flame Dash plus Frostborn; now the enemies' own burns become steam that hides the user from them for an extra turn.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Flameborn and Frostborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and for 1 more turn after that, Invulnerable to enemies with a Fire debuff.

changes.why: Was Dragon Hatchling's passive with Frostfire plus Ice Bear's bite; now killing the Salamander Shocks every Frostfired enemy, so the enemy must decide whether to.

before.effect: Summons a Salamander (35 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy Frostfire. Cold Bite (S): 20 damage and Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Salamander (35 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy Frostfire. When it dies, every enemy with Frostfire is Thermal Shocked.

changes.why: Was the kit's apply-the-opposite trick again; now it breaks Thermal Shock's once-per-turn limit, a finisher for a teammate's Shock.

before.effect: 20 damage. Ignited targets are Frostbitten for 2 turns; targets with a Frost debuff are Ignited.

after.effect: 20 damage and Frostfire. If the target was already Thermal Shocked this turn, the Frostfire Shocks them again.

changes.why: Was Inferno with Frostfire in place of Ignite; now it freezes the Ignites already burning, Shocking every burning enemy at once.

before.effect: 15 damage and Frostfire to all enemies.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Each Ignite on them turns into Frostfire, Thermal Shocking its bearer.

changes.why: Was Feed the Fire and Siphon Frost's rewards handed out together; now it drains and detonates a target who carries both extremes.

before.effect: 10 damage. If the target has both a Fire and a Frost debuff, they're all removed; the user heals 10 per debuff and gains Flameborn and Frostborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. If they have both a Fire and a Frost debuff (Frostfire counts), they're Thermal Shocked and the user heals 20 more.

changes.why: Was an Ignite mote beside a Chill mote on random targets; now the pair works one target together, so killing either mote stops the Shocks.

before.effect: Summons a Cinder Mote and a Frost Mote (10 HP each) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, one Ignites a random enemy and the other Chills a random enemy for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Cinder Mote and a Frost Mote (10 HP each) for 2 turns. Each turn, the Cinder Mote Ignites a random enemy and the Frost Mote Chills that enemy for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Searing Needle's Fire bonus plus a Frost twin; now Stab's low-HP bonus becomes a whole Shock from one needle.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 Affliction if the target has a Fire debuff and +10 Piercing if they have a Frost debuff.

after.effect: 10 damage and Chilled for 1 turn. Against targets at or below 60 HP, they're also Ignited, Thermal Shocking them.

changes.why: Was Pyrokinesis doubled against Shattered instead of Ignited; now a spender that cashes in every Fire and Frost debuff, trading the setup for burst.

before.effect: 20 Affliction damage, doubled if the target is Shattered.

after.effect: 20 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 for each Fire or Frost debuff they have. Then those debuffs are removed.

changes.why: Was Heat Haze with Frostfire in place of Ignite; now it counters attackers and Shocks an enemy who tries to support, a split neither parent reads.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they gain Frostfire and are Scorched.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain Frostfire. A Helpful skill Scorches and Numbs them for 1 turn instead.

changes.why: Was Ivory Step plus Frostborn; now Ice's debuffs set up Fire's Explosion, doubling it on the frozen.

before.effect: The user gains Immune and Frostborn for 1 turn, and Explodes.

after.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn and Explodes. Enemies with a Frost debuff take the Explosion twice.

changes.why: Was Flamethirst plus Freeze Wound side by side; now the team's burning enemies feed an icy Shield on the healed ally.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15, gains Flameborn for 2 turns and 2 Armor for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, whenever an Ignite on an enemy ticks, that ally gains 5 Shield.

changes.why: Was Burning Blood plus Boreal Aegis; now it turns an ally into the one who cashes in the kit's Shatters.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Might for 1 turn and Frostborn until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their direct damage deals 10 more to Shattered enemies.

changes.why: Was Overheat Metal plus Hypothermia's Numb and Frostfire; now Frostfire's Chill stops them offsetting Confusion that grows with each extreme, an energy stall.

before.effect: Target enemy gains Frostfire, and 1 Weakness, 1 Vulnerable and Numb for 2 turns.

after.effect: Target enemy gains Frostfire, then 1 Confusion for 2 turns per Fire or Frost debuff they have, Frostfire included (max 3).

changes.why: Was Searing Brand plus Chilling Grasp's Numb; now the frost brand turns allies' hits into the Ignite that completes the Shock.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. If the target was Ignited, they also gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Ignite them.

changes.why: Was Northern Solace plus Searing Aegis and Frostborn; now a frost Shield that melts into healing if the enemy doesn't break it.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, and gain 20 Shield, Flameborn and Frostborn for 1 turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, each heals for the Shield they have left.

changes.why: Was Blastwave's and Glacial Sweep's riders side by side; now the second target inherits the first's fire and frost, Shocking it if it held the other.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy. Ignited ones Explode; Chilled ones are Frostbitten for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who also gains copies of the target's Fire and Frost debuffs.

changes.why: Was Tempering Blow's apply-the-opposite trick on the whole team; now a team-wide Scorch that cuts healing and Shocks the frozen.

before.effect: Every Ignited enemy is Frostbitten for 1 turn, and every enemy with a Frost debuff is Ignited.

after.effect: All enemies are Scorched for 2 turns, Thermal Shocking each one with a Frost debuff.

changes.why: Was Ashen Barrier also counting Frost debuffs; now an ice wall with fire inside that punishes whoever breaks it.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield per Fire or Frost debuff on enemies (max 50), for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 1 turn. If an enemy breaks it, an Explosion is triggered.

changes.why: Was Ring of Fire with Frostbitten in place of Scorched; now it drags the whole team's fire and frost onto the Taunted enemy, Shocking them if both arrive.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn. If they use a Harmful skill, they're Ignited; if not, they're Frostbitten for 2 turns.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and moves every Fire and Frost debuff on their allies onto them.

changes.why: Was Wraith in White plus a Frost mirror of it; now attackers are primed with Frostfire, so hitting the Colossus twice Shocks them.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might per Fire debuff and 1 Armor per Frost debuff on enemies, and Immune while they have Flameborn or Frostborn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and enemies who damage them gain Frostfire.

changes.why: Was Blazing Fury plus Quiet Fury's Flow plus Catalyst; now the user is re-Catalyzed every turn, so their allies race the enemy to act on them first.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, Flow and Flameborn; then Catalyst for their next skill.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and gains Catalyst at the start of each of their turns.

changes.why: Was Flickerflare with Catalyst in place of Ignite; now Water's Renew on the enemy turns Fire's Ignite into an Explosion.

before.effect: 15 damage and Catalyst.

after.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. If the target has Renew, it boils over: they Explode.

changes.why: Was Tidal Arrow with a Transmute rider in place of its Flow requirement; now any healing spent saving the target during the wait is added to the hit.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage, and each Buff on the target is Transmuted into 1 Weakness.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, plus the total healing they received in the meantime.

changes.why: Was Whirlpool Trap with Catalyst tacked on; now acting twice makes the Catalyst react into an Explosion, unless a teammate spends it first.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Confusion and then Catalyst.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they gain Catalyst. If they already had it, it reacts instead: they Explode.

changes.why: Was Dive with its Renew coming from Transmuted Debuffs; now the user's ailments boil off into Catalyst on the enemy team.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; their Debuffs are Transmuted into Renew.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Their Debuffs are removed, and for each one, a random enemy gains Catalyst.

changes.why: Was a Renew-making skill beside a Dragon Hatchling-style Ignite; now it steadily turns an enemy's Buff into a Debuff and hands the Buff to an ally.

before.effect: Summons a Homunculus (30 HP) permanently. Distill (r): one Debuff on target ally is Transmuted into 2 Renew. Firebrew (r): 10 damage and Ignite.

after.effect: Summons a Homunculus (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, one stack of Might, Armor, Focus or Renew on a random enemy is Transmuted, and a random ally gains that stack.

changes.why: Was Splash's random-ally Renew plus Catalyst; now it primes the target on one cast and cashes the Catalyst in on the next, stripping a Buff as it does.

before.effect: 20 damage and Catalyst; a random ally gains 2 Renew.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they have Catalyst, the doubled hit also Transmutes one of their Buffs; if not, they gain Catalyst.

changes.why: Was Call Rain with a Buff Transmute in place of its Renew; now the Renew it brews boils into damage when the channel ends, so when to stop is the choice.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies, and one Buff on each is Transmuted (Buffs with no recipe become Scorched instead).

after.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. Each turn, 5 damage to all enemies and 1 Renew to all allies. When it ends, allies' Renew boils off as 5 Affliction per stack to random enemies.

changes.why: Was Shell Knife with Catalyst in place of Renew; now Fire's Scorched turns the needle into a bloodletting that heals the user.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the target has Catalyst, which it consumes.

after.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. If the target is Scorched, the user heals as much as this deals.

changes.why: Was Dunk with a Transmute in place of its Confusion; now the enemy's own heal or Buff lands inverted instead of just being stopped.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and the Buffs on its targets are Transmuted.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's Transmuted: its healing lands on its targets as damage, and its Buffs as the matching Debuffs.

changes.why: Was a plain Stun whose Catalyst bonus only restated Catalyst; now it Transmutes the Swiftness that would have dodged it.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun, doubled to 2 turns if the target has Catalyst.

after.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun that Swiftness can't stop: each Swiftness on the target is Transmuted into 1 Confusion instead.

changes.why: Was the base Dance restating Catalyst's doubling; now it's a gamble, since an enemy hit or an ally's heal in between spends the Catalyst first.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus, all doubled if they have Catalyst.

after.effect: The user gains Catalyst. At the start of their next turn, they gain 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus for 3 turns, doubled if the Catalyst is still unspent.

changes.why: Was Touch of Grace's Flow plus Flamethirst's Flameborn; now Fire's Ignites on enemies feed the ally's Water-style healing.

before.effect: Target ally gains Flow and Flameborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Renew, and 1 more Renew each time they damage an Ignited enemy.

changes.why: Was Aqua Ring plus an Ignite; now a brand that re-arms Catalyst after every ally hit, so the team's whole turn chains doubled damage.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. For 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Flow.

after.effect: 15 damage and Catalyst. For 1 turn, each ally skill that damages the target gives them Catalyst again.

changes.why: Was Rainsong with a Debuff-to-Renew Transmute; now it takes the enemy team's Renew for the user's team, leaving them Weakness.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, and each Transmutes one Debuff into 2 Renew.

after.effect: All allies heal 15. Every Renew on enemies is Transmuted into Weakness, and each ally gains 1 Renew per 2 stacks converted.

changes.why: Was Water Lash gated on Catalyst instead of Flow, with Fire's statuses added; now one Catalyst doubles the splash as well.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; those with Catalyst are also Ignited and Scorched (doubled).

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the target has Catalyst, it splashes: both hits are doubled.

changes.why: Was Whale Call plus Catalyst; now a team-wide window in which the enemy's own Buffs arrive as Debuffs.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable, then Catalyst.

after.effect: For 1 turn, every Buff an enemy gains is Transmuted on arrival.

changes.why: Was Aqua Veil plus a rider for when the user is Ignited; now an unbroken Shield condenses into Renew, so the enemy must break it or feed it.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield for 1 turn and 2 Renew; an Ignite on them is quenched into 20 more Shield.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, what's left of it is Transmuted into Renew, 1 per 5 Shield.

changes.why: Was Ring of Fire plus Catalyst; now the Taunted enemy's attacks are half turned into the user's healing.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn and gives them Catalyst. If they use a Harmful skill while Taunted, they're Ignited.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Half the damage they deal the user is Transmuted into healing for the user instead.

changes.why: Was Jolt with Heat in place of Charge; now a builder that becomes a safety-valve finisher at 4 Heat, so when to Strike matters.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. +1 Heat, or if the user already has 4, Vent instead: 5 more damage per Heat removed.

changes.why: Was Chain Detonation's Explosions plus Static Slam's splash; now Lightning's Sapped is what sets off Fire's Explosions.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies; Ignited targets Explode. +2 Heat.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Sapped enemies it hits Explode. +1 Heat.

changes.why: Was Charged Dash plus the base Focus; now it Vents Heat into a cheaper next skill, trading damage for tempo.

before.effect: 15 damage; the user gains 1 Charge (and so 1 Heat), and 1 Focus for their next skill.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Vent: the user's next skill costs 1 less per 2 Heat removed.

changes.why: Was Zap with Heat in place of Charge, plus an Ignite; now Fire's burn charges the user, feeding both Heat and energy.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. Costs r instead while the user has Heat. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. Each time this Ignite ticks, the user gains 1 Charge.

changes.why: Was Particle Beam with an Ignite added; now it lands double if the user times a Meltdown between the cast and the impact.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and to every Sapped enemy, Igniting them. +2 Heat.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user Melted Down in between. +2 Heat.

changes.why: Was Tesla Coil plus an Ignite; now it bleeds off one Heat each time it bites, a slow Vent that the enemy triggers.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage and are Sapped and Ignited. +1 Heat when it triggers.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 damage and are Sapped, and the user loses 1 Heat.

changes.why: Was Dragon Hatchling's burning passive plus a Detonate, and never touched Heat; now it stokes the user's Heat every turn, a clock they must manage.

before.effect: Summons a Ball Lightning (25 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy and Ignites them. Detonate (r): it dies, dealing 20 damage to all enemies and Sapping them.

after.effect: Summons a Ball Lightning (25 HP) permanently. Each turn, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy and gives you 1 Heat. Detonate (r): it dies, dealing 20 to all enemies and Sapping them.

changes.why: Was Innervate's Sap plus Fireball's Explosion; now it banks the user's Heat into an Ignite that keeps burning after a Vent or Meltdown.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Saps; an Ignited target Explodes. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 20 damage and Ignite. This Ignite deals 5 more per Heat the user has when it's applied. +1 Heat.

changes.why: Was Static Burst with a Heat Vent in place of spending Charge; now it forces a Meltdown on demand, trading the stored Heat for timing.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Vent: 10 more to each per Heat.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. The user Melts Down at the end of this turn, whatever their Heat.

changes.why: Was Cinderlings with a Heat-threshold Ignite; now the Sparks draw Heat off the user to hit harder, cooling them as they work.

before.effect: Summons 2 Sparks (10 HP) for 2 turns. Each deals 5 Affliction to every enemy each turn; while their summoner has 3 or more Heat, each also Ignites a random enemy.

after.effect: Summons 2 Sparks (10 HP) for 2 turns. Each turn, each draws 1 Heat from you to deal 15 damage to a random enemy, or 5 if you have none.

changes.why: Was Stun Baton with Ignite in place of Sapped; now running hot widens Stab's low-HP window.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target was at or above 80 HP, the user gains 1 Charge; if they end at or below 40 HP, they're Ignited.

after.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP (80 HP while the user has 3 or more Heat). +1 Heat.

changes.why: Was Malectrocute with Ignited added to its condition; now it burns Lightning's Charge into damage and Heat, giving up the energy it would have made.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped or Ignited. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 for each Charge the user spends on it. Each Charge spent becomes 1 Heat.

changes.why: Was Hologram plus an Ignite; now Fire's Ignite is what opens Lightning's counter, and it drains energy twice as hard.

before.effect: For 1 turn, any Sapped enemy who uses a Harmful skill is countered and Ignited, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn. +1 Heat.

after.effect: For 1 turn, any Ignited enemy who uses a Harmful skill is countered and Sapped twice, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was System Shock plus an Ignited rule; now at high Heat the stun spreads to the whole team, usually right before a Meltdown.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn (2 if Sapped). Ignited targets are fully Stunned instead. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 15 damage and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. At 4 or more Heat, it hits every enemy. +1 Heat.

changes.why: Was Three Storm Breaths plus Flameborn and Might per Heat; now running hot makes the user unstoppable, so they want to stay near the edge.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn, Conduit and Flameborn, and 1 Might per Heat they have, checked each turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Stormborn, and can't be Stunned while they have 3 or more Heat.

changes.why: Was Defibrillate with a Heat Vent in place of its Charge scaling; now the user dumps Heat into an ally's Charge, and so their energy.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. Vent: 10 more healing per Heat.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. Vent: they gain 1 Charge per 2 Heat removed.

changes.why: Was Overclock's Conduit plus Flameborn; now the ally's Fire Ignites charge them with Lightning's energy.

before.effect: Target ally gains Conduit and Flameborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and 1 Charge each time they Ignite an enemy.

changes.why: Was Apply Polarity plus an Ignite; now allies who hit the target spend the user's Heat, cooling them while sharing the power.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Charge.

after.effect: 15 damage. For 1 turn, each ally who damages the target draws 1 Heat from the user, dealing 10 more with it.

changes.why: Was a third Vent-for-healing skill beside Coolant Draw and the Heal; now it turns a Meltdown timed after it into team healing.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Vent: 5 more healing each per Heat.

after.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. If the user Melts Down before their next turn, the Meltdown heals every ally 20 and doesn't hurt the user.

changes.why: Was Arc plus Blastwave's Explosions; now a burning target's Ignite rides the arc to the second enemy and drains them.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Ignited enemy; Ignited ones Explode. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the target is Ignited, the arc carries it: the other enemy is Ignited and Sapped.

changes.why: Was Crackle plus a Scorch on Ignited enemies; now it drains the enemy while pushing the user to the brink, where the next builder melts them down.

before.effect: Saps all targetable enemies; Ignited ones are also Scorched for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Sapped, and the user's Heat rises to 4.

changes.why: Was Aggro Signal plus an Ignite; now the Taunted enemy's attacks feed the user's reactor and drain their own energy.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's Reflected back to them, and they're Ignited and Intimidated for 1 turn.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each Harmful skill they use on the user gives the user 1 Heat and Saps them.

changes.why: Was EXO-Armor with a Heat Vent in place of spending Charge; now Armor tracks Heat each turn, so every Meltdown costs the user their defense.

before.effect: Vent: 1 Armor and 1 Might per Heat. Then the user gains Stormborn and Flameborn for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Armor per Heat they have, checked each turn.

changes.why: Was the base Smash scaling with the kit's own Contraptions, so it did nothing new alone; now it spends Wind's Rushing for a heavier, burning splash.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies, +5 to each per allied Contraption.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If the user is Rushing, it vents: their Rushing ends, and the splash is 30 and Ignites.

changes.why: Was Launch's Rushing plus Bound's Leap plus an Ignite; now the dash leaves a machine behind, building the workshop on the move.

before.effect: The user Leaps and begins Rushing; their next skill also Ignites its target.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user begins Rushing and leaves a Turret behind for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Chainbreaker with a Contraption Upgrade tacked on; now the Debuffs that Wind's cleanse burns off become Fire's Might.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; they're Immune for 2 turns, and every allied Contraption is Upgraded.

after.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs, and for 3 turns they gain 1 Might per Debuff removed (at least 1, max 3).

changes.why: Was Air Bullet's mobility check gating Flickerflare's Ignite; now it rewards focusing one target with any allied minion by Upgrading it.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the user is Leaping or Rushing, it also Ignites.

after.effect: 15 damage. If an allied minion damaged the target this turn, that minion is Upgraded.

changes.why: Was Elegant Sweep plus 5 per Contraption; now the shot comes from a Mortar the enemy can destroy before it fires.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Contraption.

after.effect: Channeled. The user builds a Mortar (Contraption, 20 HP); on the following turn, if it still stands, it fires: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies.

changes.why: Was Float Noose with an Ignite in place of Isolated plus a Contraption bonus; now it punishes a target who keeps moving.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Ignited, and each allied Contraption deals them 5 more.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Ignited, or 20 if they're Leaping or Rushing.

changes.why: Was Bound plus Flame Dash's Flameborn; now the Leap's landing detonates, so Wind's jump sets up Fire's Explosion.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains Flameborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user Leaps. When a damaging skill ends the Leap, it also causes an Explosion.

changes.why: Was Grand Eagle rebuilt as a machine; now the Hound tunes itself, growing to level 3 if the enemy leaves it alone.

before.effect: Builds a Clockwork Hound (Contraption, 40 HP) permanently. Buzzsaw (r): 15 damage. Wind-Up (A): target ally Leaps.

after.effect: Builds a Clockwork Hound (Contraption, 30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, and every other turn it Upgrades itself.

changes.why: Was Compressed Bolt plus an Ignite; now Wind's Immobile read is what sets off Fire's Explosion.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target is Immobile, their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn and they're Ignited.

after.effect: 20 damage. Immobile targets Explode.

changes.why: Was Spiral Burst plus Inferno; now the bellows fan the fires already burning, and the user's speed fans them harder.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing; all of them are Ignited.

after.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Every Ignite on them ticks at once, or twice if the user is Leaping or Rushing.

changes.why: Was a Contraption sacrifice that needed two of the kit's own machines; now it burns an enemy's Ignite as fuel for Wind's Rushing.

before.effect: Destroys an allied Contraption: the user gains 10 Shield plus 10 per its level, and another allied Contraption is Upgraded.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. If they're Ignited, the Ignite is consumed and the user begins Rushing.

changes.why: Was two Turrets and nothing else, the base Summon in machine form; now killing one makes the other stronger, so the enemy must split or commit.

before.effect: Builds 2 Turrets for 3 turns.

after.effect: Builds 2 Turrets for 3 turns. When one is destroyed, the other is Upgraded.

changes.why: Was Vortex plus 5 per Contraption; now the channel is the workshop itself, building then tuning a Turret each turn it runs.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, +5 per allied Contraption; one more turn if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks.

after.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each, the user builds a Turret, or Upgrades one if they already have any.

changes.why: Was Airknife plus Searing Needle; now a poke that keeps the user airborne and Invulnerable, borrowing Air Bullet's trick and adding Fire.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing; Ignited targets take 10 more.

after.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. Used while Leaping, it doesn't end the Leap and Ignites the target.

changes.why: Was Sonic Thrust with its drawback swapped for Rushing; now a minion-shredder that turns the wreck into a Turret.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, and the user begins Rushing.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage, doubled against minions. If it destroys one, the user builds a Turret from the wreck.

changes.why: Was Spring Trap's counter-and-build-a-Turret again; now it builds a Dummy that punishes whoever destroys it.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user builds a Turret.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and a Dummy (Contraption, 15 HP) is built. When the Dummy is destroyed, it Explodes.

changes.why: Was Flashbang plus Buffet's Strategic stun on Ignited targets; now a lobbed grenade with a full Stun that Wind's mobility can dodge.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn; Ignited targets lose their Strategic skills for 1 turn too.

after.effect: Lands at the start of the user's next turn: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy, unless they used a mobility skill in between.

changes.why: Was Top Speed plus a Turret; now keeping Wind's Rushing going tunes every allied minion each turn.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Ghosted and begins Rushing; they also build a Turret.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Ghosted and begins Rushing. At the end of each turn they're still Rushing, every allied minion is Upgraded.

changes.why: Was Swiftwind or a double Upgrade; now Wind's Rushing keeps an ally's hits Igniting for as long as they keep acting.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, or target Contraption is Upgraded twice.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, their damaging skills Ignite.

changes.why: Was Headwind plus a Scorch; now the target's own speed fans the fire, so they must choose between moving and burning.

before.effect: Target enemy loses their mobility buffs, gains 1 Weakness, and is Scorched for 2 turns.

after.effect: Target enemy is Ignited and Confused for 2 turns. While they have a mobility buff, the Ignite deals double.

changes.why: Was Feathermark with a bonus only for the kit's own Contraptions; now it points every allied minion, from any source, at one target.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allied Contraptions deal 10 more to the target.

after.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allied minions attack the target instead of random enemies and deal 10 more to them.

changes.why: Was Uplifting Verse's heal plus a Contraption repair; now it posts Turrets beside whichever allies are still hurt.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, and every allied Contraption is Repaired to full and Upgraded.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. Each ally at or below half HP afterwards gets a Turret for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Falling Slam plus 5 per Contraption; now the blades carry Fire's Ignite from one enemy to the other.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Contraption. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If either is Ignited, the blades spread it to the other.

changes.why: Was Echoing Voice reworked plus a Scorch; now a rallying whistle that doubles every allied minion's next attack.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy loses 1 Swiftness and is Scorched for 1 turn.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and allied minions attack twice at the end of this turn.

changes.why: Was Slipstream with a Contraption bonus in place of its Rushing bonus; now an unbroken Shield is salvaged into a Turret.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield, +10 per allied Contraption.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, if 10 or more is left, the user builds a Turret for 2 turns from it.

changes.why: Was Torch Strike's Ignite plus Viper Strike with Sulfur for Toxin; now it loads without fire, and the fourth stack bursts on its own.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, 1 Sulfur, and Ignite.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Sulfur. If that brings them to 4, their Sulfur Erupts at once.

changes.why: Was Plague Stomp with Sulfur in place of Toxin; now Poison's Prey decides who catches Fire's Ignite.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 2 Sulfur.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Prey among them are Ignited.

changes.why: Was Lunge plus a Scorch on Ignited enemies; now Poison's Prey window doubles every burn on the enemy team.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and Ignited ones are also Scorched.

after.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and Ignites deal double to Prey.

changes.why: Was Blisterblade with Sulfur added; now a burning attacker Erupts on the spot and the blast heals the user, Shed Skin's healing in a new form.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Sulfur and is Ignited.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user. Its user gains 2 Sulfur; if they're Ignited, it Erupts at once and the user heals as much as it deals.

changes.why: Was Viper Stance with an Ignite added; now a sermon of damnation in which every enemy attack loads the attacker with Sulfur.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into Weakness; then every enemy with Weakness is Ignited.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and every enemy who uses a Harmful skill gains 1 Sulfur.

changes.why: Was Sting with Sulfur in place of its random debuff; now Poison's Prey is itself the fuse, no fire needed.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Sulfur, or 2 if the target is Ignited.

after.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Sulfur. If the target is Prey, their Sulfur Erupts.

changes.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus an Ignite, with no Sulfur despite its hook; now sticky pitch that doubles the target's next Eruption.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and Ignite.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and 2 Sulfur, and the target's next Eruption is doubled.

changes.why: Was Snake Pit with Sulfur for Toxin; now Strategic skills feed the pit and damaging ones light it, so the enemy can't play around both.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Sulfur; the third time, they also Explode.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Sulfur. The first damaging skill they use makes it all Erupt.

changes.why: Was Slither plus Flameborn; now the escape leaves a cloud that loads the whole enemy team.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Flameborn and 1 Focus.

after.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every enemy gains 1 Sulfur.

changes.why: Was Emerald Asp's bite with Sulfur for Toxin beside a separate Ignite skill; now the Toad runs the whole load-then-light loop by itself.

before.effect: Summons a Brimstone Toad (30 HP) permanently. Spit Sulfur (r): 5 Piercing damage and 2 Sulfur. Belch Flame (S): Ignites target enemy.

after.effect: Summons a Brimstone Toad (30 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, it gives a random enemy 1 Sulfur, or Ignites them if they have 3 or more.

changes.why: Was Fireball with a Sulfur rider; now it seeds a chain reaction, one Eruption loading the next.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Sulfur. An Ignited target Explodes.

after.effect: 20 damage and 1 Sulfur. When the target's Sulfur next Erupts, each of their allies gains 1 Sulfur from it.

changes.why: Was Acid Wash with Sulfur for Vulnerable; now the first rain loads the enemy team and the next one lights it.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Sulfur to all enemies.

after.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Those without Sulfur gain 1; those who already have it are Ignited.

changes.why: Was Devour with a higher threshold on Ignited targets; now the Eruption softens the target first, so the execute follows the blast.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, or below 25 if they're Ignited (doubled for minions).

after.effect: Target enemy's Sulfur Erupts. Then, if they're below 15 HP (doubled for minions), they're executed.

changes.why: Was Cinderlings adding Sulfur; now the Stokers seek out the most loaded enemy and light them.

before.effect: Summons 2 Stokers (10 HP) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each gives a random enemy 1 Sulfur and deals them 5 Affliction.

after.effect: Summons 2 Stokers (10 HP) for 2 turns. At the end of each of your turns, each Ignites the enemy with the most Sulfur.

changes.why: Was Nine Plagues with Sulfur for Toxin; now the channel's end detonates everything it loaded, so breaking it early still costs the enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 8 turns. 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Sulfur; every third turn, all Ignited enemies Explode.

after.effect: Channeled, up to 8 turns. Each turn, 5 Affliction to all enemies, and a random enemy gains 1 Sulfur. When it ends or is broken, every enemy's Sulfur Erupts.

changes.why: Was Pounce plus an Ignite; now the energy comes from lighting a loaded target, not from Prey.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and Ignite. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

after.effect: 5 Piercing damage and Ignite. If this Ignite makes their Sulfur Erupt this turn, the user gains 1 random energy.

changes.why: Was Pyrokinesis plus Envenom's Bypass and Prey read; now Fire burns off Poison's Toxin for burst, trading damage over time for damage now.

before.effect: 20 Affliction damage, Bypassing Invulnerable; doubled against Ignited or Prey targets.

after.effect: 20 Affliction damage, +10 per Toxin on the target. Then their Toxin is burned away.

changes.why: Was Numbing Needle with Sulfur for Toxin plus a Scorch; now the bigger the skill they tried, the more fuel they choke on.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 2 Sulfur and 1 Weakness, and are Scorched.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Sulfur per energy it cost.

changes.why: Was Lacerate with Ignited added to its Prey check; now lighting the target mid-Stun extends it, a sequencing reward.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Ignited.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. If their Sulfur Erupts while they're Stunned, the Stun lasts 1 more turn.

changes.why: Was Moonglove Mixture with Sulfur for Toxin; now it cleanses an ally's Toxin by turning it into an enemy's fuel.

before.effect: Target unit, ally or enemy, heals 30 and gains 2 Sulfur.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20, and their Toxin is drawn off: a random enemy gains that much Sulfur.

changes.why: Was Viper's Crest plus Flameborn; now the ally's Fire Ignites stack Poison's Toxin, pushing targets toward Prey.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Flameborn for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and each Ignite they apply also gives 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Swamp Toxins with Sulfur added; now it reloads the Toxin that Eruptions leave behind, so one target can Erupt again.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 2 Sulfur, 1 Confusion and 1 Toxin.

after.effect: Target enemy's Toxin turns into Sulfur, stack for stack (max 4), and they're Confused for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Searing Brand plus Sulfur; now a Sanctify-style brand whose healing grows with the fuel on the target.

before.effect: 15 damage and 1 Sulfur. If the target was Ignited, they also gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage and 2 Sulfur. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target heal 5 per Sulfur on it.

changes.why: Was Serpentsong with Flameborn for Renew plus Sulfur; now Fire's Flameborn treats every Eruption as an Explosion, healing the team.

before.effect: All allies gain Flameborn for 2 turns; all enemies gain 1 Sulfur and 1 Toxin.

after.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain Flameborn for 2 turns, which also heals them 10 for each Eruption their side causes.

changes.why: Was Tail Lash plus Blastwave's Explosions; now the tail flicks the target's fuel onto a second enemy.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Each Ignited one Explodes; the cooldown resets if it hits Prey.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Sulfur as the target has.

changes.why: Was Bad Stomach with Sulfur for Toxin; now cleansing the fuel sets it off, so their healers can't simply wash it away.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Sulfur; if the user has Flameborn, 1 Toxin too.

after.effect: All enemies gain 1 Sulfur, and for 2 turns, any Sulfur removed from them Erupts instead.

changes.why: Was Coil plus Ashen Barrier's Shield per burning enemy; now attackers who strike the coil pick up fuel.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor, and 10 Shield plus 10 per enemy who is Ignited or has Toxin.

after.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 20 Shield for 1 turn. Enemies who damage the Shield gain 1 Sulfur each time.

changes.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with Sulfur on each attack; now the Taunt loads them steadily whether they attack or not.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Prey for 2 turns; each Harmful skill they use gives them 1 Sulfur.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. They gain 1 Sulfur at the end of each turn they're Taunted.

changes.why: Was Wraith in White with Sulfur and Ignite counts swapped in; now debuffs thrown at the Pit Lord become fuel on the thrower.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might per enemy with Sulfur and 1 Armor per Ignited enemy, and is Immune while Flameborn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and each Debuff aimed at them gives its user 1 Sulfur instead.

changes.why: Was Worldquake with Fire's Ignite added; now Fire's Ignites pay for Earth's discount and turn into Scorch.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, all Ignited. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Costs 1 less per Ignited enemy, and Ignited enemies hit are Scorched for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Blisterblade's Igniting counter with 1 Corona tacked on; now the counter cashes in the user's Corona as burst without spending it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user and Ignites its user; the user gains 1 Corona.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user takes 15 Affliction per Corona the user has, and the user's Corona is refreshed.

changes.why: Was Nature's Wrath plus 2 Corona; now it lifts the Corona cap for a window the user has to fill.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Seedlings and gains 2 Corona, then Immune for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune, can hold up to 5 Corona and gains 1 each turn. When it ends, their Corona drops to 3.

changes.why: Its Flare needed Corona from other Sun skills; now it alternates building and spending on its own.

before.effect: 15 damage. Flare: 10 more per Corona.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has no Corona, they gain 1; otherwise it Flares: 10 more per Corona.

changes.why: Was Heat Seeker's Scorch plus Tunnelmaker's early landing with Corona for the Boulder; now its Flare turns the snipe into a team heal.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage to target enemy, who is permanently Scorched. Flare: with 2 or more Corona spent, it lands a turn sooner.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 45 damage to target enemy. Flare: when it lands, every ally heals 10 per Corona spent.

changes.why: Was Burrow plus 1 Corona; now a sunset and sunrise that burns the enemies who acted while the user was gone.

before.effect: The user sinks below the horizon: Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn, and 1 Corona.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn they rise: they gain 1 Corona, and each enemy who used a Harmful skill meanwhile is Ignited.

changes.why: Was Forest Stalker with Corona and a renamed Channel Earth; now its skill trades its own HP for new Seedlings.

before.effect: Summons a Sunflower (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently; it always has 1 Corona. Photosynthesis (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

after.effect: Summons a Sunflower (40 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently; it always has 1 Corona. Scatter Seeds (r): the Sunflower loses 10 HP, and its creator creates a Seedling.

changes.why: Was Vine Lash plus Ignite; now Earth's Seedling is planted on one cast and burned as fuel on the next.

before.effect: 25 damage and Ignite. If the user has no Seedling, they create one.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Seedling, one is sacrificed and the target is Ignited and Scorched for 2 turns; otherwise, the user creates one.

changes.why: Was Verdant Burst with a Flare bonus; now the burst costs the user their own healing for a while.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 25 damage to all enemies. Flare: 10 more to each per Corona.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Flare: 10 more to each per Corona, but the user is Scorched for 1 turn per Corona spent.

changes.why: Was Worldmarch plus Corona per Seedling; now it drains burning enemies and stretches the Corona's lifespan.

before.effect: Every allied Seedling becomes a Worldsprout, and the user gains 1 Corona per Seedling.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it, 10 more if the target is Ignited. The user gains 1 Corona, and all their Corona lasts 2 turns longer.

changes.why: Was Sprout Seedling with Corona on each; now one Corona carrier that grows it and hands it over when it dies.

before.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP), each with 1 Corona. Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

after.effect: Summons a Sunseed (20 HP) for 3 turns with 1 Corona. When it dies or expires, its creator gains its Corona. Brighten (r): the Sunseed gains 1 Corona.

changes.why: Was Worldcaller with Corona each turn; now it builds Corona and doubles its bite on Fire's burning targets.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Seedling and gain 1 Corona.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Corona. While it channels, their Corona doesn't expire and deals double to Ignited enemies.

changes.why: Was Stonepierce plus Ignite; now Earth's defense check becomes Fire melting that defense away.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor, and Ignite.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they have Shield or Armor, it first melts 10 Shield or 1 Armor, and they're Ignited.

changes.why: Was Stone Drill with Scorch tacked on; now it spends the user's own Armor to melt through.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might. The target is Scorched for 2 turns.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user has Armor, they lose 1, and this deals 15 more and Ignites the target.

changes.why: Was Pitfall with Scorch in place of Isolated; now a glare that blinds longer the brighter the user burns.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned for 1 turn and Scorched for 2.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Blinded for 1 turn per Corona the user has (at least 1).

changes.why: Was Landslide with Corona in place of the Boulder; now a mobility buff that ramps Might off Corona ticks.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from Basking, they also gain 1 Corona.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness, and each time their Corona ticks they gain 1 Might until it ends. They gain 1 Corona now.

changes.why: Was Grovetender plus 1 Corona; now it turns an ally's burns into sunlight.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15 and gains 1 Corona.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. Each Ignite or Scorch on them is removed and becomes 1 Corona.

changes.why: Was Worldmute plus Scorch; now Fire's Scorch steals the enemy's healing for the Sun's side.

before.effect: For each Might target ally has, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness and is Scorched for 2 turns.

after.effect: Target enemy is Scorched for 2 turns; the healing the Scorch denies them goes to a random ally of the user instead.

changes.why: Was a second '10 more per Corona' Flare beside Noon Ray; now spending the user's Corona seeds it into the team.

before.effect: 20 damage. Flare: 10 more per Corona, and a 1-turn Stun if 3 were spent.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Flare: for 1 turn per Corona spent, allies who damage them gain 1 Corona.

changes.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with Corona in place of Renew; now it spreads one ally's sun across the team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 20 and gain 1 Corona.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. Flare: every ally gains 1 Corona per 2 Corona spent, rounded up.

changes.why: Was Vine Whirl plus Ignite and an exploding Boulder; now it lights the pair, then turns a lit pair into Corona.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies, Igniting them. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched and Explodes on impact.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy. If both were already Ignited, the user gains 1 Corona; otherwise, the unlit one is Ignited.

changes.why: Was Awakener's Roar plus Corona; now it keeps Shout's Intimidate and makes the minions' Corona pulse at once.

before.effect: Every allied minion heals to full and gains 1 Corona.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Every allied minion gains 1 Corona, and it ticks once now.

changes.why: Was Rampart plus 1 Corona; now Earth's wall sets fire to whoever hits it.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles their Shield if they have some, and gains 1 Corona.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Enemies who damage it are Ignited.

changes.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Scorch; now each blow the grudge-holder lands makes the user's sun flare against their whole team.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time), who is Scorched while Taunted.

after.effect: Permanently Taunts target enemy (only one at a time). Each time they damage the user, the user's Corona ticks once.

changes.why: Was Treant Form plus 3 Corona; now the user becomes a fixed sun that hardens with every tick.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might per allied Seedling and 5 Shield per allied Boulder; they gain 3 Corona now.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune, their Corona stays at 3 and can't be spent, and each tick gives them 1 Armor. When it ends, they lose all Corona.

changes.why: Was Righteous Blow's Anointed bonus with Accused added; now Anointed speeds the conviction instead of the hit.

before.effect: 20 damage, and the target is Accused for 2 turns. If the user is Anointed, 10 more damage and they heal 10.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and they're Accused for 2 turns. If the user is Anointed, the target also gains 1 Sin at once.

changes.why: Was a second Sentence-everyone hit beside Day of Judgment; now the target's guilt spreads Accusation to their team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Sentences each: 10 Affliction per Sin, and anyone who had Sin is Ignited.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Their allies are Accused for 1 turn per Sin the target has (max 3).

changes.why: Was Zealous Rush with Accused added; now it convicts retroactively for what the target just did.

before.effect: 15 damage; the target is Accused for 2 turns, and the user's next Harmful skill Sanctifies for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who's Accused for 2 turns and gains 1 Sin at once if they used a Harmful skill last turn. The user gains 1 Focus.

changes.why: Was Blisterblade's Igniting counter plus 2 Sin; now it convicts a first offender or punishes a repeat one.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Sin and is Ignited.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user and Sentences its user: 10 Affliction per Sin. With no Sin, they gain 2 instead.

changes.why: Was Divine Fury plus Blazing Fury; now the user's fury grows with the enemy team's guilt.

before.effect: The user is Anointed and Flameborn for 3 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Accused for 1 turn. For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might per Sin among enemies (max 3), rechecked each turn.

changes.why: Was Sunbeam with Accused added; now a harsher charge that also convicts healing and buffing.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the target is Accused for 2 turns. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, who's Accused for 2 turns; this time, their Helpful skills earn Sin too.

changes.why: Was Spear of Light with a Sentence added; now the verdict lands on whoever is guiltiest when it falls.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage; Sentence: 15 Affliction per Sin.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to the enemy with the most Sin, or to target enemy if none has more, and Sentence: 15 Affliction per Sin.

changes.why: Was Decree with Accused added; now a hidden Accusation, so the enemy can't play around their Sin.

before.effect: Target enemy is Accused and Condemned for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy is secretly Accused; the Sin they gain stays hidden from them until it's Sentenced.

changes.why: Was Cloister plus Flameborn; now enemy Fire on the user is turned into Holy's Anointed.

before.effect: The user gains Immune and Flameborn for 1 turn, and Invulnerable too if they're Anointed.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each Ignite on them burns out: it's removed and heals them 10, and they're Anointed if any were.

changes.why: Was Rebuke with Accused for Sanctify; now their guilt feeds any Fire burning them.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Accused for 2 turns; a target that already has Sin is also Ignited.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. When it ends, they spend all their Fervor: every ally heals 10 per stack.

changes.why: Was Black Axe plus Righteous Blow; now it asks who hurt the team and makes them pay through Exposed.

before.effect: 25 damage. If this kills the target, the user gains Stealth; if the user is Anointed, 10 more and they heal 10.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they damaged an ally of the user since the user's last turn, they're Exposed for 1 turn first, so this deals 10 more.

changes.why: Was Shadow Crash plus Divine Storm's heal; now hitting an Exposed enemy lets the user melt back into the shadows.

before.effect: Removes Stealth from every Stealthed ally; then 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to the others, +10 to each per Stealth removed. The user heals 5 per target hit.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. If any enemy hit is Exposed, the user gains Stealth.

changes.why: Was Mirage Blade with Exposed tacked on; now the counter guards the whole team, catching whoever strikes an ally.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Exposed for 2 turns, and the user gains 1 Focus.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on any ally of the user; its user is Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Night of Knives plus Divine Fury; now the user stays hidden for as long as they hunt Exposed prey.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness and is Anointed.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and their skills are Stealthy when they target an Exposed enemy.

changes.why: Was Sunbeam plus Exposed; now it sweeps for hidden enemies at random and pins down whoever it finds.

before.effect: 10 damage and Exposed for 1 turn. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

after.effect: 10 damage to a random enemy, Stealthed ones included. If they had Stealth or an Invisible effect, they're Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Dream Seeker with 5 more and Exposed; now it punishes a target who tries to hide from the shot.

before.effect: On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, and Exposed for 2 turns.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy; if they gained Stealth or used an Invisible skill meanwhile, 20 more and Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Decree with Exposed on trigger; now the trap springs on the enemy's own attempt to act unseen.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; when it triggers, they're also Exposed for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Stealthy or Invisible skill, it's countered and they're Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Shadowstep plus Cloister's Immune; now Holy's verdicts let the user keep Shadow's Stealth while carrying them out.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted and Immune for 1 turn.

after.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; their next skill against a Condemned or Sanctified enemy is Stealthy too.

changes.why: Was Spirit Raven with Exposed for Taunt; now the scent holds until the enemy deals with the dog.

before.effect: Summons a Bloodhound (30 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 Piercing damage. Sniff Out (r): target enemy is Exposed for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Bloodhound (30 HP) permanently. Run Down (r): 10 Piercing damage. Scent (r): target enemy is Exposed for as long as the Bloodhound lives, until it uses Scent again.

changes.why: Was Blackbolt plus Rebuke; now each parent's status sets up the other's, so the bolt escalates what's already there.

before.effect: 20 damage; Blinded for 2 turns and Sanctified for 1.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. A Blinded target is also Condemned for 2 turns; a Condemned one is also Blinded for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was an AoE with Exposed on everyone; now it only lights up the enemies who were hiding.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and all are Exposed for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Those with Stealth, an Invisible effect or Invulnerable are Exposed for 2 turns first, and take 10 more.

changes.why: Was Ascension with Exposed as a condition; now Holy's drain feeds on Shadow's hidden tricks and dismantles them.

before.effect: 5 damage. If the target is Exposed or Sanctified, their Invisible effects end and the user becomes Anointed.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for the damage dealt. Their Invisible effects are revealed and end, and the user heals 10 more for each.

changes.why: Was Call Shade with Exposed for Blind; now the informant sells out whoever silences it.

after.effect: Summons an Informant (15 HP) for 3 turns. Whoever damages it is Exposed for 2 turns. Tip Off (r): the user's next skill on target enemy is Stealthy.

changes.why: Was Consecration with Exposed added; now the patrol only answers the enemies who acted.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded or Condemned.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Against an Exposed target, it doesn't end the user's Stealth.

changes.why: Was Sap plus Repentance; now catching an Exposed target turns the sleeper hold into a real lockdown.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; a Condemned target is Stunned for 1 turn instead, which damage doesn't end.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and Sleep. An Exposed target is Stunned for 2 turns instead, which damage doesn't end.

changes.why: Was Hall of Phantoms with Anointed added; now the mask is for the hunt: hidden, the vigilante hits Exposed enemies twice as hard.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, they gain Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns, and are Anointed.

after.effect: The user gains Stealth and 1 Swiftness. While they stay Stealthed, their skills deal 10 more to Exposed enemies.

changes.why: Was Nightfall for one ally; now the ally chooses between acting and lying low for Holy's second heal.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains Stealth.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains Stealth. If they're still Stealthed at the end of their next turn, they heal 15 more.

changes.why: Was Nightwrap plus Holy Favor; now the hidden blessing is also bait that exposes whoever goes after the ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: Invisible. Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn; any enemy who targets them meanwhile is Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Blinding Powder with Exposed added; now it posts a bounty that rewards the team's hunter.

before.effect: Target enemy is Exposed and Blinded for 3 turns.

after.effect: Target enemy is Exposed for 3 turns. The first ally of the user to damage them gains Stealth.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sanctify and Exposed for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns; while they're Exposed, it heals the damager 15 more.

changes.why: Was Nightfall plus a heal while Anointed; now the vigil heals the team and names who hurt it.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth and heal 20; if the user is Anointed, they heal 10 more next turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. Each enemy who damaged one of them since the user's last turn is Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus Guardian Strike; now the second hit seeks out whoever is Exposed.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random Exposed enemy, or to a random enemy if none is.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time one uses a Harmful skill, they're Exposed for 1 turn.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If it breaks, its breaker is Condemned for 2 turns and the user gains Stealth.

changes.why: Was Shadow Mockery plus Gleam and Exposed; now the vigilante takes the hit, vanishes, and leaves the attacker in the light.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and every enemy who damages them is Exposed for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Soul Shackle with Hex of Silence for Weakness; now it punishes cleansing, backing up Lingering.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if a Debuff is removed from target enemy, they're Stunned for 1 turn and gain Hex of Ruin for 3 turns.

changes.why: Was Shadowstep plus Grave Step; now the escape feeds on Shadow's Blind to take Unholy's Soul Fragments.

after.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and drains a Soul Fragment from each Blinded enemy.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If it kills them, each of their Hexes Lingers onto two allies instead of one.

changes.why: Was Lay Waste plus Ambush's Stealth bonus; now Shadow's Sleep sets up a hit that doesn't break it, and Unholy's Horrify.

after.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Asleep, it doesn't wake them, and they're Horrified for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill while Hexed, it's countered and their Hexes last 1 turn longer. The user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; Hexed ones take 10 more.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random Hexed enemy, whose Hexes are refreshed to 2 turns.
