changes.why: Was Envenom with Suspended added to its condition; now it pays off a Stun and freezes it in place.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. Prey or Suspended targets gain 2 Toxin.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Stunned. A Stunned target is also Suspended for 1 turn, so the Stun can't wear off.

changes.why: Was Numbing Needle with Suspended added; now its stacks make the target Prey, and the cold keeps them from fading while they stay Prey.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable, and are Suspended for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they gain 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable. These can't wear off while they're Prey.

changes.why: Was Lacerate with Suspended added; now the Stun ends in a Thaw-style release of their Toxin.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned and Suspended for 1 turn, or 2 turns if they're Prey.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey. When the Stun ends, their Toxin deals its damage at once, doubled.

changes.why: Was Viper's Crest lasting a turn longer through Suspended; now it rewards picking the ally with the most Buffs and freezes them all in place.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns, then is Suspended for 1 turn so they last longer.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might for each Buff they have, then is Suspended for 2 turns so their Buffs hold.

changes.why: Was Swamp Toxins with an extra Toxin and Suspended; now the freeze lengthens with every Debuff already on them, holding the whole set in place.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion and 2 Toxin, and is Suspended for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion, and is Suspended for 1 turn for each Debuff they have (max 3).

changes.why: Was Preymark with Numb added; now the team loads Toxin into a frozen target so it all comes out in one doubled Thaw.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Vulnerable.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and Suspended for 1 turn. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them adds 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Serpentsong with Suspended added; now it cleanses the team's Toxin into Ice's Shield.

before.effect: All allies gain 2 Renew; all enemies gain 1 Toxin and are Suspended for 1 turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 15 and lose their Toxin, gaining 10 Shield for each stack lost.

changes.why: Was Tail Lash with Chilled added; now the lash carries the target's Toxin to a second enemy and freezes it there.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, and Chilled for 1 turn. If it hits any Prey, its cooldown resets.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Toxin as the target has (max 3) and is Suspended for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Coil plus Permafrost's Frostborn bonus; now a Shield the enemy leaves unbroken turns into Toxin on them.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 10 Shield, or 20 Shield if Frostborn.

after.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 20 Shield for 2 turns. When the Shield expires, each 10 left gives a random enemy 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with Suspended added; now every forced attack adds Toxin that waits for the Thaw.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 3 turns, and is Suspended for the first.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Suspended for 2 turns. Each Harmful skill they use on the user gives them 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was base Titan with a one-turn team freeze and Frostborn attached; now every enemy the user hits is held until the form ends, then they Thaw together.

before.effect: Every enemy is Suspended for 1 turn; the user gains 2 Armor and Frostborn for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune. Enemies they damage gain 1 Toxin and stay Suspended until this ends.

changes.why: Was Worldfist with more damage and a Mythic damage bonus; now the lone giant hits hardest without minions, the reverse of Earth's army scaling, and Mythic makes it sweep.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per allied minion. Mythic: 15 more, and Frostbitten for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, or 30 if the user has no allied minions. Mythic: it also hits a random other enemy for 15.

changes.why: Was Worldquake with Chilled and a Mythic double; now Boulders power the stomp, and a Mythic stomp raises more of them.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, all Chilled for 1 turn. Costs 1 less per allied minion. Mythic: double damage.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each hit per allied Boulder. Mythic: the user creates a Boulder for each enemy it hits.

changes.why: Was Rolling Crash with more damage and a Mythic Stun; now it alternates between raising a Boulder and smashing it into the target.

before.effect: 15 damage, and creates a Boulder. Mythic: the target is also Stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Boulder, it's destroyed to add half its HP to the hit; if not, they create one. Mythic: the Boulder isn't destroyed.

changes.why: Was Shale Guard with a Mythic Frostbitten; now the ward raises a Boulder, and the Mythic giant throws the skill back.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage to its user. Mythic: they're also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and creates a Boulder when it does. Mythic: it reflects the skill instead of countering it.

changes.why: Was Launch Stone with Chilled tacked on; now a Mythic user can seize an enemy minion and throw it, removing it from the fight.

before.effect: 15 damage. Can instead launch an allied Boulder at a random enemy for its remaining HP, Chilling them for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Boulder to hurl it at a random enemy for its remaining HP. Mythic: it can hurl an enemy minion the same way.

changes.why: Was Tunnelmaker with a Mythic speed-up; now the enemy chooses when it lands, since hitting the user early looses a smaller spear.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 60 Piercing damage to target enemy; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder. Mythic: always a turn sooner.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, growing by 20 at the end of each of the user's turns. It lands at 60, or as soon as the user takes damage.

changes.why: Was Boulder Trap with Chilled added; now the troll's Boulder takes the enemy's attack, and breaking it leaves them Chilled.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed, the user creates a Boulder, and the target is Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first Harmful skill target enemy uses strikes a new allied Boulder instead. If that destroys the Boulder, they're Chilled for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Burrow with Frostborn in place of Ghosted; now the user gives up a turn in the barrow to rise closer to Mythic, and a Mythic user, who can't be Stunned, loses nothing.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable and Frostborn for 1 turn.

after.effect: The user is Stunned and Invulnerable until the end of their next turn, and gains 1 more Legend.

changes.why: Was Glacial Hammer's hit and Frostbitten at Bolt cost; now Frost debuffs feed the user's Legend, and a Mythic rune carves itself onto a second enemy.

before.effect: 25 damage and Frostbitten for 1 turn. Mythic: Frostbitten for 2 turns, and Numb.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; the user gains 1 more Legend if the target has a Frost debuff. Mythic: the target's Frost debuffs also spread to a random ally of theirs.

changes.why: Was Verdant Burst's damage with Glacial Burst's Chilled and a Mythic damage bump; now it turns enemy minions to stone on the user's side.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies; those without Buffs are Chilled for 2 turns. Mythic: 35 damage.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Enemy minions it kills become allied Boulders. Mythic: every enemy minion it hits becomes one, dead or not.

changes.why: Was Worldcaller with Rime Giants and Legend; now the stones sleep until the channel completes, then every Boulder wakes as a giant.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Rime Giant (30 HP, 1 Armor; Frost Maul (nc): 15 damage) and gain 1 Legend.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. The user creates a Boulder at the end of each of their turns. When it ends, every allied Boulder awakens as a Rime Giant with its HP (Frost Maul (nc): 15 damage).

changes.why: Was Stonepierce plus Piercing Cold's Frostbitten; now Ice's Frostbitten lets the blade Shatter the defenses Earth's version only punishes.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor, and Frostbitten until the end of the user's next turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have Shield or Armor. Frostbitten targets are also Shattered for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Stone Drill with a Mythic bonus; now it rewards hitting the biggest enemy, and Mythic's extra HP no longer shrinks the list of giants.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might. Mythic: +20 more.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +20 if they have more HP than the user. If it kills, the user gains 1 more Legend. Mythic: the bonus always applies.

changes.why: Was Pitfall with Chilled added; now it's a riddle with no safe answer: attack and be Stunned, or hold back and be Frostbitten.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and Chilled for 2.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn; if they don't, they're Frostbitten for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Earthwrap with a Mythic that removed its Shield; now the stone shell is the Stun, so the user's team must choose whether to break it.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 25 Shield. Mythic: they gain no Shield.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned and gains 25 Shield for 3 turns; the Stun ends if the Shield breaks. Mythic: it doesn't.

changes.why: Was Landslide plus a Legend; now its Boulders are cairns that feed Legend when they fall, so enemies pay for breaking them.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, they also create a Boulder and gain 1 Legend.

after.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from Cairn Builder, they also create a Boulder that gives them 1 Legend when it's destroyed.

changes.why: Was Grovetender plus Freeze Wound's Armor; now it spends a Boulder for a bigger heal, as Worldcaller's Vitality Transfer spends a Worldsprout.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15 and gains 2 Armor for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 15. If the user has a Boulder, it crumbles into them: they heal half its HP more and gain 1 Armor for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Infuse Earth with a Mythic 'both'; now it favors minions, and a Mythic user can lend the giant's form to an ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random. Mythic: both.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random; an allied minion gains both. Mythic: a non-minion ally also becomes Mythic until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Worldmute with Chilled added; now the curse grows with the user's Legend and falls on the whole team once they're Mythic.

before.effect: For each Might target ally has, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness and is Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Weakness for 2 turns per Legend the user has (at least 1). Mythic: every enemy does.

changes.why: Was Earth Pillar with a Mythic Frostbitten; now the team's follow-up hits write the user's saga, pushing them toward Mythic.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, if a Boulder damages the target, they're Stunned for 1 turn. Mythic: also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them gives the user 1 Legend. Mythic: those allies also gain 1 Armor.

changes.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with a Mythic Shield; now it restores the user's minions, and Mythic shares the giant's size with the team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 25 and gain 2 Renew. Mythic: and 20 Shield.

after.effect: All allies heal 20, and allied minions heal to full. Mythic: allies also gain 20 max HP while the user stays Mythic.

changes.why: Was Vine Whirl with Chilled tacked on; now the giant's sweep catches everyone smaller than the user, a list Mythic's extra HP widens.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies, Chilled for 1 turn. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and 10 to every other enemy with less HP than the user.

changes.why: Was Awakener's Roar plus a Legend; now it's a war horn whose fear lasts longer the more Boulders stand with the user.

before.effect: All allied Boulders gain 1 Armor and heal to full; the user gains 1 Legend.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, +1 per allied Boulder (up to 4). Mythic: they're also Frostbitten for as long.

changes.why: Was Rampart plus Permafrost's Frostborn bonus; now the rampart shelters the user's minions too.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield (45 if Frostborn), or doubles the Shield they have.

after.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles the Shield they have. Until it breaks, damage to allied minions hits this Shield instead.

changes.why: Was Ancient Grudge with a Mythic Frostbitten; now the feud feeds the user's Legend, so every blow the rival lands brings Mythic closer.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time). Mythic: they're Frostbitten while Taunted.

after.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time). Each time they damage the user, the user gains 1 Legend. Mythic: the user deals 10 more to them.

changes.why: Was Treant Form's minion scaling plus instant Mythic; now the Legend already banked decides how long the giant stays awake.

before.effect: The user becomes Mythic now, for 4 turns, and gains 1 Might per allied Seedling and 5 Shield per allied Boulder.

after.effect: The user becomes Mythic now, for 3 turns +1 per Legend they had, and is Immune for as long.

changes.why: Was Righteous Blow with Refract in place of its heal; now Ice's Frostbitten turns the half-strength split into a full second hit.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, 10 more if the user is Anointed. Refract.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Refract; if the refracted hit lands on a Frostbitten enemy, it's full strength.

changes.why: Was Divine Storm plus Foot of the Mountain's Chilled; now Ice's Frost debuffs mark who gets Condemned and how much the user heals.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, all Chilled for 1 turn; the user heals 5 per target hit.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Enemies it hits with a Frost debuff are Condemned for 1 turn, and the user heals 5 for each.

changes.why: Was Retribution with its healing Refracted to an ally; now the countered attack splits back onto the attacker's own team.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them; the healing Refracts to a random ally.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, which Refracts instead: it hits a random ally of its user at half strength.

changes.why: Was Divine Fury with a free Lens every turn; now the Lens comes only from holding the beam on one target.

before.effect: The user is Anointed for 3 turns and gains Lens at the start of each of their turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Anointed, and gains Lens each turn they damage the same enemy they damaged the turn before.

changes.why: Was Sunbeam with Refract tacked on; now the ice in the target splits the shot further, one extra beam per Frost debuff.

before.effect: 15 damage. Refract. Consumes the user's Anointed to heal them 15.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Refract, once more for each Frost debuff they have.

changes.why: Was Comet Shard's Piercing lance with a note that Lens boosts it; now a killing shot passes through and carries its overkill to the next enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 Piercing damage (75 with Lens).

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. If it kills them, the damage left over Refracts to a random ally of theirs at full strength.

changes.why: Was Decree plus Frostbitten; now it springs on the enemy's support play, locking the healer's costs and Sanctifying whoever they helped.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Frostbitten for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they're Chilled for 2 turns and everyone it helped is Sanctified for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Cloister plus Frostborn; now Frostborn's shelter from the Frostbitten stretches to the Condemned, a longer but partial escape.

before.effect: The user gains Immune and Frostborn for 1 turn, and Invulnerable too if they're Anointed.

after.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn, and for 2 turns can't be targeted by Frostbitten or Condemned enemies.

changes.why: Was Sacred Lion with its second attack given Refract; now the Elk is a support that hands out Lens and sets up Sanctify.

before.effect: Summons a Lumen Elk (45 HP) permanently. Glare (W): 10 damage to all enemies and Sanctify. Gore (r): 15 damage, Refract.

after.effect: Summons a Lumen Elk (45 HP) permanently. Antler Glow (W): target ally gains Lens. Gore (r): 15 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Rebuke with Refract tacked on; now the bolt splits into colors, a different Holy or Ice debuff on each target.

before.effect: 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn. Refract.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Refract. Each target also gets one of Sanctified, Condemned, Frostbitten or Numb at random for 1 turn, never the same one.

changes.why: Was Holy Nova plus Glacial Burst's no-Buffs bonus; now Ice's no-Buffs test decides who gets Holy's Condemned.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies, 10 more to those with no Buffs. If the user is Anointed, it strikes again at the start of their next turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies; those with no Buffs are also Condemned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Ascension with Lens added; now it drains both parents' debuffs, healing more the more of them the target carries.

before.effect: 5 damage. If the target is Sanctified, the user becomes Anointed and gains Lens.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. The user heals 10 for each Frost debuff and Sanctify on them.

changes.why: Was Consecration with Refract tacked on; now the beam spreads wider every turn it's held.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to a random enemy without Sanctify, who is Sanctified. Refract.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to target enemy and Sanctified for 1 turn; it Refracts to 1 more enemy each turn.

changes.why: Was Piercing Light under a Lens hook it never used; now a weak stab focuses the user's next skill instead.

before.effect: 10 damage, +10 if the target is Condemned or Sanctified. The bonus always applies if the user is Anointed.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Condemned or Frostbitten. If it deals only 10, the user gains Lens.

changes.why: Was Crusade plus Glacial Burst's no-Buffs bonus; now it uses Shardstorm's shape, with Holy's Condemned choosing who it hits.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; targets with no Buffs take 10 more.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and every other Condemned enemy. Any it hits above 75 HP are Condemned afterward.

changes.why: Was Martyrdom with a shorter Anoint that also Refracted; now it counters and hands the would-be victims a focused reply.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, all its targets are Anointed until the end of their next turn, and one more ally is too.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and every unit it targeted gains Lens.

changes.why: Was Repentance with Frostbitten added as a second trigger; now having both parents' debuffs spreads the Stun to a second enemy.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn if they're Condemned or Frostbitten.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn if they're Condemned. If they're also Frostbitten, the Stun Refracts.

changes.why: Was Angel's Grace with Frostborn and a free Lens; now every single-target attack spends the Lens and drops the Invulnerable until next turn.

before.effect: For 2 turns, the user is Invulnerable, Immune and Frostborn, and gains Lens at the start of each of their turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains Lens at the start of each of their turns. While they have Lens, they're Invulnerable.

changes.why: Was Hand of Light with less healing and Refract tacked on; now the split is aimed, reaching whoever needs it most.

before.effect: Target ally heals 40. Refract.

after.effect: Target ally heals 40. It Refracts to the most injured other ally rather than a random one.

changes.why: Was Holy Favor with Lens added; now Lens is the reward for blessing an ally who's already Anointed.

before.effect: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn, and gains Lens.

after.effect: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn; if they already were, they also gain Lens.

changes.why: Was Mark of Heresy with Refract tacked on; now the verdict splits, Condemning one enemy and Sanctifying another.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn. Refract.

after.effect: Target enemy is Condemned until the end of the user's next turn. It Refracts as Sanctify: a random ally of theirs is Sanctified for as long.

changes.why: Was Karmic Marking plus Numb plus Refract; now it rewards the first ally to follow up with a focused next skill.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 1 turn; Refract. If the user is Anointed, both targets are also Sanctified for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Sanctified for 1 turn. The first ally who damages them before then gains Lens.

changes.why: Was Northern Solace plus Saving Grace's repeat; now one ally gets the full hymn and the rest half, or a Lens pours it all into one.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, and gain 20 Shield and 1 Armor for 1 turn. If the user is Anointed, it repeats next turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 30 and gains 20 Shield. It Refracts to every other ally.

changes.why: Was Guardian Strike with Refract as its second hit; now Ice's Frostbitten sets up Holy's Sanctify for the team's follow-ups.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Refract. If a Sanctified target is hit, all allies heal 5.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Each Frostbitten one it hits is Sanctified for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Excoriate plus Frostbitten; now it's a team-wide focus that sets up one big burst turn.

before.effect: Bypass. Every Sanctified enemy is Condemned and Frostbitten for 1 turn.

after.effect: Every ally gains Lens. Every Frostbitten or Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Shield of Faith plus Permafrost's Frostborn bonus plus Lens; now breaking the Shield is what focuses the user's reply.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield (35 if Frostborn) and Lens; if Anointed, Immune for 2 turns too.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, they gain Lens, and Immune for 1 turn if they're Anointed.

changes.why: Was Gleam with a refracted Condemned; now the Taunt itself splits, pulling two enemies onto the user.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill; one more random enemy is Condemned too.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy until they use a new Harmful skill. Refract: a random ally of theirs is Taunted by the user too.

changes.why: Was Grand Crusader with a Refracted share of its buffs; now the colossus splits incoming blows, sending half back at the enemy.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Armor per Sanctified or Condemned enemy hit, and a random ally gains half as much.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor and Immune. Half of each direct hit on them Refracts away, striking a random enemy instead.

changes.why: Was Witchblade with Soulfrost in Glacial Hammer's Frostbitten slot; now it hits one enemy and plants the frost on whoever is closest to death.

before.effect: 25 damage and Soulfrost for 2 turns; Horrified targets take 10 more.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. The enemy with the lowest HP is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Soulcrusher with Soulfrost tacked on; now the splash is delayed and repeats whenever the team hits the frosted target.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies are Horrified and Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

after.effect: 35 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. Each time it yields a Soul Fragment, their allies take 10.

changes.why: Was Avalanche's Numb plus Wraithwalk's drain; now it plants Soulfrost and makes a follow-up on a frosted target cheaper, so the harvest comes sooner.

before.effect: 15 damage and Numb for 2 turns; the user's next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Focus for their next skill, or 2 if it targets a Soulfrosted enemy.

changes.why: Was Spiteful Retort plus a free Phylactery; now the counter also guards the jar and minions, so going for the jar first can backfire.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Horrified for 2 turns, and the user creates a Phylactery.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user or an allied minion, such as their Phylactery; its user is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Undying Fury plus Chilled and Frostborn; now Unholy's Immortal meets Frost Giant's missing-HP scaling: the nearer death, the harder it hits.

before.effect: Consumes all the user's Soul Fragments: 10 damage to a random enemy for each, who is also Chilled for 1 turn. Then Immortal and Frostborn for that many turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immortal and gains 1 Might for every 25 HP they're missing.

changes.why: Was Bone Shard plus Icicle's Chill and Soulfrost; now it loans out a Fragment as Soulfrost, which pays it back when the target is hit again.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has; Chilled and Soulfrosted for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more, and the target is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Comet Shard's Chill trigger plus Soul Lance's drain; now a kill traps the victim's soul as the user's Phylactery.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 Piercing damage (instantly if the target is Chilled). Below 50 HP after, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 Piercing damage to target enemy. If it kills them, their soul becomes the user's Phylactery: one is created, or theirs is restored to full.

changes.why: Was Soul Shackle with Soulfrost in place of Weakness; now it arms in two steps, and the visible frost warns the enemy that their next attack stuns them.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they're Stunned for 1 turn and Soulfrosted for 2.

after.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Soulfrosted for 2 turns; the second time, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Grave Step plus a Phylactery; now the Lich hides in the jar, and the enemy must crack it to reach them.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and creates a Phylactery.

after.effect: If the user has no Phylactery, they create one. They become Invulnerable until it takes damage, for up to 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Hellhound with Soulfrost; now the Wight farms souls and spends them to cheat death, a sink for the Lich's hoard.

before.effect: Summons a Frost Wight (35 HP) permanently. Grave Touch (S, Channeled): 10 Affliction damage to target enemy at the end of each of its turns, and Soulfrost.

after.effect: Summons a Frost Wight (30 HP) permanently. When a hit would kill it, the user spends a Soul Fragment instead and it's left at 1 HP. Rime Claw (S): 15 damage and Soulfrost for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Fel Bolt with Soulfrost; now Ice's Absolute Zero strip feeds Unholy's Horrify, so the faster the target, the longer the dread.

before.effect: 25 damage; Horrified and Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. They lose all Swiftness and Focus, and are Horrified for 1 turn per stack lost (max 3).

changes.why: Was Soul Blast plus Glacial Burst's no-Buff rider; now it marks the weakened for harvest instead of scaling with Fragments.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has; those without Buffs are also Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Those it leaves below 50 HP are Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Drain Soul with Horrified swapped for a Frost debuff; now it cashes a Soulfrost early, trading the slow harvest for a lump sum.

before.effect: 5 damage and drains a Soul Fragment, or 2 if the target has a Frost debuff.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, draining a Soul Fragment. If they're Soulfrosted, it ends, and the user drains 1 more per turn it had left.

changes.why: Was Imp with a Chill; now its volley pays off Ice's no-Buff theme, and it can be sacrificed early for souls.

before.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. Frostbolt (r): 10 Affliction damage and Chilled for 1 turn. Dread Chill (I): target enemy is Horrified for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. Rime Volley (r): 10 damage to each enemy without Buffs. Final Offering (nc): it dies, giving the user 1 Soul Fragment per turn it had left.

changes.why: Was Drain Life with Soulfrost tacked on; now the drain ramps as the frost yields souls, and cleansing the target starves it.

before.effect: Channeled. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and the user heals 10; the target is Soulfrosted while it lasts. If they die, the user gains 2 Soul Fragments.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 1 turn; the user heals 10 for each Soul Fragment it has yielded so far.

changes.why: Was Piercing Cold plus Blighted Dagger; now either parent's Buff lock opens the target up, and both together reward the full combo.

before.effect: 15 damage, and Frostbitten until the end of the user's next turn. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Numb or Horrified. If they're both, it's Piercing and the user heals 10.

changes.why: Was Lay Waste plus a Frostbite fork; now it shatters the target's frost for burst and turns it into dread.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage. A target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn; one without is Frostbitten for 2.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Frost debuff on them. Those debuffs end, and they're Horrified for 1 turn per debuff ended.

changes.why: Was Mirage of Nightmares plus a Phylactery; now it applies Frostborn's rule to Horrify: the frightened can't touch the Lich.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it's countered; the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn and creates a Phylactery.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Horrified for 2 turns. Meanwhile, the user is Invulnerable to Horrified enemies.

changes.why: Was Cripple plus Soulfrost; now the Stun is armed on the frost and fires when anyone on the team hits them.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable and Soulfrost for 2 turns; if Horrified, also 1 permanent Weakness.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. The first time it yields a Soul Fragment, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Grisly Spectacle with Frost debuffs extended too; now it's a real mobility Dance, fuelled by the enemy's dread and cold.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage; every Horrify and Frost debuff on enemies lasts 1 turn longer. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

after.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Swiftness per Horrified enemy and 1 Focus per Chilled one.

changes.why: Was Consume Lesser plus healing the jar; now it's a true ally heal that favors the Lich's minions and jar.

before.effect: Deals 15 damage to another ally or allied minion; the user and their Phylactery each heal 20.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. A minion, such as a Phylactery, heals 40 instead and gains 1 Armor for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Vampirism plus Boreal Aegis; now Lifesteal is gated by Ice's no-Buff condition, which Horrify helps keep true.

before.effect: Target ally gains Lifesteal and Frostborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and heals for half the damage they deal to enemies without Buffs.

changes.why: Was Cause Fear plus Soulfrost; now denied Buffs become the Lich's souls, so the enemy must choose whether to buff at all.

before.effect: Target enemy is Horrified until the end of the turn, and Soulfrosted for 1 turn.

after.effect: For 2 turns, each Buff target enemy would gain is lost, and the user gains a Soul Fragment instead (max 3).

changes.why: Was Soul Sickness plus Soulfrost; now the frost works like Sanctify, healing whichever ally lands the harvesting hit.

before.effect: 20 damage and Soulfrost for 1 turn. For 1 turn, any ally who damages the target gains a Soul Fragment too.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Soulfrost for 2 turns. Each time it yields a Soul Fragment, the ally who dealt that damage heals 10.

changes.why: Was Profane Chant plus Chilled; now it's a team heal whose Ice Shield grows with the enemy's Horrify.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, and 2 Weakness and Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield, plus 10 more Shield for each Horrified enemy.

changes.why: Was Oathbreaker Strike with a Frostborn exception; now the betrayal pays: allies trade HP for Soul Fragments, and Frostborn ones pay nothing.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies; allies with Frostborn are spared.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each ally of the user without Frostborn loses 10 HP; every ally gains a Soul Fragment.

changes.why: Was Soulshriek plus Soulfrost; now it opens a team-wide harvest window where every enemy hit yields a Soul Fragment.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend one for 10 more, and the target is Horrified and Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 1 turn and Soulfrosted until the end of the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was Misery plus a Phylactery; now absorbed blows are stored in the jar, so attacking the Lich builds it.

before.effect: Drains 10 HP from each other ally; the user gains 20 Shield plus the total, and creates a Phylactery if they have none.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, the damage it absorbed heals their Phylactery, or creates one with that much HP (at least 10).

changes.why: Was Unrelenting Horror plus Cold Shoulder's Frostbite; now every forced attack plants the frost the team then harvests.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and they're Frostbitten; if they're Horrified, the user gains Lifesteal for that time.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, they're Soulfrosted for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Soul Colossus with Frostborn in place of Immortal; now the jar is bait: every enemy who goes for it is frosted for the harvest.

before.effect: Consumes all Soul Fragments to heal 5 each; then for that many turns, 2 Armor and Frostborn. Their Phylactery gains 2 Armor too.

after.effect: Creates a Phylactery, or restores the user's to full. For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Frostborn, and every enemy who damages the Phylactery is Soulfrosted for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Icelance's Numb and Blackbolt's Blind side by side; now Ice's frost sets up Shadow's Isolation, cutting a frozen or Midnight-struck target off from their healers.

before.effect: 20 damage; Numb and Blinded for 1 turn, or 2 turns if the target has Dusk.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Isolated for 1 turn. If they have a Frost debuff, they take 10 more and the Isolation lasts 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Nightwrap plus Boreal Aegis plus a Shield; now rime builds while the ally hides, so they choose when to break Stealth.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth and 15 Shield, and is Frostborn while Stealthed.

after.effect: Target ally gains Stealth. When it ends, they gain 10 Shield for each turn it lasted (max 30).

changes.why: Was Blinding Powder plus Hypothermia's Chill plus Dusk; now acting in the dark hastens Midnight, so the target chooses between acting and sleeping sooner.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded and Chilled for 2 turns and gains Dusk 3.

after.effect: Target enemy gains Dusk 4, or deepens it by 1. For 2 turns, each skill they use deepens it by 1 more.

changes.why: Was Hunter's Howl's Blinded rider feeding Arctic Roar's Frostbite; now Ice's Absolute Zero idea hunts the swift with Shadow's Blind, and the kit drops a fourth Blind-into-Frost rider.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; Blinded ones are also Frostbitten for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Any with Swiftness lose it all and are Blinded for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Jolt scaling with Tempest plus Wind's Leaping Strike stun; now it rewards keeping the storm fed turn after turn, the user's own included.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per Tempest. If the user is Leaping, it also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 for each Storm skill the user's team used last turn (max +15).

changes.why: Was Wind's Spiral Crash with Tempest damage tacked on; now Wind's Leap lands as Lightning's Sapped on everyone it hits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per Tempest. If the user isn't Leaping, they Leap; if they are, every other enemy takes 10.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If the user is Leaping, they come down hard: every enemy it hits is Sapped.

changes.why: Was Wind's Launch plus Lightning's Charged Dash; now Wind's Rushing keeps generating Lightning's Charge for as long as the user keeps moving.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing and gains 1 Charge.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user begins Rushing. Each turn they start Rushing, they also gain 1 Charge.

changes.why: Was Wind's Zephyr Blade with Sapped added; now it's a true counter that Wind's Rushing turns into Lightning's Reflect.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy. If this skill is countered, the counterer takes 25 Piercing damage and is Sapped.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; if the user is Rushing, it's Reflected back at its user instead.

changes.why: Was Wind's Chainbreaker with Tempest set to 5 (and named after the Eye); now Lightning's Stormborn Charge cycle feeds the team's Tempest every time it fills.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; Tempest rises to 5, and the user is Immune for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and 1 Might, and each time their Charge fills to 3, Tempest rises by 1.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Zap with Tempest damage added; now it feeds the storm faster off a Sapped target instead of hitting harder.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Tempest; the user gains 1 Charge.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Sapped, the spark jumps: Tempest rises by 1 more.

changes.why: Was Wind's Elegant Sweep plus Lightning's Particle Beam with Tempest damage; now it breaks the storm on purpose, spending all Tempest on one sweeping front.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 20 Piercing damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest; Sapped ones take 10 more.

after.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 15 Piercing damage to all enemies, +5 for each Tempest; it spends all of it.

changes.why: Was Float Noose plus Tesla Coil side by side; now every skill the snared enemy uses feeds the storm that hits them.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage, are Sapped, and are Isolated for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, the user's team gains 1 Tempest, and they take 5 Piercing damage per Tempest.

changes.why: Was Wind's Bound plus 1 Charge; now the Leap carries Lightning's Conduit, so the landing blow steals the target's Charge.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains 1 Charge.

after.effect: The user Leaps, and gains Conduit until their Leap ends, so their landing blow steals the target's Charge.

changes.why: Was Wind's Grand Eagle plus Lightning's Storm Hawk; now the Roc keeps the storm fed with a free wingbeat and unlocks its talons once Tempest is high.

before.effect: Summons a Storm Roc (45 HP) permanently; its skills count as Storm skills. Talon Bolt (r): 15 damage, and Saps. Lift Off (A): target ally Leaps and gains 1 Charge.

after.effect: Summons a Storm Roc (40 HP) permanently; its skills are Storm skills. Gale Wing (nc): 5 damage to target enemy. Thunder Talon (r, only at 3 or more Tempest): 20 damage, and Saps.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Innervate plus Wind's Compressed Bolt with Tempest damage; now Tempest makes it arc to more enemies instead of hitting harder.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per Tempest, and Saps. Immobile targets also have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Saps them. It then arcs to 1 other enemy for every 2 Tempest, dealing 10 to each.

changes.why: Was Wind's Spiral Burst with Tempest damage added; now it discharges the storm into the team, trading Tempest for Lightning's Charge.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest, +10 if the user is Leaping and +10 if Rushing.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. The storm discharges: Tempest falls by 1, and each ally gains 1 Charge.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Siphon Charge plus Wind's Sap Speed; now it drinks from the storm itself, trading Tempest for healing.

before.effect: 5 damage. The user takes all of the target's Charge and removes their mobility buffs, gaining 1 Swiftness per buff.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. The storm calms: Tempest falls by up to 2, and the user heals the damage dealt plus 10 for each point it fell.

changes.why: Was Wind's Wind Sprites with Sap for their counter-punish and a Storm tag; now one cloud feeds the storm and breaks over the enemy when it expires.

before.effect: Summons 2 Storm Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns. Zap (nc, a Storm skill): 5 Piercing damage, and Saps.

after.effect: Summons a Squall Cloud (20 HP) for 3 turns; its skills are Storm skills. Rumble (nc): 5 damage to target enemy. When it expires, it breaks: 5 damage per Tempest to all enemies.

changes.why: Was Wind's Airknife with Tempest damage added; now it punishes Wind's Immobile targets and turns each such stab into Lightning's Charge.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Rushing, +5 per Tempest.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Immobile; stabbing an Immobile target also gives the user 1 Charge.

changes.why: Was Wind's Sonic Thrust plus Lightning's Charged bonus with a muddled trade; now Lightning's Charge clearly pays Wind's Stun price, and hits harder for it.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged. If the user isn't Rushing, they lose their Charge instead of being Stunned.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Rushing, they spend 1 Charge for 15 more damage, or are Stunned for 1 turn if they have none.

changes.why: Was Wind's Wind Step plus Sapped and 1 Tempest; now it's a true counter whose Sapping deepens with the storm.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they're Marked and Sapped, the user begins Rushing, and Tempest rises by 1.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Sapped once for every 2 Tempest (at least once).

changes.why: Was Lightning's System Shock with its Sapped bonus made a full Stun; now it reads the target and stuns whichever half of their kit they just used, Wind's Strategic stun or Lightning's non-Strategic one.

before.effect: 15 damage, and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn; Sapped targets are fully Stunned.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and a 1-turn stun on whichever kind of skill they used last: Strategic or non-Strategic.

changes.why: Was Wind's Top Speed plus Stormborn and 2 Tempest; now riding the storm turns every skill the user has into fuel for Tempest and the Eye.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, Ghosted and Stormborn, and begins Rushing; Tempest rises by 2.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, all their skills count as Storm skills.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Defibrillate plus Wind's Invigorating Breeze; now it's the calm at the Eye: at 5 Tempest it heals the whole team and saves the Eye for a strike.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, +5 per Charge the user has; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. At 5 Tempest, it heals every ally instead, without using up the Eye of the Storm.

changes.why: Was Wind's Swiftwind plus Lightning's Overclock; now the ally joins the storm, so their own skills feed Tempest and can ride the Eye.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, and Conduit for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 2 turns, target ally's skills count as Storm skills, and they gain 1 Swiftness.

changes.why: Was Headwind plus Power Drain; now the enemy's own Lightning is blown into the user's storm.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs, is Sapped, and gains 1 Weakness.

after.effect: Target enemy loses all their Charge. For 2 turns, any Charge they would gain feeds the user's team Tempest instead.

changes.why: Was Wind's Feathermark plus Lightning's Apply Polarity; now the target is a lightning rod, and every ally's hit on them feeds the storm.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap and gain 1 Charge.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally damages them, Tempest rises by 1.

changes.why: Was Wind's Uplifting Verse plus Charge and 1 Tempest; now the song holds the storm up for 2 turns, so the team can pause without losing it.

before.effect: All allies heal 15, Leap and gain 1 Charge; Tempest rises by 1.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, the team's Tempest doesn't fall.

changes.why: Was Wind's Falling Slam with Tempest damage added; now it's the storm's comeback, restoring 2 extra Tempest after a quiet turn.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per Tempest. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If Tempest fell at the end of the team's last turn, it rises by 2 more.

changes.why: Was Wind's Echoing Voice for allies plus Charge and 2 Tempest; now it restores Shout's Intimidate and can be cast at the Eye without wasting it.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Charge; Tempest rises by 2.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. It never uses up the Eye of the Storm; at 5 Tempest, it also Saps every enemy.

changes.why: Was Wind's Slipstream plus Lightning's Lightning Cage with Tempest added; now the wall turns every blow it catches into Tempest for the team.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield, +15 if Rushing and +5 per Tempest, and gains Charge whenever it's hit.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn, and each enemy hit it absorbs raises Tempest by 1.

changes.why: Was Wind's Piercing Cry plus Lightning's Aggro Signal; now the provoked enemy's Lightning Charge and Wind momentum flow to the user.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn, or 3 if they're Immobile; the first Harmful skill they use while Taunted is Reflected.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While Taunted, any Charge or mobility buff they would gain goes to the user instead.

changes.why: Was Wind's Djinnform plus Stormborn with Tempest set to 5; now the djinn feeds the storm every turn and hardens as it grows.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 15 Shield, Immune and Stormborn, then Leaps; Tempest rises to 5.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Armor per 2 Tempest, rechecked each turn; Tempest rises by 1 at the start of each of their turns.

changes.why: Was Jolt's Charge scaling plus Viper Strike's Toxin plus a Cell; now it alternates between storing a Cell and spending one to inject 2 Toxin.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per Charge the user has, and 1 Toxin. The user stores 1 Cell.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has no Cells, they store 1; if they have any, they spend 1 and the target gains 2 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Plague Stomp with Corroded tacked on; now the target's Toxin conducts the splash, so it asks which enemy is most poisoned.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin and are Corroded for 2 turns.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 10 to each of their allies, +5 per Toxin the target has.

changes.why: Was Lunge plus a flat Cell; now it makes one target Prey and pays the follow-up hit on Prey in Cells, a sequencing reward.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey; the user stores 1 Cell.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, who is Prey through the user's next turn. The user's next skill stores 1 Cell for each Prey enemy it damages.

changes.why: Was a counter with Toxin, Sap and 2 Cells tacked on; now it absorbs the countered skill's energy, so it's best saved for the enemy's big skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Toxin and is Sapped, and the user stores 2 Cells.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the next Harmful skill used on the user; the user stores 1 Cell for each energy that skill cost.

changes.why: Was Overcharge plus a Cell each turn; now held Cells become Might, so every Discharge during it costs the Rage some power.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Stormborn and stores 1 Cell at the start of each of their turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user has Stormborn and 1 Might per Cell they hold.

changes.why: Was Zap plus Sting's Toxin side by side; now it poisons until the target is Prey, then feeds on them for Charge.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin; the user gains 1 Charge. Costs r instead while the user has Charge.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user gains 2 Charge; if not, they gain 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Particle Beam with Discharge added; now a kill refunds the Cells, so it rewards aiming at a target it can finish.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy and every Sapped enemy. Discharge: 10 more to the target per Cell.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. Discharge: 10 more per Cell; if it kills them, the Cells are stored again.

changes.why: Was Tesla Coil with Corroded added; now it springs on a Helpful skill and corrodes whoever that skill was shielding.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a skill, they take 15 damage, are Sapped, and are Corroded for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they take 15 Piercing damage and every unit it affects is Corroded for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Slither plus a Cell; now the escape also turns the user's own Toxin and Sapped into stored charge.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, gains 1 Focus, and stores 1 Cell.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and their Toxin and Sapped turn into Cells, stack for stack.

changes.why: Was Storm Hawk's ally Charge plus an Asp bite with Corroded for Toxin; now it's a retaliating beetle whose Acid Jet pays off its own spray.

before.effect: Summons a Bombardier Beetle (30 HP) permanently. Acid Spray (r): 5 Piercing damage and Corroded for 1 turn. Static Spark (I): target ally gains 1 Charge.

after.effect: Summons a Bombardier Beetle (30 HP) permanently; enemies who damage it are Corroded for 2 turns. Acid Jet (r): 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 if they're Corroded.

changes.why: Was Innervate plus Acid Orb's Prey rider with Corroded swapped in; now it dissolves Armor into Toxin, and Corroded stops the Armor coming back.

before.effect: 20 damage, and Saps. Prey targets are also Marked and Corroded for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and Corroded for 2 turns. Each Armor they have turns into 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Static Burst with Cells added; now emptying the battery also drains the user's energy, so the dump is a timing call.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Consumes the user's Charge for 10 more each per Charge; Discharge: 5 more each per Cell.

after.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Discharge: 10 more to each per Cell, and the user is Sapped once per Cell spent.

changes.why: Was Siphon Charge storing Cells instead of Charge; now it's an execute whose threshold is the Cells it burns, and a miss charges the battery instead.

before.effect: 5 damage, and Saps. The user stores 1 Cell, or 2 if the target is Prey.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they're then at or below 5 HP per Cell the user has (10 for minions), Discharge: they're executed; if not, the user stores 1 Cell.

changes.why: Was Spriggan Harasser's Sting with Sap and Corroded riders; now the shock arcs through every poisoned enemy, so spreading Toxin widens it.

before.effect: Summons a Voltaic Wasp swarm (15 HP) for 3 turns. Sting (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin; Prey targets are also Sapped and Corroded for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Voltaic Wasp swarm (15 HP) for 3 turns. Arc Sting (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy, then 5 Piercing to every other enemy with Toxin.

changes.why: Was Lightningrod plus a Cell each turn; now it meters Cells out as a poison drip that lasts as long as the battery does.

before.effect: Channeled. The user has Stormborn while channeling, and stores 1 Cell at the end of each of their turns.

after.effect: Channeled. The user stores 2 Cells. At the end of each of their turns, they spend 1 Cell for 10 Affliction to all enemies; it ends when they have none.

changes.why: Was Stun Baton's hit with Pounce's Prey check paying a Cell; now it's a two-beat shiv, the first Corroding and the next hitting double.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target is Prey or Sapped, the user stores 1 Cell.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Corroded; then they're Corroded for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Malectrocute with Discharge added; now Poison's Prey opens the target to a full Sap, turning the hunt into energy denial.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, +10 if the user is Charged and +10 if the target is Sapped. Discharge: 10 more per Cell.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, they're also Sapped until they have 3.

changes.why: Was Numbing Needle with Sapped and Corroded in place of its riders; now the counter inverts the enemy's Charge, Might and Focus, stance-style.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin, are Sapped, and are Corroded for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and their Charge, Might and Focus turn into Sapped, Weakness and Confusion.

changes.why: Was Lacerate's Prey condition and System Shock's Sapped condition stitched together; now the shock makes their Toxin surge, paying off a poisoned target.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Sapped.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, and their Toxin deals its damage now as well.

changes.why: Was Cobra Stance plus a Charge-to-Sapped twin; now it's a mobility buff that draws Charge from every poisoned enemy.

before.effect: All Armor on enemies turns into Vulnerable, and all their Charge into Sapped.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness; at the end of each of their turns, they gain 1 Charge per enemy with Toxin.

changes.why: Was Defibrillate with Cells in place of Charge; now it pours stored Cells into the ally as Charge, jump-starting their energy.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. Discharge: 10 more healing per Cell.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the user moves up to 3 of their Cells to them as Charge.

changes.why: Was Overclock plus Viper's Crest side by side; now Poison's Renew charges the ally as it heals them.

before.effect: Target ally gains Conduit for 2 turns, and 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 2 Renew, and each Renew heal also gives them 1 Charge.

changes.why: Was Power Drain plus Swamp Toxins' Toxin plus Corroded; now Confusion squeezes their energy and Sapped punishes any they hoard.

before.effect: Target enemy is Sapped, gains 1 Toxin, and is Corroded for 2 turns.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. At the end of each of their turns meanwhile, they're Sapped if they have unspent energy.

changes.why: Was Apply Polarity with Corroded added; now an ally cashes the user's battery, so one character banks and another spends.

before.effect: 15 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain 1 Charge and Corrode them for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Viper's Crest with Inoculated tacked on; now a true vaccine, where a small dose of poison buys immunity to the rest.

before.effect: Target ally is Inoculated, and gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Toxin. For 3 turns, they're immune to further Toxin and gain 1 Might and 1 Renew.

changes.why: Was Mark of Heresy plus Swamp Toxins; now the target soaks the damage of every cleanse on the user's team.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn, and gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion.

after.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Debuff removed from the user's allies deals them 10 Affliction.

changes.why: Was Karmic Marking plus Preymark; now striking the target cleanses the striker, a Sanctify that cures instead of heals.

before.effect: 15 damage; Sanctified for 2 turns if the user is Anointed. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target give them 1 Vulnerable.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them Purges 1 of their own Debuffs onto them.

changes.why: Was Saving Grace with a Purge tacked on; now one ally's infection teaches the whole team immunity.

before.effect: All allies heal 10, gain 10 Shield, and Purge one Debuff each. If the user is Anointed, it repeats next turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, when an enemy gives one of them a Debuff, every ally becomes immune to it for 3 turns.

changes.why: Was Guardian Strike with Prey added to its condition; now Holy's Condemn on one fang makes Poison's Prey of the other.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy; if a Sanctified or Prey target is hit, all allies heal 5.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. If one of them is Condemned, the other is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Excoriate plus a team Purge; now the team's cleansing slows the enemy's cooldowns instead of damaging them.

before.effect: Bypass. Every ally Purges one Debuff (onto random enemies), and every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 1 turn.

after.effect: Every ally loses 1 Debuff. All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, with 1 stack per Debuff removed.

changes.why: Was Shield of Faith with Inoculated tacked on; now afflictions become damage and Shield at once, so a sicker user stands firmer.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield and is Inoculated; if Anointed, also Immune for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user Purges all their Debuffs onto random enemies, then gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, +10 per Debuff Purged.

changes.why: Was Gleam plus Mesmerizing Glare's Prey; now the user draws one enemy's fire and learns immunity to their whole toolkit.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill, and counts as Prey meanwhile.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns. The first Debuff they give the user is prevented, and the user is immune to all their Debuffs for 3 turns.

changes.why: Was Witchblade's 25 plus Viper Strike's Toxin and a Withered; now deep rot yields a Soul Fragment, so the Strike rewards working one target down.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, 1 Toxin, and 1 Withered.

after.effect: 20 damage and 1 Withered to target enemy. If they now have 3 or more Withered, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them.

changes.why: Was Soulcrusher with Withered and Toxin in place of Horrify; now it reads each ally, rotting the poisoned and poisoning the rest so Festering can start.

before.effect: 40 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Withered and 1 Toxin.

after.effect: 40 damage to target enemy. Each of their allies who has Toxin gains 1 Withered; the rest gain 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Lunge plus Wraithwalk; now Poison's Prey is the condition for Unholy's soul drain, with Toxin to build toward it otherwise.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and the user's next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them; if not, they gain 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Spiteful Retort with 2 Withered tacked on; now the rot scales with how hard the countered skill would have hit.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 2 Withered and is Horrified for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user gains 1 Withered per 10 damage it would have dealt.

changes.why: Was Viper Stance plus a Renew-to-Toxin conversion; now a self-rotting frenzy that trades the user's max HP for Might, Unholy's pay-in-flesh style.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into Weakness, and all Renew on enemies turns into Toxin.

after.effect: The user gains 2 Withered. Then, for 3 turns, they gain 1 Might per Withered on them and are Immortal.

changes.why: Was Bone Shard plus Toxin and Withered riders; now it scales off the target's rot, and Unholy's Horrify adds to it.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has, and 1 Toxin; a target that already has Toxin gains 1 Withered instead.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, +5 per Withered they have. If they're Horrified, they gain 1 Withered first.

changes.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus Soul Lance's drain and a Withered; now a single rot-scaled finisher.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage and 1 Withered; below 50 HP after, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage to target enemy, +10 per Withered they have.

changes.why: Was Snake Pit with a Withered tacked on; now it turns the enemy's next heal into rot.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. Each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin; the first time, 1 Withered too.

after.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy would be healed, they aren't, and they gain 1 Withered per 10 it would have healed.

changes.why: Was Grave Step plus Slither's Focus and Unstunnable; now lying low cashes Poison's Prey in for Unholy's Soul Fragments.

before.effect: Unstunnable, Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, they drain a Soul Fragment from each enemy that's Prey.

changes.why: Was Emerald Asp with a Withered skill in place of Constrict; now the swarm spreads rot and then sweeps every rotting enemy.

after.effect: Summons a Plague Rat swarm (25 HP) permanently. Plague Bite (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Withered. Scurry (nc): 5 Piercing damage to each Withered enemy.

before.effect: 25 damage, and Horrified for 2 turns; Prey targets also gain 1 Withered.

after.effect: 20 damage and 1 Withered to target enemy, and Horrified for 1 turn. While Horrified, their Withered can't be cleansed.

changes.why: Was Soul Blast plus Toxin and Withered riders; now the storm hits hardest where the rot runs deepest.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 per Soul Fragment the user has; each gains 1 Toxin, and those already Withered gain another stack.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +5 to each for every Withered stack they have.

changes.why: Was Devour with a Withered threshold plus Soul Fragments; now a drain that feeds on the target's rot.

changes.why: Was Nine Plagues with a Withered every third turn; now its length reads how many enemies are rotting.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns. 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Toxin; every third turn, every enemy gains 1 Withered.

after.effect: Channeled, 2 turns, +1 turn per Withered enemy. Each turn, 10 Affliction to all enemies.

changes.why: Was Blighted Dagger plus Pounce; now it rots healthy targets and finishes weakened ones.

before.effect: 15 damage. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user; against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. Above 60 HP, they also gain 1 Withered.

changes.why: Was Lay Waste with Toxin and Withered riders; now it converts the target's Buffs into rot.

before.effect: 35 Piercing damage; Prey or Horrified targets gain 2 Toxin and 1 Withered.

after.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. Each Buff on them is torn off and becomes 1 Withered.

changes.why: Was Cripple with 2 Withered tacked on; now it stuns and festers the target's Toxin in one burst.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable and 2 Withered; if Horrified, also 1 permanent Weakness.

after.effect: 10 damage, a 1-turn Stun and 1 Withered to target enemy. Then their Toxin grows by 1 per Withered they have.

changes.why: Was Cobra Stance plus Grisly Spectacle's Horrify extension; now a mobile stance that rots whatever it touches.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each skill they use gives its first target 1 Withered.

after.effect: Target ally heals 25 and loses their Toxin; the user gains a Soul Fragment per 2 stacks removed.

before.effect: Target ally gains Lifesteal for 2 turns, and 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Lifesteal against Prey.

changes.why: Was Cause Fear plus Swamp Toxins and a Withered; now the Confusion is bound to the rot, so only a cleanse ends it.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Withered and 1 Toxin, and is Horrified until the end of the turn.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Withered and 1 Confusion; the Confusion lasts until the Withered is cleansed.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them makes their Toxin tick once, healing that ally for it.

after.effect: All allies heal 10, +5 for every Withered stack on the enemy team.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy, who gains as much Withered as the first has (max 2).

changes.why: Was Soulshriek with Withered for Horrify; now a Shout where Poison's Toxin sets up Unholy's Horrify across the team.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; each one with 3 or more Toxin is also Horrified for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Misery plus Coil's Armor; now it drains poisoned enemies instead of the user's own allies.

after.effect: The user drains 5 HP from each enemy with Toxin, then gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, plus twice the total drained.

changes.why: Was Unrelenting Horror plus Mesmerizing Glare and a Withered each turn; now the rot comes from every blow they're forced to land.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns; each time they damage the user, they gain 1 Withered.

changes.why: Was Soul Colossus with Withered on every enemy; now the user grows by the max HP the enemy team has lost.

before.effect: Consumes all Soul Fragments to heal 5 each; then 2 Armor and Immortal for that many turns. Every enemy gains 1 Withered.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and 5 max HP per Withered stack on enemies, healing as it rises.

changes.why: Was Black Axe word for word; now a closed contract passes itself on, keeping the enemy guessing who's next.

before.effect: 25 damage. If this kills the target, the user gains Stealth.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If this executes your Death Mark, a new one goes on a random enemy, hidden.

changes.why: Was Shadow Crash with Toxin tacked on; now hidden allies poison the targets instead of breaking cover to hit harder.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each enemy hit gains 1 Toxin per Stealthed ally of the user, and no one's Stealth is spent.

after.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy and your Death Mark for 2 turns; while the user stays Stealthed, the Mark doesn't count down.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Blinded for 2 turns and counts as Prey while Blinded.

changes.why: Was Night of Knives with Toxin on every hit; now it opens a contract and keeps going for as long as contracts keep closing.

after.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and a random enemy gains your Death Mark. An execution meanwhile extends this by 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Shadow Spine with Toxin tacked on; now Shadow's Blind sets up Poison's Toxin.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, striking once more for each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep that the target is.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Blinded, they also gain 2 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Banewood Javelin plus Dream Seeker's riders; now one shot places the contract and the next collects it at a higher threshold.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 30 Affliction damage; against your Death Mark, it Bypasses and doesn't end Sleep.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy. If they have your Death Mark, this executes at 40 HP; if not, they gain it.

changes.why: Was Snake Pit with a Death Mark tacked on; now the enemy unknowingly hands the contract to the ally they help.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin and your Death Mark.

after.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill on an ally, that ally gains your Death Mark and 2 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Shadowstep plus Slither's Focus; now the vanish punishes whoever just hurt the user.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each enemy who damaged them since their last turn gains 1 Toxin and is Blinded for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Emerald Asp with a Death Mark bonus on its fang; now the Viper places a contract or strikes its bearer wherever they are.

after.effect: 20 damage and 1 Toxin to all enemies. Then your Death Mark moves, hidden, to the enemy with the least HP.

changes.why: Was Devour with a larger range against the Death Mark; now a drain that pays out a big heal and Stealth when it closes the contract.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, or below 30 if they have your Death Mark (doubled for minions).

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If this executes them through your Death Mark, the user heals 30 more and gains Stealth.

changes.why: Was Sap with Prey and Death Mark conditions; now Poison's Toxin decides how deep Shadow's Sleep goes.
