changes.why: Was Sprout Seedling plus a healing aura; now a builder whose work depends on the Sanctum's level.

before.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP); at the end of your turns, each heals the ally with the least HP 5. Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

after.effect: Summons a Stonemason (20 HP) for 3 turns. Carve (r): the user creates a Boulder, or a Wardstone if your Sanctum is at 2 or more.

changes.why: Was Worldcaller making Wardstones instead of Worldsprouts; now it builds the Sanctum up, then turns it on the enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Wardstone (max 2), or raise your Sanctum by 1 if they already have 2.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, your Sanctum rises by 1; if it's already at 3, 10 damage to all enemies instead.

changes.why: Was Stonepierce plus Piercing Light; now it carves Earth's Armor off into Holy's Condemn.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor or who are Condemned or Sanctified.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they have Armor, 1 is chiseled off and they're Condemned.

changes.why: Was Stone Drill plus Crusade; now Holy's Condemn calls Earth's stones down on the target.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might; targets above 75 HP are Condemned.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Condemned, each allied Boulder and Wardstone adds 10.

changes.why: Was Pitfall with a Sanctum rise tacked on; now the bigger the attack it stops, the higher the Sanctum rises.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and your Sanctum rises by 1.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and your Sanctum rises by 1 for each ally it targeted.

changes.why: Was Earthwrap plus a Condemn; now the more consecrated stones stand, the longer the penance.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and Condemned, and gains 25 Shield.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, +1 turn for each allied Wardstone (up to 3 turns in all).

changes.why: Was Landslide with a Sanctum rise in place of the Boulder; now a mobile stance that builds the Sanctum through support.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, your Sanctum rises by 1.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each time they use a Helpful skill, your Sanctum rises by 1.

changes.why: Was Grovetender scaled by Sanctum level; now Earth's Armor on the ally opens Holy's Anointed.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15, +5 per level of your Sanctum.

after.effect: Target ally heals 25. If they have 2 or more Armor, they're also Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Infuse Earth doubled for Anointed allies; now a Wardstone shoulders the ally's wounds.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random, or both if they're Anointed.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and while an allied Wardstone stands, it takes half the damage they would.

changes.why: Was Mark of Heresy with a Sanctum-gated Isolate; now it spends a level to cast the target out for as long as the temple lasts.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn; while your Sanctum stands, they're also Isolated.

after.effect: Your Sanctum drops by 1. Target enemy is Isolated and Condemned for as long as your Sanctum stands, up to 3 turns.

changes.why: Was Earth Pillar with Wardstones added; now Holy's Sanctify pays out more the higher the Sanctum stands.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, if a Boulder or Wardstone damages the target, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn; it heals 5 more per level of your Sanctum.

changes.why: Was Verse of Nurturing plus a Sanctum rise; now it rebuilds a fallen Sanctum in one step.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice; then all allies heal 20, and your Sanctum rises by 1.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. If your Sanctum is down, it rises straight to level 2.

changes.why: Was Guardian Strike plus Vine Whirl's launch; now Holy's Condemn on the targets turns into Earth's Armor for the user.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a random other; if a Sanctified target is hit, all allies heal 5. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Each one hit that's Condemned gives the user 1 Armor for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Awakener's Roar plus a Sanctum rise; now it turns Earth's Boulders into anchors while cowing the enemy.

before.effect: Every allied Boulder and Wardstone heals to full and gains 1 Armor; your Sanctum rises by 1.

after.effect: Every allied Boulder is consecrated into a Wardstone, and all enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Rampart with a Sanctum-gated Immune in place of Anointed; now the stones give up HP to wall the user, putting the Sanctum's anchors at risk.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles theirs; with your Sanctum at 2 or more, they're also Immune for 1 turn.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, +10 per allied Boulder and Wardstone; each of those loses 10 HP.

changes.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus a Condemn on every Harmful skill; now a Wardstone draws the enemy's blows and Condemns them while it anchors the Sanctum.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time), who is Condemned each time they use a Harmful skill while Taunted.

after.effect: The user creates a Wardstone. Target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns and Condemned each time they hit it.

changes.why: Was Treant Form plus a Sanctum lock; now the user becomes the anchor, so the enemy must bring them down to end the Sanctum.

before.effect: Your Sanctum rises by 1. For 4 turns, it can't expire, and the user gains 1 Might per allied Seedling and 10 Shield per allied Boulder or Wardstone.

after.effect: Your Sanctum rises by 1. For 3 turns, the user counts as a Wardstone and gains 2 Armor and Immune.

changes.why: Was Worldfist with a dug Grave tacked on; now it alternates between digging and burying on its own, trading burst against the army's Graves.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per allied minion, and the user digs 1 Grave.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. The user spends 1 Grave, if they have one, for 10 more; with none, they dig 1 Grave instead.

changes.why: Was Worldquake with a Raise rider; now it sweeps the enemy's minions, whose deaths fill the user's Graves.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Raise: spend 1 Grave for a Skeleton. Costs 1 less per allied minion.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Every enemy minion falls into the rift for 20 damage.

changes.why: Was Rolling Crash with a Boulder that left extra Graves; now it cashes Graves in for tempo, competing with Raise for them.

before.effect: 10 damage, and creates a Headstone: a Boulder (45 HP) that leaves 2 Graves when it's destroyed.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends up to 2 Graves, and their next skill costs 1 less per Grave spent.

changes.why: Was Shale Guard plus Spiteful Retort's Horrify plus a dug Grave; now the counter raises a Skeleton the attacker must hit, whose death feeds a Grave.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage; its user is Horrified for 1 turn, and the user digs 1 Grave.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; a Skeleton claws up for the user, spending no Grave, and Taunts its user for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Nature's Wrath with Skeletons for Seedlings; now the lord grows stronger as the army falls, and every fallen minion also leaves a Grave.

before.effect: Raise: spend up to 3 Graves for as many Skeletons. The user gains Immune for 2 turns.

after.effect: Raise: spend up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons. For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might whenever one of their minions dies.

changes.why: Was Launch Stone plus Bone Shard; now any death on the board, often an Earth minion's, sets up Unholy's Soul Fragment drain.

before.effect: 10 damage, +5 per Soul Fragment the user has. Can instead launch an allied Boulder or Undead at a random enemy for its remaining HP.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If a unit or minion died since the user's last turn, the user also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

changes.why: Was Tunnelmaker with Undead as extra fuel; now any death on either side speeds it up, so a kill or a spent minion times the hit.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 60 damage to target enemy; a turn sooner if the user consumes a Boulder or Undead (which leaves a Grave).

after.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage to target enemy. If any unit or minion dies before then, it lands at the end of that turn instead.

changes.why: Was Boulder Trap with a Skeleton for the Boulder; now it punishes the enemy's kills and turns their victim into the user's soldier.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed and the user Raises a Skeleton instead, spending no Grave.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy kills a unit or minion, they're Stunned for 1 turn and the fallen rises for the user as a Skeleton, spending no Grave.

changes.why: Was Burrow with a dug Grave tacked on; now it spends Graves to come back armored, a trade against raising Undead.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn, and digs 1 Grave.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, they spend up to 2 Graves and rise with 15 Shield per Grave spent.

changes.why: Was Forest Stalker with Dig for Channel Earth, useless without a spender; now it digs and raises on its own, building an army over time.

before.effect: Summons a Ghoul Gravedigger (40 HP) permanently. Dig (r): +1 Grave. Gnaw (nc): 10 damage, and it heals 10.

after.effect: Summons a Ghoul Gravedigger (40 HP) permanently. Gnaw (nc): 10 damage, and it heals 10. Unearth (r): spends 2 Graves to Raise a Skeleton; with fewer, it digs 1 Grave.

changes.why: Was Fel Bolt plus Vine Lash's summon; now it reads the board and rewards casting right after a death.

before.effect: 25 damage, and Horrified for 2 turns. If the user has no minion, they Raise a Skeleton, spending no Grave.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. If a unit or minion died since the user's last turn, it's Piercing and they're Horrified for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Verdant Burst and Soul Blast with Undead swapped in, needing an existing army; now the Graves it spends become both burst damage and soldiers.

before.effect: Every allied Undead heals 10; then 25 damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Undead.

after.effect: Raise: spend up to 2 Graves for as many Skeletons, each bursting out under a random enemy for 15 damage. Then 20 damage to all enemies.

changes.why: Was Worldmarch turning minions into Ghouls, with no drain; now Unholy's drain feeds on Earth's minions, on both sides, and culls the weak ones into Graves.

before.effect: Every allied Seedling and Boulder becomes a Ghoul.

after.effect: Drains 10 HP from every minion on both sides; the user heals the total. Minions that die leave Graves as usual.

changes.why: Was Worldcaller with free Skeletons for Worldsprouts; now it's a damaging zone where every death, on either side, joins the user's army.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they Raise a Skeleton, spending no Grave.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies. Any unit or minion that dies while it channels rises for the user as a Skeleton.

changes.why: Was Stonepierce plus Blighted Dagger; now Graves buy an execution, and the kill gives one Grave back.

before.effect: 15 damage, or 25 against targets with Shield or Armor. At or above 70 HP, the target loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If that leaves them at 15 HP or less, the user spends 2 Graves, if they have them, to kill them.

changes.why: Was Stone Drill plus Lay Waste's Horrify; now Unholy's Horrify sets up Earth's armor-breaking, since a Horrified target can't rebuild it.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might; a target with Buffs is Horrified for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Stunned. A Horrified target loses all their Shield and Armor first.

changes.why: Was Pitfall with a free Skeleton; now the user's minions pile into the pit on whoever falls in.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and the user Raises a Skeleton.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn, and each allied minion deals them 10 damage.

changes.why: Was Earthwrap plus Horrify and bonus Graves; now every Grave spent buries the enemy a turn deeper.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and Horrified, and gains 15 Shield. If they die meanwhile, +2 Graves.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, plus 1 more turn for each Grave the user spends, up to 2.

changes.why: Was Landslide with a Grave for its Boulder; now it grows with the team's Graves and seeds its own, without spending them.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from this skill, they also dig 1 Grave.

after.effect: The user gains 5 Shield per Grave, up to 25. If they already had Shield from this skill, they dig 1 Grave first.

changes.why: Was Worldmute plus Horrify; now every death on the board deepens the curse, so kills and sacrifices tax the enemy.

before.effect: For each Might target ally has, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness and is Horrified for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns, and gains 1 more Confusion for each unit or minion that dies meanwhile.

changes.why: Was Soul Sickness plus bonus Graves on a kill; now it's a Sanctify-like mark whose healing grows with the Graves the user saves.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain a Soul Fragment; if the target dies this turn, +2 Graves.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them heals 5 per Grave the user has.

changes.why: Was Profane Chant with a Ghoul tacked on; now it's a team heal that swells after a bloody turn.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies and 2 Weakness for 1 turn. Raise: spend 2 Graves for a Ghoul.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield, and heal 10 more for each unit or minion that died since the user's last turn.

changes.why: Was Vine Whirl with Undead as ammunition; now its second hit seeks the weakest body, usually a minion, to finish it for a Grave.

before.effect: 5 damage to all enemies. If there's an allied Boulder or Undead, a random one is launched, as with Bone Toss.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to whichever other enemy or minion has the least HP.

changes.why: Was Awakener's Roar extended to Undead plus a Raise; now the toll grows heavier with the dead the user keeps, without spending them.

before.effect: Every allied Undead and Boulder heals to full and gains 1 Armor. Raise: spend 1 Grave for a Skeleton.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, or 3 if the user has 3 or more Graves.

changes.why: Was Rampart plus 5 Shield per Grave; now the broken wall stands back up as a soldier.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield, or doubles the Shield they have, +5 per Grave.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, a Skeleton rises from the bones for the user, spending no Grave.

changes.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Unrelenting Horror's Lifesteal; now the grudge literally outlives the user.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time); if they're Horrified, the user has Lifesteal while it lasts.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. If the user dies meanwhile, they rise as a Ghoul, spending no Grave, and the Taunt carries on to it.

changes.why: Was Treant Form with Undead and Graves swapped in; now Unholy's Immortal protects Earth's whole army while the lord stands.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might per allied Undead and 5 Shield per Grave, and is Immortal while there are 3 or more Graves.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and allied minions are Immortal.

changes.why: Was Worldfist plus 15 at Full; now it's the free hit for the off-beats, hiding at New and draining at Waning.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per allied minion. Full: 15 more.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. New: Stealthy. Waning: the user heals half the damage dealt.

changes.why: Was the base Smash with Stealthy and double-damage riders; now Earth's impact pays off Shadow's Blind and leaves ammunition behind.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. New: Stealthy. Full: double damage.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. It creates a Boulder for the user, and Blinded enemies hit are Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Long Shadow plus Rolling Crash's Boulder; now the phase decides whether the rush buys tempo or cover.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage, and creates a Boulder; the user's next skill is Stealthy too.

after.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Focus for their next skill. New: they gain Stealth instead of Focus.

changes.why: Was Mirage Blade with a Waning Weakness tacked on; now the dark of the moon turns one counter into a full wall, so the user times it.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, who gains 1 Focus. Waning: its user also gains 2 Weakness for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. New: it counters every Harmful skill used on them instead.

changes.why: Was Night of Knives with a Full upgrade; now its length depends on when the beast turns, trading a long hunt against an instant peak.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness. Full: 3 Might instead, and Immune.

after.effect: Until the next Full Moon ends, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness; during the Full Moon, 3 Might and Immune instead.

changes.why: Was Shadow Spine with a Full upgrade; now a Waxing cast plants damage that blooms on the Full Moon.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage. New: it strikes once more for each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep the target is. Full: 20 Piercing.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. Waxing: the shard stays lodged, dealing 15 more at the start of the next Full Moon.

changes.why: Was Dream Seeker with 20 more at Full; now it takes the phase it lands in, so the user aims it a turn ahead.

before.effect: On the following turn, 35 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable; it doesn't end Sleep. Full: 55.

after.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable. It uses the phase it lands in: Full, 20 more; Waning, the user heals half.

changes.why: Was Dream Chains plus Isolation; now Earth's Boulders and Seedlings become bait that springs Shadow's Sleep.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy doesn't use a skill, they take 15 Affliction, fall Asleep, and are Isolated.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill on a minion, they fall Asleep and are Isolated for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Shadowstep with Burrow's Invulnerable at New; now it skips a phase, pulling the Full Moon closer or past it.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn. New: Invulnerable too.

after.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and the Lunar Cycle advances one extra phase at the end of the turn.

changes.why: Was Spirit Raven with a Full damage bonus; now the wolf becomes a tank on schedule, drawing fire every Full Moon.

before.effect: Summons a Lunar Wolf (35 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 Piercing damage; Full: 25. Howl (r): target enemy is Taunted by the Wolf for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Lunar Wolf (35 HP) permanently. Moonfang (r): 10 Piercing damage. At the start of each Full Moon, it howls: it heals 20, and a random enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Blackbolt with Vine Lash's Seedling and a Full bonus; now full moonlight strips the enemy's hiding for the rest of the cycle.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns. Waxing: the user also creates a Seedling. Full: 30 damage.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns. Full: it also ends their Stealth, and they can't regain it until the next New Moon.

changes.why: Was Verdant Burst with Wave of Darkness's Confusion at Full; now it sets up a mass Sleep at Full or sustains at Waning.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 25 damage to all enemies. New: Stealthy. Full: each also gains 1 Confusion.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. Full: Blinded ones fall Asleep after the hit. Waning: the user heals 5 per enemy hit.

changes.why: Was Drink Darkness with a Waning heal; now it's a true drain that widens to the whole team on the drain phase.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. Waning: the user heals the total dealt.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user for the damage dealt. Waning: it drains every enemy instead.

changes.why: Was one Shade skill plus one Earth Armor skill; now Shadow's swarm hides Earth's minions from enemy skills.

before.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. Dust (r): target enemy is Blinded for 1 turn. Glow (r): target ally gains 1 Armor.

after.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. Dust (r): target enemy is Blinded for 1 turn. While a Moth lives, allied Boulders and Seedlings are Untargetable.

changes.why: Was Nightsong with Seedlings on Waxing; now its length follows the cycle, trading a long channel against a quick mass Sleep.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and a Seedling for the user on each Waxing turn; if it completes, every enemy falls Asleep.

after.effect: Channeled until the next New Moon: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns. If it lasts to the New Moon, every enemy falls Asleep.

changes.why: Was Backstab with a Full upgrade; now Earth's Boulders count as Shadow's cover for the backstab.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded. Full: always 25.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or has an allied Boulder to strike from behind.

changes.why: Was Ambush doubled at Full too; now the Full Moon lets the user ambush from Stealth without leaving it.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed or it's Full Moon.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user is Stealthed. Full: it doesn't end the user's Stealth.

changes.why: Was Pitfall exactly; now Shadow's Isolation lasts as long as an Earth Boulder survives, so the enemy must break it.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user creates a Boulder; the enemy is Isolated while it stands, for up to 3 turns.

changes.why: Was Sap with debuff riders at Full and Waning; now a Full Moon sleep can't be broken, opening a free turn of hits.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep. Full: 2 Confusion too. Waning: 2 Weakness for 2 turns too.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and Sleep. Full: damage doesn't wake them until the Full Moon ends.

changes.why: Was Hall of Phantoms with Shield at Waxing; now it's a different buff in every phase, so the user picks when to dance.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth; if already Stealthed, Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns. Waxing: 10 Shield as well.

after.effect: For 2 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and the phase's gift: New, Stealth; Waxing, 2 Armor; Full, 2 Might; Waning, 2 Renew.

changes.why: Was Grovetender plus Touch of Slumber at New; now the waxing moon grows the ally for the rest of the cycle.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 15. New: they heal 15 more and fall Asleep.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. Waxing: they also gain 10 max HP until the next New Moon.

changes.why: Was Nightwrap plus Earth's buffs at Waxing; now Shadow's Stealth builds Earth's Armor for as long as the ally stays hidden.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth. Waxing: also 1 Might and 1 Armor.

after.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; while Stealthed, they gain 1 permanent Armor at the end of each of their turns.

changes.why: Was Blinding Powder plus Worldmute; now Earth's minions become the walls that Shadow's Blind makes them stumble into.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns, and gains 1 Weakness for each Might that target ally has.

after.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns; each time their skill lands on a minion instead of their target, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Shadowbrand with 15 more at Full; now the New Moon, not the user's Stealth, frees the cooldown, and keeps them hidden.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown. Full: 25 damage.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. New: Stealthy, and it has no cooldown.

changes.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus Vine Whirl's Boulder launch; now it's a quiet two-target cut or a full sweep, by phase.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, or 20 at Full Moon. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other. New: Stealthy. Full: 10 to every other enemy instead.

changes.why: Was Hunter's Howl plus Awakener's Roar at Full; now the pack answers the Full Moon howl with an attack.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns (Intimidated instead if already Blinded). Full: every allied minion heals to full and gains 1 Armor.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Full: every allied minion also attacks a random enemy for 10.

changes.why: Was Veiled Guard with 10 Shield; now only Armor gained under the Full Moon lasts, so it's a timing choice.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, they gain Stealth and 10 Shield.

after.effect: The user gains 1 Armor until the next Full Moon ends. Full: it's permanent instead.

changes.why: Was Shadow Mockery with more HP and duration; now the decoy is Earth's Boulder, reusable as ammunition, and it covers the user's Stealth.

before.effect: Creates a Decoy (10 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns.

after.effect: Creates a Stone Double: a Boulder (20 HP) in the user's likeness. Target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, and the user gains Stealth.

changes.why: Was Faceless One with 3 Armor at Full; now it freezes the phase, so the team can hold a Full Moon or a New Moon for three turns.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor (3 if it's Full Moon), and all enemies are Taunted by them and Isolated.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 3 Armor and Immune, and the Lunar Cycle holds at its current phase.

changes.why: Was Fire's Torch Strike with Dragonfire for Ignite; now the claws grow with the hoard without spending it, the counterweight to Breath.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and Dragonfire.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 for every 2 Hoard the user has. Hoard isn't spent.

changes.why: Was Fire's Chain Detonation with 5 more damage; now the sweep breaks channels and sets the channelers alight.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Every target that was already Ignited Explodes.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Any of them who is channeling stops and gains Dragonfire.

changes.why: Was Fire's Blisterblade with Dragonfire and Hoard added; now the dragon takes a toll: the pricier the countered skill, the bigger the hoard.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user: its user gains Dragonfire and the user gains 2 Hoard.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters any Harmful skill used on the user, and the user gains 1 Hoard per energy each countered skill cost.

changes.why: Was Fire's Blazing Fury plus Might and Hoard; now a wounded wyrm hoards its wrath, a new Hoard source that rewards being hit.

before.effect: The user gains 3 Hoard, then Flameborn and 2 Might for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and 1 Hoard each time an enemy damages them.

changes.why: Was Fire's Flickerflare with Dragonfire for Ignite; now one skill with two modes: light them, then cash the burn in.

before.effect: 15 damage and Dragonfire. If the target was already Ignited, a random other enemy gains Dragonfire too.

after.effect: If target enemy is Ignited, 25 damage. Otherwise, 10 damage and Dragonfire.

changes.why: Was Fire's Heat Seeker with Dragonfire and Breath swapped in; now the dragon takes to the sky while it lines up the breath.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage and Dragonfire to target enemy, plus Breath.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. The user circles overhead, Untargetable until it lands. On the following turn, 35 damage to target enemy, plus Breath.

changes.why: Was Fire's Hidden Explosives lasting longer and adding Dragonfire; now the bait is their own Buff, which the dragon snatches for its hoard.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, they gain Dragonfire and Explode.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy gains a Buff, they lose it and gain Dragonfire, and the user gains 2 Hoard.

changes.why: Was Fire's Dragon Hatchling (a random burn each turn) with Dragonfire; now the Drake gathers Hoard from anyone's fires and fights with anti-heal claws.

before.effect: Summons a Drake (40 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns it gives a random enemy Dragonfire; Hoard from its burns goes to its summoner.

after.effect: Summons a Drake (40 HP) permanently. At the end of each of your turns, if any enemy is Ignited, it gives the user 1 Hoard. Drake Claw (r): 15 damage and Scorched for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Fire's Fireball with 5 more damage and a Dragonfire fallback; now it trades the team-wide Explosion for single-target burst that feeds Hoard.

before.effect: 25 damage. If the target is Ignited, they Explode; otherwise they gain Dragonfire.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Ignited, their Ignite deals its damage twice right now.

changes.why: Was Fire's Inferno with Dragonfire, damage and Breath added; now it's the payoff for fires already lit instead of another way to light them.

before.effect: 20 damage and Dragonfire to all enemies, plus Breath.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, plus Breath. Ignited enemies take 10 more.

changes.why: Was Fire's Feed the Fire with a different reward; now it eats every fire on their side at once, a burst that ends your own burns.

before.effect: 10 damage. If the target is Ignited, the Ignite is removed, and the user heals 20 and gains 3 Hoard.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Then every Ignite on the enemy side ends, and the user heals 10 and gains 1 Hoard for each.

changes.why: Was Fire's Searing Needle's burn bonus with Dragonfire; now the dragon covets what shines and bites whoever is Buffed.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against Dragonfire. The user gains 1 Hoard if the target is Ignited.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have a Buff, in which case the user also gains 1 Hoard.

changes.why: Was Fire's Heat Haze with Dragonfire and a counter; now it escalates: a burning target who takes the bait is Stunned.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Scorched for 2 turns and gain Dragonfire.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. If they're Ignited, they're also Stunned for 1 turn; otherwise they're Ignited.

changes.why: Mass-Exploded every Ignited enemy, the same as Take Wing; now the wings fan the flames from one enemy to the next over three turns.

before.effect: Every Ignited enemy Explodes. The user gains 1 Hoard per Explosion, and 1 Focus.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. At the end of each of their turns, if any enemy is Ignited, a random enemy that isn't is Ignited too.

changes.why: Was Fire's Flamethirst plus healing; now it's purely a trade of the dragon's scales (Hoard's Armor) for an ally's health.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains Flameborn for 2 turns. Spends up to 3 Hoard for 10 more healing each.

after.effect: Target ally heals 15, plus 10 for each Hoard the user spends, up to 3.

changes.why: Was Fire's Burning Blood plus Flameborn from another Fire skill; now it lends the dragon's fire to any ally's attacks.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Might and Flameborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 2 turns, target ally's damaging skills also Ignite their targets, or give Dragonfire to targets already Ignited.

changes.why: Was Fire's Searing Brand with 5 more damage and an upgrade to Dragonfire; now the team's hits stoke the target's burn.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the target was Ignited, their Ignite becomes Dragonfire and they gain 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally damages them, their Ignite deals its damage once more.

changes.why: Was Fire's Ring of Fire burn-on-attack with Dragonfire and Hoard; now it draws every burning enemy to the dragon at once.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, they gain Dragonfire and the user gains 1 Hoard.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy and every Ignited enemy for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Armor for each enemy Taunted, for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Ice's Glacial Hammer with Brittle for Frostbitten; now it turns Ice's lasting debuffs into Brittle stacks, trading control for a Shatter.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 1 Brittle.

after.effect: 20 damage and 1 Brittle to target enemy. Each of their other Frost debuffs crystallizes: it ends, and they gain 1 more Brittle for it.

changes.why: Was the base Smash with Brittle on everyone; now the splash comes from the target's Brittle: burst it now, or save it for a Shatter.

after.effect: 25 damage and 1 Brittle to target enemy. Then their Brittle bursts: it's removed, and each of their allies takes 10 damage per stack.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user's Buffs crystallize: each one ends and gives them 1 Brittle.

changes.why: Was the base Rage with Diamond for 1 Might; now it's a trade: burst-proof and strong, but nothing can mend the gem.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Diamond and 2 Might, but can't be healed.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they have a Buff, a random one ends; if not, they gain 1 Brittle.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and their Debuffs end. When it ends, a random enemy gains 1 Brittle for each Debuff removed.

changes.why: Was Ice's Icelance with Brittle for Numb; now the spike sets up a teammate: whoever spends the Mark cracks the target.

after.effect: 20 damage and a Mark for 1 turn. When the Mark is spent, the target also gains 2 Brittle.

changes.why: Was Ice's Blizzard with Brittle for Frostbitten; now it works across the enemy team, cracking the clean and hitting the cracked.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, every enemy without Brittle gains 1, and every enemy with Brittle takes 10 damage.

changes.why: Was the base Mislead with Brittle added; now it counters support instead, and pushes Ice's Numb (no giving Buffs) further.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Numb for 2 turns.

after.effect: 15 damage, then target enemy is encased: Stunned for 2 turns, with Diamond for as long as the Stun lasts.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each of their damaging skills also gives a random enemy 1 Brittle.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and gains Diamond for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the enemy who last damaged them is Numb for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target ally gains Diamond for 2 turns. When it ends, they heal half the damage it prevented, up to 30.

after.effect: For 2 turns, target enemy gains 1 Brittle each time they use a skill.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them become Frostborn for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to the other enemy with the most Brittle (a random one if none has any). Each gains 1 Brittle.

after.effect: Crest: 20 damage. Trough: 5 damage, and 1 Focus for the user's next skill.

after.effect: Summons a Kraken (40 HP) permanently. Tentacles (r): Crest: 15 damage. Trough: it grabs target enemy: their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

before.effect: Crest: 25 damage. Trough: 15 damage, and a random ally gains 3 Renew.

after.effect: Crest: 25 damage and a Mark for 1 turn. Trough: 15 damage and a Mark for 1 turn; whoever spends the Mark heals 15.

changes.why: Was a damage Crest and a Renew-and-Brimming Trough; now the Trough speeds up the whole team.

after.effect: Crest: 30 damage to all enemies. Trough: 15 damage to all enemies, and every ally's cooldowns drop by 1.

after.effect: Crest: 20 damage. Trough: 10 damage, and barnacles cling on: the target takes 5 damage at the end of each of their next 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time an ally damages them, every enemy takes 5 damage.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Signal Boost made team-wide; now the healing itself Resounds.

before.effect: All allies heal 15; then each Charged ally heals 10 more per Charge.

after.effect: All allies heal 20, and it echoes: they heal 10 more at the start of the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Arc widened to Sapped targets, plus Resound; now the second hit is the echo, a turn later.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and to every Marked or Sapped enemy. Resound.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy. Resound, but the echo forks to a random other enemy instead, at full strength.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Crackle with Deafened added; now the roar also breaks concentration.

before.effect: All enemies are Deafened for 1 turn and Sapped.

after.effect: All enemies are Deafened for 2 turns, and any of them channeling a skill stops.

changes.why: Was Lightning's Lightning Cage lasting a turn longer; now what hits the Shield rings back at the attacker.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield plus 10 per Charge for 2 turns, and gains 1 Charge whenever it takes damage.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Damage it absorbs echoes back: at the start of the user's next turn, each attacker takes half of what they dealt to it.

changes.why: Was the base Taunt plus Lightning's Aggro Signal reflect; now every forced attack rings back at the attacker, twice.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. The first Harmful skill they use on the user is Reflected.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; each time they damage the user, they take 10 damage that Resounds.

changes.why: Was Wind's Launch with Aloft for Rushing; now it rises, then dives on the second use.

before.effect: The user gains Aloft for 2 turns, and 1 Focus for their next skill.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gains Aloft for 2 turns. If they were already Aloft, they dive instead: the target's non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Wind's Chainbreaker lasting a turn longer, plus Aloft; now Debuffs can't stay on the user past a turn.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes all Debuffs from the user; for 3 turns they're Aloft and Immune.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Aloft and gains 1 Might, and any Debuff applied to them drifts off at the start of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Wind's Elegant Sweep with an Aloft bonus; now the squall hits hardest on whoever attacked while it gathered.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to all enemies, or 40 if the user is Aloft.

after.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 30 Piercing damage to every enemy who used a Harmful skill in the meantime, and 15 to the rest.

changes.why: Was Wind's Float Noose with its damage Drifting; now it stores up a storm the target builds themselves.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they're Isolated for 1 turn and 15 damage Drifts onto them.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each skill target enemy uses gathers a cloud over them. When it ends, 15 damage per cloud Drifts onto them.

changes.why: Was Wind's Bound with Aloft for Leaping; now it's the cleanse Wind keeps in Chainbreaker, on a dodge.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains Aloft for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and all their Debuffs evaporate.

changes.why: Was Wind's Grand Eagle with Aloft for Leap; now a slow sky beast whose rain and dives land a turn later.

before.effect: Summons a Sky Whale (50 HP) permanently. Carry (A): target ally gains Aloft for 2 turns. Rain Down (r): Drift, 20 damage.

after.effect: Summons a Sky Whale (50 HP) permanently. Rain Down (r): Drift; when it lands, all allies heal 10. Breach (A): Drift; when it lands, 20 damage to all enemies.

changes.why: Was Wind's Compressed Bolt with its damage Drifting; now it picks its target when it lands, hunting the weakest.

before.effect: Drift. 30 damage when it lands; if the target is Immobile, their non-Strategic skills are also stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: Drift. When it lands, 30 damage to the enemy with the least HP, and a Mark on them for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Wind's Sap Speed plus Shield removal; now a drain that returns for more a turn later.

before.effect: 5 damage. Removes the target's mobility buffs and Shield; the user gains 1 Swiftness per buff removed.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals as much. Drift: when it lands, it drains them again for 15.

changes.why: Was Wind's Wind Sprites with Drift; now killing them rains healing on your team.

before.effect: Summons 2 Cloudlings (10 HP) for 3 turns. Drizzle (nc): Drift, 10 damage.

after.effect: Summons 2 Cloudlings (10 HP) for 3 turns. Drizzle (nc): Drift, 10 damage. When a Cloudling dies, it breaks into rain: all allies heal 10.

changes.why: Was Wind's Vortex with Aloft on the user; now the whole team rides the clouds while it lasts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; the user is Aloft while channeling.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies. While it lasts, every ally is Aloft.

changes.why: Was Wind's Airknife with Aloft for Rushing; now it Drifts, giving the team a turn to pin the target down.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 if the user is Aloft or Leaping.

after.effect: Drift. When it lands, 15 damage, or 30 if the target is Immobile by then.

changes.why: Was Wind's Top Speed with Aloft for Rushing; now it grounds a random enemy each turn.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user is Aloft and Ghosted; now, 1 Focus and 2 Swiftness.

after.effect: For 4 turns, the user is Aloft and gains 1 Focus. At the start of each of their turns, a random enemy loses their mobility buffs.

changes.why: Was Wind's Swiftwind with Aloft; now it frees an ally from Taunts.

before.effect: Target ally gains Aloft for 3 turns and 1 Swiftness.

after.effect: Target ally gains Aloft for 2 turns, above the fray: any Taunt on them ends, and they can't be Taunted while Aloft.

changes.why: Was Wind's Headwind plus a lockout; now it grounds a target, then becalms them on the next use.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs, gains 1 Weakness, and can't gain mobility buffs for 2 turns.

after.effect: If target enemy is Immobile, they gain 2 Confusion for 2 turns; otherwise they lose all mobility buffs.

changes.why: Was Wind's Feathermark with Aloft for Leap; now the team's hits cleanse them.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target gain Aloft for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them loses a Debuff.

changes.why: Was Wind's Falling Slam with 5 more damage and Aloft; now the second hit Drifts in a turn later.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Costs 1 less while the user is Aloft.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy now. Drift: 20 damage to a random other enemy when it lands.

changes.why: Was Wind's Slipstream with Aloft for Rushing; now breaking the Shield hides the user.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, or 35 if they're Aloft.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. If it breaks, they vanish into the cloud: Untargetable for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Wind's Piercing Cry plus a mobility lockout; now every attack they make returns to them a turn later.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 1 turn, or 3 turns if they're Immobile; they can't gain mobility buffs while Taunted.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each skill they use while Taunted Drifts 10 damage back onto them.

changes.why: Was Wind's Djinnform with Aloft for the Leap; now the titan answers every attacker a turn later.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 20 Shield, Immune and Aloft.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and Aloft; at the end of each of their turns, 15 damage Drifts onto the enemy who last damaged them.

changes.why: Was Viper Strike with more Toxin and damage per stage; now it evolves from applying Toxin to cashing it in, then resets.

before.effect: I: 20 damage and 1 Toxin. II: 2 Toxin. III: 25 damage, and Prey targets also gain 1 Vulnerable.

after.effect: I: 20 damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy. II: 20 damage, and their Toxin ticks once now. III: 25 damage, and their Toxin ticks twice now; then this returns to Stage I.

changes.why: Was Plague Stomp adding Toxin and splash back per stage; now it grows into a contagion that copies the target's Toxin onto their team.

before.effect: I: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin. II: the target gains 1 Toxin too. III: their allies also take 15 damage.

after.effect: I: 25 damage to target enemy; their allies gain 1 Toxin. II: they gain as much as the target has, at least 1. III: the target takes 5 more per Toxin on their allies.

changes.why: Was Lunge handing out its Prey one stage at a time; now charging into existing Prey pays Focus before it spreads Prey.

before.effect: I: 10 damage; the target is Prey through the user's next turn. II: every enemy is. III: the user also gains 1 Focus for their next skill.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus for their next skill per enemy already Prey (max 2); then every enemy counts as Prey through the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was a Might buff that only grew in numbers; now it evolves Viper Stance from a blunt conversion into stealing the enemy's Might.

before.effect: I: for 2 turns, the user gains 1 Might and deals 10 more to Prey. II: 2 Might. III: lasts 3 turns.

after.effect: I: all Might in the battle turns into Weakness. II: the user's own is spared, and they gain Immune for 2 turns. III: they also gain 1 Might per stack converted, for 3 turns.

changes.why: Was Sting adding a second and third status per stage; now the venom adapts to what the target lacks and Marks fresh Prey.

before.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable, at random. II: two of the three. III: all three.

after.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin, Weakness or Vulnerable, at random. II: it picks one the target doesn't have. III: if that makes them Prey, they're also Marked.

changes.why: Was Banewood Javelin with 10 more damage per stage; now it learns to strike Prey instantly, then to volley every Prey enemy.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, I: 25 Affliction. II: 35. III: 45, and 2 Toxin.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. I: 25 Affliction damage to target enemy on the following turn. II: against Prey, it lands at once. III: it also hits every other Prey enemy.

changes.why: Was Snake Pit with wider triggers and more Toxin; now it hatches for delayed damage and at III punishes an enemy who plays around it.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. I: each time target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin. II: any skill. III: 2 Toxin each time.

after.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. I: whenever target enemy uses a Strategic skill, they gain 1 Toxin. II: when it ends, they take 10 Affliction per trigger. III: if it never triggered, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Slither plus a cleanse and Swiftness; now the shed skin carries the user's Toxin, then all their Debuffs, back to whoever hurt them.

before.effect: Unstunnable. I: the user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus. II: also removes their Debuffs. III: also 1 Swiftness.

after.effect: Unstunnable. I: the user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 Focus. II: their Toxin moves to the last enemy who damaged them. III: all their Debuffs do.

changes.why: Was Serpent Fang with bigger numbers per stage (and a Bite name other kits use); now the Spawn itself grows, then its Mandibles hunt every Prey enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Mutant Spawn (25 HP) permanently; its skill Evolves too. Bite (r): I: 5 Piercing and 1 Toxin. II: 10 Piercing. III: 2 Toxin.

after.effect: Summons a Mutant Spawn (25 HP) permanently. Mandibles (r, Evolves): I: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. II: the Spawn grows to 40 HP, healed to full. III: Mandibles hits every Prey enemy.

changes.why: Was Acid Orb's Prey riders returned one per stage; now the acid eats Armor into Vulnerable, then Shield into Toxin.

before.effect: I: 20 damage; Prey targets are Marked. II: they also gain 1 Vulnerable. III: 25 damage, and every target counts as Prey.

after.effect: I: 20 damage to target enemy; 1 of their Armor turns into Vulnerable. II: all of it does. III: their Shield dissolves too, giving 1 Toxin per 10 removed.

changes.why: Was Acid Wash with Toxin and damage added; now the cloud learns to seep past Armor and Shield, then scars Prey for good.

before.effect: I: 15 damage and 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns to all enemies. II: each also gains 1 Toxin. III: 25 damage.

after.effect: I: 15 damage and 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns to all enemies. II: its damage becomes Affliction. III: 20 Affliction, and Prey enemies keep the Vulnerable permanently.

changes.why: Was Devour with its threshold raised per stage; now the threshold reads how debilitated the target is.

before.effect: I: executes target enemy below 15 HP (doubled for minions). II: below 20. III: below 25, and the user heals 15 on an execution.

after.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, +5 per stack of Toxin, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion they have. The threshold is doubled for minions.

changes.why: Was Spriggan Harasser with one more minion per stage; now killing a Larva poisons its killer, and at III they stay for good.

before.effect: Summons Larvae (15 HP) for 3 turns: I: 1. II: 2. III: 3. Nibble (W): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin.

after.effect: Summons 2 Larvae (15 HP). Nibble (W): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. I: they last 3 turns. II: whoever kills a Larva gains 2 Toxin. III: they no longer expire.

changes.why: Was Nine Plagues whose stages only added Toxin; now the strain seeks out healthy enemies, then weakens the Prey it made.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns: 5 Affliction to all enemies each turn, and a random enemy gains 1 Toxin. It Evolves each turn it's channeled: II: 2 Toxin. III: every enemy gains 1.

after.effect: Channeled, up to 6 turns; Evolves each turn. I: 5 Affliction to all enemies and 1 Toxin to a random one. II: the Toxin goes to a non-Prey enemy. III: Prey enemies gain 1 Weakness.

changes.why: Was Pounce with more damage per stage; now it evolves from an energy thief into a finisher that executes Prey.

before.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage; against Prey, you gain 1 random energy. II: 10 Piercing. III: 15 Piercing, and the target counts as Prey.

after.effect: I: 5 Piercing damage; against Prey, the user gains 1 random energy. II: 15 Piercing against targets at or below 40 HP. III: it executes Prey below 15 HP.

changes.why: Was Envenom with more Toxin per stage; now it evolves into doubling existing Toxin, which does nothing to a clean target.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. I: 1 Toxin against Prey. II: 2 Toxin. III: 3 Toxin, against anyone.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable. I: Prey targets gain 2 Toxin. II: a Stunned target's Toxin doubles instead. III: every target's Toxin doubles instead.

changes.why: Was Numbing Needle's statuses returned one per stage; now it punishes costly skills, and at III becomes a visible warning to the whole team.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. I: they gain 1 Toxin. II: and 1 Weakness. III: and 1 Vulnerable and 1 Confusion.

after.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. I: if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they gain 1 Toxin. II: 1 Toxin per energy it cost. III: it's visible, and any enemy's Harmful skill triggers it.

changes.why: Was Lacerate plus Toxin and a shorter cooldown; now the paralysis makes its victim Prey, then spreads to a Prey ally.

before.effect: I: a 1-turn Stun, or 2 turns against Prey. II: also 1 Toxin. III: cooldown drops to 2.

after.effect: I: target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if Prey. II: they count as Prey while Stunned. III: when it ends, a random Prey ally of theirs is Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Poison's three stance conversions in one, strictly better; now a mobility buff that runs on Prey and pins Prey down.

before.effect: Every enemy's Might, Armor and Focus turn into as many Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion. (Poison's three stances in one.)

after.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus if any enemy is Prey. Prey enemies can't gain Swiftness.

changes.why: Was a heal that grew by 10 per stage; now it evolves into a cure that scales with the Toxin removed, then regrows next turn.

before.effect: I: target ally heals 20. II: 30. III: 30, and removes all their Toxin.

after.effect: I: target ally heals 20. II: they lose their Toxin and heal 10 more per stack removed. III: the same healing repeats at the start of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Viper's Crest with Armor and a Toxin ward added per stage; now it runs Poison's conversions backwards, turning an ally's Debuffs into Buffs.

before.effect: I: target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns. II: also 1 Armor. III: also can't gain Toxin for 3 turns.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns, and their Weakness and Vulnerable turn into as many Might and Armor.

changes.why: Was Swamp Toxins with more stacks per stage; now the fever feeds on every skill they push through the Confusion.

before.effect: I: target enemy gains 1 Confusion and 1 Toxin. II: 2 Toxin. III: 2 Confusion and 2 Toxin.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Each skill they use while Confused gives them 1 more Toxin.

changes.why: Was Preymark with longer Prey and more damage per stage; now it only evolves when teammates follow up on the mark.

before.effect: I: 15 damage; the target is Prey for 1 turn. II: 2 turns. III: 20 damage, and allies who damage them gain 1 Might.

after.effect: Evolves each time it triggers, not on use. I: 15 damage to target enemy; for 1 turn, allies who damage them give them 1 Vulnerable. II: 1 Toxin too. III: it lasts 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Serpentsong with bigger numbers per stage; now allies feed on the enemy's Toxin, then hand their own Toxin over.

before.effect: I: all allies gain 2 Renew and all enemies 1 Toxin. II: 3 Renew and 2 Toxin. III: allies also heal 15.

after.effect: I: all allies gain 2 Renew and all enemies 1 Toxin. II: for 2 turns, each enemy Toxin tick heals a random ally 5. III: first, allies' Toxin moves onto random enemies.

changes.why: Was Tail Lash with 5 more damage and Toxin; now a use that finds no Prey sets up its own next reset.

before.effect: I: 15 damage to all enemies; its cooldown resets if it hits Prey. II: 20 damage. III: Prey hit also gain 1 Toxin.

after.effect: I: 15 damage to all enemies; if it hits Prey, its cooldown resets. II: if it hits none, the enemy with the most Toxin becomes Prey for 1 turn. III: Prey take 10 more.

changes.why: Was Bad Stomach whose self-Toxin simply went away at II; now the user's own poison sets the dose, and new Prey are Intimidated.

before.effect: I: all enemies gain 1 Toxin, and so does the user. II: the user no longer does. III: enemies also gain 1 Weakness.

after.effect: The user gains 1 Toxin; then every enemy gains as much Toxin as the user has (max 3). Enemies this makes Prey are Intimidated for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Coil with Shield and Armor raised per stage; now the shell is spined and poisons whoever hits it.

before.effect: I: 10 Shield and 1 Armor. II: 15 Shield. III: 20 Shield and 2 Armor.

after.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and 1 Armor for 2 turns. Each time an enemy damages the Shield, they gain 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with longer duration and Toxin; now the hood lulls an enemy who won't strike into Sleep.

before.effect: I: target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 2 turns. II: 3 turns. III: they also gain 1 Toxin each turn they're Taunted.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 2 turns. If they don't damage the user during it, they fall Asleep when it ends.

changes.why: Was a Might and Armor form that grew in numbers; now the mutation first poisons the user, then turns outward, then leaves permanent scales.

before.effect: I: for 3 turns, 1 Might and 1 Armor. II: 2 of each. III: also Immune.

after.effect: I: for 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and 1 Might, but 1 Toxin each turn. II: a random enemy gains that Toxin instead. III: when it ends, they keep 1 Armor for good.

changes.why: Was Worldfist with a Treant bonus; now it trades minion scaling for the user's own growth.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, +5 per allied minion (+10 per Treant).

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, +5 per 10 max HP the user has gained from Flourish.

changes.why: Was Worldquake with more damage and a Seedling heal; now it tears up the user's own Seedlings, spending their HP to hurry their Bloom.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Costs 1 less per allied minion. Each allied Seedling heals 10.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Costs 1 less per allied minion. Each allied Seedling that hasn't Bloomed takes 5 damage and Blooms a turn sooner.

changes.why: Was Rolling Crash with a Seedling in place of the Boulder; now the Seedling is cover, so shielding the user and living to Bloom pull against each other.

before.effect: 15 damage, and the user creates a Seedling.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a Seedling that takes the next single-target Harmful skill aimed at the user.

changes.why: Was Shale Guard with 5 more damage and a Seedling; now the counter guards the whole garden, not just the user.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 15 Piercing damage to its user and creating a Seedling for the user.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user or one of their minions, dealing 15 Piercing damage to its user.

changes.why: Was Nature's Wrath with an instant Bloom; now the Seedlings must survive to Bloom, and each that does gives the user permanent Might.

before.effect: The user creates 2 Seedlings, and every allied Seedling Blooms at the end of this turn. The user gains Immune for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user creates 2 Seedlings and is Immune for 3 turns. Each allied Seedling that Blooms during it gives the user 1 Might for good.

changes.why: Was Launch Stone without the Boulder plus Vine Lash's Seedling; now Treants are the ammunition, and a thrown one lands as a Seedling that can Bloom again.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the user has no Seedling, they create one.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Treant: it's flung at a random enemy for damage equal to its HP, and lands as a fresh Seedling.

changes.why: Was Tunnelmaker with Flourish healing in place of the Boulder; now the two-turn wait asks the team to keep its minions alive for the payoff.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 55 damage to target enemy; the user then heals by half the damage dealt, which can Flourish.

after.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy, +10 per allied minion still alive when it lands.

changes.why: Was Boulder Trap making Seedlings instead of Boulders; now every skill the target uses tightens the roots, until the garden grows from them.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, it's destroyed and the user creates a Seedling instead. The target is also Immobile.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each skill target enemy uses tightens the roots: 1 Weakness for 2 turns (max 3). At 3, a Seedling sprouts for the user.

changes.why: Was Burrow with Flourish healing in place of Ghosted; now it leaves a Boulder the enemy must break to deny the user Armor.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and heals 20, which can Flourish.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and creates a Boulder. If the Boulder still stands at the start of their next turn, they gain 2 Armor for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Forest Stalker with a healing skill swapped in, and Blooming would have shrunk it; now it starts fragile and becomes a healer only if protected until it Blooms.

before.effect: Summons a Grove Warden (50 HP, counts as a Seedling) permanently. At the end of each of your turns it heals your most injured ally 10, which can Flourish.

after.effect: Summons a Grove Warden (15 HP, a Seedling) permanently. Once it Blooms, at the end of each of your turns it heals your most injured ally 10, which can Flourish.

changes.why: Was Vine Lash that could also force a Bloom; now its Seedling punishes whoever tries to weed it out.

before.effect: 25 damage. The user creates a Seedling; if they already had 2, one of them Blooms now instead.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and the user creates a thorned Seedling: an enemy who damages it before it Blooms takes 15 Piercing damage.

changes.why: Was Verdant Burst plus a team heal; now wounded enemies seed the user's garden, so it pays to time it late.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then 25 damage to all enemies; every ally heals 10, which can Flourish.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. The user creates a Seedling for each enemy left below 50 HP (max 2).

changes.why: Was Sprout Seedling word for word; now the pair is linked, so killing one Seedling grows the other into a Treant.

before.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP). Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

after.effect: Creates 2 Seedlings (15 HP). Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor. If one dies before Blooming, the other Blooms at once.

changes.why: Was Worldcaller making Seedlings instead of Worldsprouts; now it grows the minions the user already has past their max HP.

before.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, they create a Seedling; Seedlings created this way Bloom a turn sooner.

after.effect: Channeled, 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, every allied minion heals 15, which can Flourish; if the user has no minion, they create a Seedling.

changes.why: Was Stonepierce plus an Armor rider; now the brambles catch enemies who have just been healed.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets with Shield or Armor; the user gains 1 Armor if it hits either.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they were healed since the user's last turn.

changes.why: Was Stone Drill word for word; now it drinks max HP from a Stunned target to grow the user.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, +20 if the user has 3 or more total Armor and Might.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Against a Stunned target, 10 of their max HP moves to the user, counting toward the user's Flourish limit.

changes.why: Was Pitfall plus a Seedling; now the snare hardens the user in proportion to the skill it caught.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn, and the user creates a Seedling.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn; the user gains 1 Armor per energy it cost, for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Earthwrap plus a Seedling heal; now the enemy's vine Shield is stored growth, so breaking it or leaving it is a real choice.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 20 Shield; each allied Seedling heals 10.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 2 turns and gains 25 Shield. When the Stun ends, the user heals whatever Shield is left, which can Flourish.

changes.why: Was Landslide's shape with healing and a Seedling in place of Shield and a Boulder; now a mobility buff that turns growth into Swiftness.

before.effect: The user heals 15, which can Flourish. If they're already above their starting max HP, they also create a Seedling.

after.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they heal 10, which can Flourish, and gain 1 Swiftness if they're above their starting max HP.

changes.why: Was Grovetender with 10 more healing; now overhealing a healthy ally plants a Seedling, so topping up the full is a real option.

before.effect: Channel Growth, then target ally heals 25, which can Flourish.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20, which can Flourish. If any of it Flourishes, the user creates a Seedling.

changes.why: Was Infuse Earth plus a heal; now it rewards blessing an ally who has already grown.

before.effect: Target ally heals 10, which can Flourish, and gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random, or both if they're above their starting max HP.

changes.why: Was Worldmute counting minions instead of Might; now the vines keep tightening for as long as the user's garden survives.

before.effect: For each allied minion, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness for 2 turns.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Weakness, and 1 more at the start of each of their next 2 turns while the user has a Seedling.

changes.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with Flourish added; now the user's Seedlings harden the whole team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice, then all allies heal 25, which can Flourish, and gain 2 Renew.

after.effect: Channel Growth twice, then all allies heal 20 and gain 1 Armor for 2 turns per allied Seedling (max 3).

changes.why: Was Vine Whirl with Treant scaling in place of the Boulder launch; now it clears enemy minions and replants them as the user's own.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, +5 per allied Treant.

after.effect: 10 damage to all enemies, doubled against minions. Each enemy minion it kills becomes a Seedling for the user.

changes.why: Was Ancient Grudge plus Seedlings; now the garden holds the enemy's attention, and a Seedling that weathers it Blooms.

before.effect: Permanently Taunts one enemy (only one at a time). While they're Taunted, each of their Harmful skills gives the user a Seedling.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns by the user's healthiest minion, or by the user if they have none. A Seedling that survives it Blooms when it ends.

changes.why: Was Treant Form counting Treants for Armor instead of Boulders for Shield; now the user shelters the grove so its Seedlings can Bloom.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user counts as a Treant: 1 Might per allied Seedling and 1 Armor per allied Treant; every heal on them can Flourish.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune and 1 Armor per allied minion, and allied minions are Untargetable.

changes.why: Was Righteous Blow's Anointed bonus applied to either side; now alternating sides is what empowers it, and alternating Anoints the user.

before.effect: Enemy: 20 damage. Ally: heals 20. If the user is Anointed, 10 more either way.

after.effect: Enemy: 20 damage. Ally: heals 20. If its last use was on the other side, 10 more, and the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Divine Storm mirrored with 5 more damage; now the splash Condemns the enemy team or Shields the allied one.

before.effect: Enemy: 25 damage to them and 10 to their allies. Ally: heals 25, and their allies 10. The user heals 5 per unit hit.

after.effect: Enemy: 25 damage, and their allies are Condemned. Ally: heals 25, and their allies gain 10 Shield.

changes.why: Was Zealous Rush plus a mirrored heal; now each side's use discounts the user's next move on the other side.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage, and the user's next Harmful skill Sanctifies for 1 turn. Ally: heals 15 and gains 1 Focus for their next skill.

after.effect: Enemy: 15 damage, and the user's next Helpful skill costs 1 less. Ally: heals 15, and the user's next Harmful skill costs 1 less.

changes.why: Was Retribution plus Condemn; now it's a true counter whose stopped damage becomes healing for the neediest ally.

before.effect: For 1 turn, Harmful skills used on the user heal them instead of damaging them, and their users are Condemned.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, and the ally with the least HP heals the damage it would have dealt.

changes.why: Was Divine Fury with Exalted in place of Anointed; now every skill the user has reaches both sides, so it works without other Radiant skills.

before.effect: The user becomes Exalted for 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Exalted. Each time they damage an enemy, the ally with the least HP heals 10; each time they heal an ally, a random enemy takes 10.

changes.why: Was Sunbeam's Anointed heal mirrored to either side; now each side leaves a short-lived mark that pays off for teammates.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage. Ally: heals 15. Consumes the user's Anointed for 15 more either way.

after.effect: Enemy: 15 damage; until the user's next turn, allies who damage them heal 5. Ally: heals 15; until then, enemies who damage them are Condemned.

changes.why: Was Decree plus a Sanctify; now an invisible edict against the enemy's healing and buffs.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; the first time it triggers, they're also Sanctified for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Condemned.

changes.why: Was Cloister, since Exalted already counts as Anointed; now it always grants Invulnerable and trades Anointed for Exalted.

before.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn, and Invulnerable too if they're Anointed or Exalted.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they're Anointed, it's spent, and they're Exalted until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Holy Nova with a side choice added; now the Anointed repeat flips sides, so one cast both smites and heals.

before.effect: Choose a side. Enemies: 25 Piercing damage each. Allies: each heals 25. If the user is Anointed, it repeats on the same side at the start of their next turn.

after.effect: Choose a side: enemies take 25 Piercing damage, or allies heal 25. If the user is Anointed, it strikes again at the start of their next turn, on the other side.

changes.why: Was Ascension with Exalted in place of permanent Anointed; now it sets up its own Sanctify, so the second use pays off.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user becomes Exalted for 2 turns.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy; the user heals 10. If they're Sanctified, it's spent and the user is Exalted for 2 turns; otherwise they're Sanctified for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Divine Blessing granting Exalted instead of Anointed, with Vengeance's Herald name; now its one proclamation can bless an ally or Condemn an enemy.

before.effect: Summons a Herald (15 HP) for 3 turns. Proclaim (W): target ally is Exalted until the end of their next turn; then the Herald dies.

after.effect: Summons a Harbinger (15 HP) for 3 turns. Proclaim (W, Radiant): Ally: Anointed until the end of their next turn. Enemy: Condemned for 2 turns. Either way, the Harbinger then dies.

changes.why: Was Consecration plus a random heal; now the healing grows with how many enemies the light has marked.

before.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy who isn't Sanctified takes 10 damage and is Sanctified, and a random ally heals 10.

after.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy who isn't Sanctified takes 10 damage and is Sanctified; then every ally heals 5 per Sanctified enemy.

changes.why: Was Piercing Light mirrored to either side; now both sides compare against the user's own HP, levelling the scales.

before.effect: Enemy: 10 damage, 20 if they're Condemned or Sanctified. Ally: heals 10, 20 if they have a Debuff. The bonus always applies if the user is Anointed.

after.effect: Enemy: 10 damage, or 20 if they have more HP than the user. Ally: heals 10, or 20 if they have less HP than the user.

changes.why: Was Crusade plus 15 against Condemned; now cashing a Condemn in for damage means giving up its penalty.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Targets above 75 HP are Condemned; targets already Condemned take 15 more.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Against a Condemned target, it ends the Condemn without triggering it and deals double.

changes.why: Was Martyrdom's Anointing spread to every ally; now Radiant lets it guard an ally instead of watching an enemy.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and every ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. Enemy: if they use a Harmful skill, it's countered. Ally: the first Harmful skill used on them is countered. Either way, the countered skill's user is Condemned.

changes.why: Was Angel's Grace with Exalted in place of Ghosted; now a sanctuary that trades the user's offense for doubled healing.

before.effect: For 2 turns, the user is Exalted, Invulnerable and Immune.

after.effect: For 2 turns, the user is Invulnerable and Immune and their healing is doubled, but they can only use Helpful skills.

changes.why: Was Holy Favor granting Exalted instead of Anointed; now Radiant lets it bless an ally or strip an enemy's blessing.

before.effect: Target ally is Exalted until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: Ally: Anointed until the end of their next turn, and 1 Might for 3 turns. Enemy: they lose Anointed and Exalted, and are Condemned.

changes.why: Was Mark of Heresy plus stripping Anointed; now Radiant turns it around into a cure for Holy's own penalties.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified for 2 turns, and loses Anointed and Exalted.

after.effect: Enemy: Condemned and Sanctified for 2 turns. Ally: loses their Condemn, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion.

changes.why: Was Karmic Marking mirrored onto allies; now its Sanctify always feeds whoever needs healing most.

before.effect: Enemy: 15 damage, and Sanctified for 2 turns if the user is Anointed. Ally: heals 15, and Anointed until the end of their next turn if the user is.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and they're Sanctified for 2 turns. Its healing goes to the ally with the least HP instead of the damager.

changes.why: Was Saving Grace with a side choice; now wasted healing crosses over as damage, so it smites harder the healthier the team is.

before.effect: Choose a side. Allies: heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Enemies: 15 damage and Condemned. If the user is Anointed, it repeats on that side at the start of their next two turns.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Healing past an ally's max HP instead deals that much damage to a random enemy.

changes.why: Was Excoriate with a longer Condemn and damage; now it judges whoever acted against the team last turn.

before.effect: Bypass. Every Sanctified enemy is Condemned for 2 turns, and every Condemned enemy takes 15 damage.

after.effect: Bypass. Every enemy who used a Harmful skill since the user's last turn is Condemned for 2 turns; Sanctified ones are also Intimidated for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Shield of Faith with 10 more Shield; now breaking it Sanctifies the attacker, so the team heals by striking back.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield. If they're Anointed or Exalted, 10 more and Immune for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, the enemy who broke it is Sanctified for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Gleam plus a heal; now Radiant lets the user make any ally the beacon the enemy must attack.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill; when they do, the user heals 15.

after.effect: Enemy: Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill. Ally: every enemy is Taunted by that ally for 1 turn, and the ally gains 20 Shield.

changes.why: Was Grand Crusader plus a heal and an Exalted doubling; now the form turns every Condemn the user lands into an ally's Anointing.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies and 10 healing to all allies. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Armor per Sanctified or Condemned enemy, doubled if Exalted.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Exalted and gains 2 Armor. Whenever they Condemn an enemy, a random ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Witchblade's Horrify bonus with Unhallowed tacked on; now it punishes an enemy who was just healed by turning their next heals against them.
