changes.why: Was Unholy's Soul Sickness with Hemorrhage added; now the mark lets allies feed on the target's bleeding, healing more as it grows.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Hemorrhage. For 1 turn, any ally who damages the target gains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Hemorrhage. For 2 turns, allies who damage them heal 5 per Hemorrhage stack they have.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Profane Chant with Hemorrhage, Renew and Blood Price added; now it heals the team and lets the user pay their allies' random costs in blood for a turn.

before.effect: Blood Price. 20 damage and 1 Hemorrhage to all enemies; all allies gain 2 Renew.

after.effect: Blood Price. All allies heal 20. Until the user's next turn, their allies' random costs are paid with the user's HP instead, 10 each.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Oathbreaker Strike plus Water's Renew; now Water's Weakness and Confusion open its targets to an Unholy leech.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 to them and to each of the user's allies; allies hit gain 2 Renew.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The user heals for the damage dealt to any that have Weakness or Confusion.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Soulshriek with Hemorrhage in place of Horrify; now it restores Shout's Intimidate, and Unholy's Horrify marks which enemies start to bleed.

before.effect: 20 damage. If the user has a Soul Fragment, they spend it for 10 more damage and 2 Hemorrhage.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Horrified ones also gain 2 Hemorrhage.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Misery with twice the payoff and Blood Price; now the blood is a loan the user repays as Water's Renew.

before.effect: Blood Price. The user drains 10 HP from each other ally, and gains 20 Shield plus twice the amount drained.

after.effect: The user drains 10 HP from each other ally and gains 20 Shield plus the total. At the end of the user's next turn, each of those allies gains 3 Renew.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Unrelenting Horror with free Lifesteal and a Hemorrhage bonus; now the user's own bleeding pours into whoever is forced to strike them.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile the user has Lifesteal, and deals 10 more to enemies with Hemorrhage.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time they damage the user, the user's Hemorrhage moves onto them; if the user has none, they gain 1 Hemorrhage.

changes.why: Was Water's Naiad Form with Lifesteal and a 30 HP price; now the colossus runs on blood, Immortal for 3 turns and paying every random cost in HP.

before.effect: Blood Price (30 HP). For 4 turns, the user gains 3 Armor, Lifesteal, and 2 Renew at the start of each of their turns.

after.effect: Blood Price. For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immortal, and all of their skills' random costs are paid in HP.

changes.why: Was base Strike with a Reflect tacked on; now it pays off Shadow's Blind, turning the target's next blind swing back on themselves.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy; for 1 turn, the next Harmful skill aimed at the user is Reflected.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Blinded, their next single-target skill is Reflected back at them.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Shadow Crash spending Reflects instead of Stealth; now it breaks the enemy's hidden counters, Reflects and Traps, Water's Flow made into a hammer.

before.effect: Breaks the user's Reflects: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies, +10 to each per Reflect broken.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Any counter, Reflect or Trap on the enemies it hits shatters: it ends, and its owner takes 10 more.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Long Shadow plus Flow's counter-proofing; now Shadow's Stealth quickens the user's cooldowns the way Water's Waterfall does.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage, and the user's next skill is Stealthy and ignores counters and reflects.

after.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. If the user is Stealthed, their other cooldowns drop by 1.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Mirage Blade with Reflect for its counter; now it lets the blows land but turns every curse back on its sender.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first Harmful skill used on the user is Reflected.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, every Debuff aimed at the user is Reflected onto whoever sent it; the damage still lands.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Night of Knives plus Water's Flow; now the fury mirrors every self-buff the enemy casts, Rage for Rage.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and Flow.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, and whenever an enemy uses a Helpful skill on themselves, the user Mimics it.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Shadow Spine plus Water's Renew; now it copies the target's cheap attacks straight back at them.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage, +5 for each of Blinded, Isolated and Asleep the target is; a random ally gains 1 Renew.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If the last skill they used cost 1 energy or less, the user Mimics it too.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Shadowstep plus Water's Dive; now the user slips out of reach but turns the next attack on an ally back at its user.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted and gains Stealth for 1 turn, and 2 Renew.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, watching from the glass: the first single-target Harmful skill aimed at an ally in that time is Reflected.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Blackbolt plus Water's Splash; now a second dose of Shadow's Blind sets up a Water-style stun.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns; a random ally gains 2 Renew.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns. If they were already Blinded, the glare also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Wave of Darkness plus Water's Deluge; now the tide returns the enemy's last area attack in kind.

before.effect: 25 damage and 1 Confusion to all enemies. With Flow, it also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. The user then Mimics the last enemy skill that hit more than one of their allies.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Drink Darkness with a Reflect tacked on; now it drinks the target's last blessing and Mimics it for the user's team.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. For 1 turn, the next Harmful skill aimed at the user is Reflected.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If their last skill was Helpful, the user Mimics it.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Call Shade with a Reflect-granting skill in place of its Blind; now the Shade is a trap itself, Reflecting whatever kills it.

before.effect: Summons a Mirror Shade (15 HP) for 3 turns. Silver Veil (r): for 1 turn, the next Harmful skill aimed at target ally is Reflected.

after.effect: Summons a Mirror Shade (20 HP) for 3 turns. Glass Shard (nc): 10 damage to target enemy. When it's killed, the skill that killed it is Reflected onto its user.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Nightsong with a team Reflect in place of its Sleep; now the hall bends every attack on the user onto a random enemy while it lasts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns; while it channels, the first Harmful skill aimed at each ally each turn is Reflected.

after.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. Each turn, 10 damage to all enemies. While it channels, enemy single-target skills aimed at the user hit a random enemy instead.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Backstab word for word; now it strikes Shadow's sleepers and, like Water's Drown, keeps them under.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or the target is Blinded.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Asleep; it doesn't wake them.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Ambush plus Water's Drown; now it punishes a foiled attacker, paying off any counter or Reflect that caught them.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed. Against Stunned targets, their Stuns last 1 turn longer.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if one of their skills was countered or Reflected since the user's last turn.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Sap plus Water's Undertow rule; now Shadow's Sleep hands off to Water's Confusion when it breaks, so waking them has a cost.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; a target already Asleep gains 2 Confusion instead.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Sleep. When they wake, they're groggy: 2 Confusion for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Hall of Phantoms with Reflect in place of Immune; now the dancer slips each Stun and copies the skill that tried it.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, for 1 turn they're Ghosted and every Harmful skill aimed at them is Reflected.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness at the start of each of their turns. Each time Swiftness stops a Stun, the user Mimics the skill that tried it.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Touch of Slumber plus Water's Renew; now it heals an ally and diverts the enemy's next heal onto them.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, gains 2 Renew, and falls Asleep.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. The next Helpful skill an enemy uses to heal is Reflected, landing on that ally instead.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Nightwrap with a Reflect tacked on; now Water's Flow keeps Shadow's Stealth from breaking, so the ally can act unseen.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; for 2 turns, the first Harmful skill aimed at them is Reflected.

after.effect: Target ally gains Stealth, and Flow for 2 turns; while they have Flow, their skills are Stealthy.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Blinding Powder plus a Helpful Reflect that copied the kit's Trap; now Shadow's Blind feeds Water's Confusion each time it misdirects them.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns, and the next Helpful skill aimed at them is Reflected onto a random unit of yours.

after.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns and gains 1 Confusion. Each time their Blind sends a skill astray, they gain 1 more Confusion.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Shadowbrand plus Water's Aqua Ring; now the brand lets a teammate turn the target's own last skill against them.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns; for 2 turns, allies who damage the target gain Flow. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, the first ally who damages them also Mimics the last skill they used.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Nightfall with a Reflect tacked on; now allies already hidden by Shadow get Water's Renew, and the rest are hidden.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain Stealth; next turn, the first Harmful skill aimed at each of them is Reflected.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. Each ally already Stealthed gains 3 Renew; the rest gain Stealth.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Shadow Pulse plus Water's Water Lash; now Shadow's Blind sets up Water's Weakness on whoever the shards find.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies; with Flow, each gains 1 Weakness.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; any Blinded one it hits also gains 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Hunter's Howl plus Water's Whale Call; now it keeps Shout's Intimidate, and Shadow's Blind and Sleep set up Water's Affliction.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 2 turns (Intimidated instead if already Blinded) and gain 1 Vulnerable.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; those already Blinded or Asleep also take 15 Affliction.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Veiled Guard with Reflect in place of Stealth; now breaking the guard hands the user a copy of the skill that broke it.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor; with 3 or more, the next Harmful skill aimed at them is Reflected.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. If an enemy breaks it, the user Mimics the skill that did.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Faceless One with Reflect in place of Isolate; now the user takes on one enemy's face, copying their Buffs throughout and their last skill once.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor and all enemies are Taunted by them; the first Harmful skill each enemy uses on the user each turn is Reflected.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user wears target enemy's face: 2 Armor and copies of their Buffs, refreshed at the start of each of the user's turns. When it begins, the user Mimics that enemy's last skill.

changes.why: Was Viper Strike plus a Leaping condition; now the kiss that tips a target into Prey charms them, a threshold neither parent's Strike reads.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Toxin. If the user is Leaping, the target is also Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin. If that makes them Prey, they're Charmed for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Spiral Crash with Charmed on its splash; now the ring traps whoever dances through it, turning the enemy's speed into their undoing.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Leaping, they Leap; if they are, every enemy takes 10 and is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each one hit who has a mobility buff loses them all and is Charmed for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Launch plus Lunge's Prey clause; now Wind's speed carries Poison, so every skill the user rushes out spreads Toxin.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing; through their next turn, every enemy is Prey.

after.effect: The user begins Rushing. For 2 turns, each enemy they damage also gains 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Zephyr Blade's bait with Charmed in place of damage; now it's a real counter that turns the attack onto the attacker's own friend.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin to target enemy. If this skill is countered, the counterer is Charmed for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first single-target Harmful skill used on the user hits a random ally of its user instead; then its user is Charmed for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Viper Stance plus Launch; now a real Rage whose Might counts the quarry, with Wind's Immobile and Poison's Prey both marking the hunted.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into Weakness, and the user begins Rushing.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune and gains 1 Might for each enemy that is Prey or Immobile, rechecked at the start of each of their turns.

changes.why: Was Poison's Sting with Charmed added to its random pool; now a two-step dusting: the first muddles, the second charms.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, and at random 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness, 1 Vulnerable, or Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and 1 Confusion. If they already had Confusion, they're Charmed for 1 turn instead.

changes.why: Was Banewood Javelin with Charmed tacked on; now the wind carries the shot to whoever is sickest when it lands.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 25 Affliction damage, and Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target, Uncounterable. On the following turn, 30 Affliction damage to target enemy; if another enemy has more Toxin by then, it veers to them instead.

changes.why: Was Float Noose with Toxin for damage and a late Charm; now it springs on the enemy's heals and buffs, which may land on the wrong side.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they gain 1 Toxin and are Isolated for 1 turn; the second time, they're also Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, whenever target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they're Charmed for 1 turn first, so it picks its target at random; they also gain 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Slither with a Leap for Invulnerable; now Wind's Leap is weighted by Poison, so the escape sets up a strike on the most poisoned foe.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user Leaps and gains 1 Focus.

after.effect: The user Leaps; their Leap's bonus damage is 5 per Toxin on the target it hits instead of 5.

changes.why: Was Emerald Asp's fang (and Poison's Sting name) plus an Eagle's Leap; now a trickster that hides while its mischief is working.

before.effect: Summons a Pixie (25 HP) permanently; it Leaps at the start of each of your turns. Sting (r): 5 Piercing damage and 1 Toxin. Befuddle (A): target enemy is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Pixie (25 HP) permanently; it's Untargetable while any enemy is Charmed. Befuddle (A): target enemy is Charmed for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey.

changes.why: Was Compressed Bolt and Acid Orb side by side; now Wind's Immobile feeds Poison's Prey, so the slow become the hunted.

before.effect: 15 damage. If the target is Immobile or Prey, they gain 1 Vulnerable and their non-Strategic skills are stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. If they're Immobile, they also count as Prey for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Spiral Burst plus Acid Wash plus a random Charm; now trades Blast damage for one misfire from every enemy.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies, +10 if the user is Leaping; each gains 1 Vulnerable, and a random one is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to all enemies; each is Charmed for their next skill.

changes.why: Was Devour plus Sap Speed; now it drinks the target's Toxin as a drain, and Rushing lets the user sip without spilling it.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP (doubled for minions); otherwise they lose their mobility buffs.

after.effect: Target enemy takes 5 Affliction damage per Toxin on them and loses it; the user heals that much. If the user is Rushing, the Toxin stays.

changes.why: Was Wind Sprites with Charmed in place of Stun; now the Sprites are bait, and swatting one charms the swatter.

before.effect: Summons 2 Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns. Pinch (nc): 5 Piercing damage; if it's countered, the counterer is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons 2 Sprites (10 HP) for 3 turns; an enemy who damages a Sprite is Charmed for 1 turn. Pinch (nc): 5 Piercing damage.

changes.why: Was Vortex plus Nine Plagues' random rider; now the revel spreads Charm and hurts only those it has swept in.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, one more if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks; each turn, a random enemy is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: Channeled. For 3 turns, at the end of each of the user's turns, a random enemy is Charmed for 1 turn, and every Charmed enemy takes 10 Affliction damage.

changes.why: Was Airknife plus Pounce; now it cashes Toxin early, and Wind's Rushing doubles the payout.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage, or 15 if the user is Rushing. Against Prey, you gain 1 random energy.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, and their Toxin ticks once now, or twice if the user is Rushing.

changes.why: Was Envenom plus Rushing; now a fork: dive on Prey and escape with a Leap, or dive on the healthy and poison them.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage, Bypassing Invulnerable; Prey or Invulnerable targets gain 2 Toxin. The user begins Rushing.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user Leaps; otherwise they gain 2 Toxin.

changes.why: Was Numbing Needle with Charmed for its debuffs; now the user poses as the enemy's friend and steals the help meant for others.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they gain 1 Toxin and are Charmed for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; if they use a Helpful skill on an ally, it lands on the user instead.

changes.why: Was Lacerate with an Immobile clause; now they wake up charmed, so waking them early is a choice.

before.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey or Immobile.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they fall Asleep for 1 turn. When the Sleep ends, they're Charmed for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Cobra Stance with a Charm tacked on; now a real Dance with a fae price: big buffs, but the user's own single-target skills go wild.

before.effect: All Armor on enemies turns into Vulnerable; then a random enemy with Vulnerable is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and is Charmed.

changes.why: Was Moonglove Mixture plus Invigorating Breeze; now each use asks whether to cleanse a friend or buy a Charm by healing a foe.

before.effect: Target unit, ally or enemy, heals 20 and gains 2 Toxin; an ally above 60 HP afterwards begins Rushing.

after.effect: Target unit heals 20. An ally also loses all Toxin; an enemy is Charmed for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Swiftwind plus Viper's Crest; now Wind's Swiftness bites back, charming whoever tries to Stun the ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness, and 1 Might for 3 turns.

after.effect: Target ally gains 2 Swiftness. For 3 turns, each Stun their Swiftness shrugs off Charms its source for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Swamp Toxins with Charmed for Toxin; now the Charm is contagious, spreading through the team it turns on.

before.effect: Target enemy is Charmed for 2 turns and gains 1 Confusion.

after.effect: Target enemy is Charmed for 2 turns. Each ally of theirs they damage while Charmed is Charmed for 1 turn too.

changes.why: Was Feathermark plus Preymark; now it punishes the target's supporters, charming whoever just helped them.

before.effect: 20 damage. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap and give them 1 Vulnerable.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Each ally of theirs who healed or buffed them since the user's last turn is Charmed for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Serpentsong plus Uplifting Verse's Leap and a Charm; now the song lifts the poison off allies and blows it onto foes.

before.effect: All allies gain 2 Renew and Leap; all enemies gain 1 Toxin, and a random one is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and lose their Toxin; each stack removed goes to a random enemy.

changes.why: Was Falling Slam plus Tail Lash; now Prey keeps the petals whirling from foe to foe.

before.effect: 10 damage to all enemies; the cooldown resets if it hits Prey. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; each Prey it hits sends another 10 at a random enemy.

changes.why: Was Echoing Voice plus a Toxin-gated Charm; now a real Shout whose laughter trips the first enemy to act.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy with 2 or more Toxin is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; the first of them to use a single-target skill is Charmed for 1 turn first, so it picks at random.

changes.why: Was Coil plus Slipstream; now the Shield has thorns, and Rushing sharpens them.

before.effect: The user gains 10 Shield and 1 Armor, and 10 more Shield if they're Rushing.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn; each enemy who damages it gains 1 Toxin, or 2 if the user is Rushing.

changes.why: Was Mesmerizing Glare with Piercing Cry's Immobile extension; now the Taunt points them at their own friend.

before.effect: Target enemy is Taunted and counts as Prey for 3 turns, or 4 if they're Immobile.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by a random ally of theirs for 1 turn, or 2 if they're Prey, so that ally is all they can target.

changes.why: Was Constrictor Stance with a Charm, not a transformation; now a real Titan whose court enthralls anyone who dares to strike her.

before.effect: All Focus in the battle turns into Confusion; then every enemy with Confusion is Charmed for 1 turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune; each enemy who uses a single-target skill on them is Charmed for 1 turn afterwards.

changes.why: Was Worldfist's +5 per minion with Trek in its place; now it cashes the whole journey in, so the user chooses between one big blow and keeping Trek.

before.effect: 20 damage, +5 per Trek.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user spends all their Trek for 10 more per Trek spent.

changes.why: Was Worldquake's split with +5 per Trek and a Leap; now a full journey buries the enemy team, making them Immobile for Wind's payoffs.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies, +5 to each per Trek; the user Leaps.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. At 3 Trek, each one hit is also buried: they lose their mobility buffs and are Isolated for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Launch with a Focus at 3 Trek; now the user can trade Earth's camp (a minion) for a head start on the road.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing; at 3 Trek, they also gain 1 Focus for their next skill.

after.effect: The user begins Rushing. If they have an allied Boulder or Seedling, they pack one up: it's removed, and they gain 2 Trek.

changes.why: Was Shale Guard with Isolated added; now the counter raises a stone decoy that soaks the attacker's next blows.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 10 Piercing damage to its user, who is Isolated for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Taunted for 1 turn by a Boulder the user creates.

changes.why: Was Chainbreaker plus Trek set to 3; now the Rage grows only while the user keeps moving, and one repeat throws it away.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs; they're Immune for 2 turns, and Trek becomes 3.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user is Immune, and each time their Trek rises they gain 1 Might, which lasts until their Trek next resets.

changes.why: Was Launch Stone with +5 per Trek; now Earth's stone knocks Wind's leapers out of the air.

before.effect: 15 damage, +5 per Trek. Can instead launch an allied Boulder at a random enemy for its remaining HP.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Against a Leaping target, it Bypasses and ends their Leap.

changes.why: Was Elegant Sweep with more damage at 3 Trek (and named like the kit's suggested rename); now Trek's rule turns outward: the storm punishes enemies who stay put.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team, or 40 at 3 Trek.

after.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 25 Piercing damage to the enemy team; any enemy who repeated their last skill in the meantime takes 15 more.

changes.why: Was Float Noose with a mobility lock; now the quicksand deepens the farther the user travels before it's sprung.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage, are Isolated for 1 turn, and can't gain mobility buffs.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy has Trap 15, which grows by 10 at the end of each of the user's turns in which their Trek rises.

changes.why: Was Bound plus Armor, and its Trek clause never mattered on a 3-turn cooldown; now it restarts a journey broken by a Stun or a rest.

before.effect: The user Leaps and gains 1 Armor. Using this skill never resets Trek.

after.effect: The user Leaps. If their Trek is 0, it becomes 2.

changes.why: Was Grand Eagle with Trek for allies who can't use it; now the camel carries the user through rests and Stuns without losing the road.

before.effect: Summons a Pack Camel (50 HP) permanently. Kick (r): 15 damage. Carry (A): target ally Leaps and gains 1 Trek.

after.effect: Summons a Pack Camel (50 HP) permanently; while it stands, a turn in which the user uses no skill doesn't reset their Trek. Kick (r): 15 damage.

changes.why: Was Compressed Bolt plus Isolated; now Earth's defenses become Wind's weakness, turning armored targets Immobile.

changes.why: Was Float Noose with Blinded in place of Isolated; now it punishes Wind's movement with Shadow's Sleep.

before.effect: For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Blinded for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a mobility skill or gains a mobility buff, they take 20 Piercing damage and fall Asleep.

changes.why: Was Shadowstep plus 2 Clones; now a Clone is spent to vanish, and with none left it makes one.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and creates 2 Clones.

after.effect: The user destroys a Clone, if they have one, to gain Stealth; otherwise they become Invulnerable for 1 turn and create a Clone.

changes.why: Kept as it was; its minion skill is renamed from Bite, which Blood's Vampire Bat also uses.

before.effect: Summons a Ninken (30 HP) permanently. Bite (r): 10 Piercing damage. Track (r): target enemy loses Stealth and can't regain it for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Ninken (30 HP) permanently. Snap (r): 10 Piercing damage. Track (r): target enemy loses Stealth and can't regain it for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Blackbolt plus Compressed Bolt's Immobile clause; now Shadow's Blind turns on Wind's payoffs against the Immobile.

before.effect: 20 damage and Blinded for 2 turns; Immobile targets also have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns, during which they count as Immobile.

changes.why: Was Wave of Darkness plus per-Clone damage; now it rebuilds a spent army before the blades fall, so they join the Flurry.

before.effect: 20 damage and 1 Confusion for 1 turn to all enemies, +5 to each per Clone.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. If the user has no Clones, they create 3 first.

changes.why: Was Drink Darkness with a Clone per Blind; now the user reabsorbs their shadows as healing, or leaves one to absorb next time.

before.effect: 5 Affliction to all enemies; Blinded ones lose Blind and take 10 more. The user creates a Clone per Blind removed.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it; then the user absorbs their Clones, healing 10 per Clone, or creates one if they have none.

changes.why: Was Vortex plus per-Clone damage; now the tornado builds its own Clones, and they strike on every tick, not only when the user acts.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, one more if the user is Leaping or Rushing when it ticks; each Clone adds 5 to every hit.

after.effect: Channeled. For 2 turns, the user creates a Clone at the start of each tick; then 10 damage to all enemies, and every Clone Flurries each of them.

changes.why: Was Backstab plus Airknife; now Wind's Rushing lets the user stay in Shadow's Stealth while they keep cutting.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or Rushing or the target is Blinded.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is Stealthed. If the user is Rushing, it's Stealthy.

changes.why: Was Ambush plus Rushing; now Wind's Leap sets up Shadow's Stealth for the next strike.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the user is Stealthed; the user begins Rushing.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user was Leaping, they land in the shadows and gain Stealth.

changes.why: Was Illusory Lure plus a Clone; now a successful feint rebuilds the whole decoy line.

before.effect: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered; they're Isolated for 2 turns, and the user creates a Clone.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user creates Clones until they have 3.

changes.why: Was Sap plus a Strategic stun on the Immobile; now Wind's Immobile deepens Shadow's Sleep.

before.effect: 10 damage, and Sleep; Immobile targets also have their Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they fall Asleep; if they're Immobile, damage can't wake them for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Hall of Phantoms plus 2 Clones; now the Clones are fuel that keeps the user hidden while attacking.

before.effect: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, they gain Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns, and create 2 Clones.

after.effect: The user gains Stealth, 2 Clones and 1 Might for 3 turns; meanwhile, a skill that would end their Stealth destroys a Clone instead.

changes.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus a Stealthed bonus; now Shadow's Sleep is a rest that Wind wakes them from, running.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, or 30 if they're Stealthed; above 60 HP afterwards, they begin Rushing.

after.effect: Target ally heals 30 and falls Asleep; when they wake, they begin Rushing and gain 1 Swiftness.

changes.why: Was Nightwrap plus Swiftwind; now the user lends their decoys to an ally.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth and 2 Swiftness.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Swiftness, and the user creates a Clone; for 2 turns, the user's Clones Substitute for that ally too.

changes.why: Was Blinding Powder plus Headwind; now each blind swing costs them Wind's speed.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns and loses their mobility buffs.

after.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns and loses a mobility buff each time they use a skill.

changes.why: Was Shadowbrand plus Feathermark; now the team's hits on the mark build the Ninja's decoys.

before.effect: 10 damage and Sanctify for 2 turns. For 1 turn, allies who damage the target Leap. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them gives the user a Clone.

changes.why: Was Nightfall plus Uplifting Verse's Leap; now each ally gets Shadow's cover or Wind's lift, depending on their speed.

before.effect: All allies gain Stealth, heal 15, and Leap.

after.effect: All allies heal 20; each ally with no mobility buff gains Stealth, and the rest Leap.

changes.why: Was Shadow Pulse plus per-Clone damage and Falling Slam's discount; now a real Cleave whose extra targets come from the Clones.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, +5 to each per Clone. Costs 1 less while the user is Leaping or Rushing.

after.effect: Stealthy. The user creates a Clone if they have none; then 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, and each Clone adds 10 to another random enemy.

changes.why: Was Echoing Voice plus a 1-turn Hunter's Howl; now the smoke hides new Clones among the already-blinded.

before.effect: Every ally gains 1 Swiftness; every enemy is Blinded for 1 turn.

after.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 1 turn; the user creates a Clone for each one who already was.

changes.why: Was Veiled Guard plus a Clone; now the Shield keeps the decoys standing through the hits they take.

before.effect: The user gains 1 permanent Armor and creates a Clone; with 3 or more Armor, they also gain Stealth.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn and creates a Clone; while the Shield lasts, a Clone that Substitutes for them spends the Shield instead of being destroyed.

changes.why: Was Shadow Mockery with a Clone as the decoy; now every move the taunted enemy makes brings the Clones down on them.

before.effect: The user creates a Clone; target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn, or 3 if they're Immobile.

after.effect: The user creates a Clone. Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns, and each skill they use during it draws a Flurry from every Clone.

changes.why: Was Faceless One with a Clone refill in place of its Taunt; now the Clones cover the user even against sweeping attacks.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor, all enemies are Isolated, and the user's Clones refill to 3 at the start of each of their turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune and creates a Clone at the start of each of their turns; their Clones Substitute for them against multi-target skills too.

passes.title: Texture and Unique pass
passes.summary: Texture skills that only worked with both parents' statuses, or followed the same if-this-then-that formula, now open new synergies for one parent's play style; each kit also gained one or two Unique skills with utility no other kit has.

changes.why: Was Hidden Explosives with a Chill rider; now a Trap that springs on an HP threshold rather than on any action the target takes.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first time target enemy uses a Harmful skill, an Explosion is triggered, and it Chills every enemy it hits for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time target enemy falls to 50 HP or less, the ice cracks under them: they take 20 Piercing damage and are Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Ivory Step with a double Explosion on Frost-debuffed enemies; now a Fire player's sustained dance that turns every attacking turn into an Explosion.

before.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn and Explodes. Enemies with a Frost debuff take the Explosion twice.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Explodes at the end of each of their turns in which they dealt damage.

changes.why: Was a heal plus Shield from enemy Ignite ticks; now a heal frozen in waiting that thaws early to cushion a killing blow.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, whenever an Ignite on an enemy ticks, that ally gains 5 Shield.

after.effect: Target ally heals 35 at the end of the enemy's next turn. If a hit would kill them before then, the heal lands first, at once.

changes.why: Was Northern Solace with leftover Shield turned to healing; now bends Ice's Chill from a cap on discounts into a real cost tax.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 25 Shield for 1 turn. When it ends, each heals for the Shield they have left.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, Chilled enemies' skills also cost 1 more random energy.

changes.why: Was a Shield that Exploded when broken (a third Fire expansion); now gives Ice players a new route to Frostborn, balancing the kit.

before.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 1 turn. If an enemy breaks it, an Explosion is triggered.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and is Frostborn while any of it remains.

changes.why: Was an Ignite that Exploded enemies with Renew; now a volatile Ignite that punishes being cleansed, which any Fire player wants.

before.effect: 15 damage and Ignite. If the target has Renew, it boils over: they Explode.

after.effect: 15 damage and Ignite to target enemy. For 2 turns, if that Ignite is removed from them, they Explode.

changes.why: Was the stock Stab plus healing against Scorched targets; now a probe that gives Water players a new way to earn Flow by testing for tricks.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. If the target is Scorched, the user heals as much as this deals.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. It ignores counters and reflects; if it slips past one, the user gains Flow for 2 turns.

changes.why: Was Might and Renew with more Renew for hitting Ignited enemies; now a Bless that changes the ally's damage type, dissolving Armor for any class.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Renew, and 1 more Renew each time they damage an Ignited enemy.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their Normal damage is Piercing.

changes.why: Exploded Sapped enemies; now bends Fire's Ignite so a team's existing burns hit twice as hard.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Sapped enemies it hits Explode. +1 Heat.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Until they end, the Ignites on every enemy it hits deal double.

changes.why: Was Hologram with Ignited in place of Sapped; now a counter that plants a Fire Ignite burning on both sides' turns.

before.effect: For 1 turn, any Ignited enemy who uses a Harmful skill is countered and Sapped twice, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Ignited. For 2 turns, that Ignite also ticks at the end of their own turns.

changes.why: Gave Charge for Igniting; now a Lightning trade-off: an instant full Charge paid for with 3 turns of none.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and 1 Charge each time they Ignite an enemy.

after.effect: Target ally's Charge fills to 3 at once, and they gain 1 Might for 3 turns. For those 3 turns, they can't gain Charge.

changes.why: Was Sapped and Scorched with an Ignite if already Sapped; now bends Lightning's Sapped so a full stack keeps draining instead of resetting.

before.effect: Target enemy is Sapped and Scorched for 2 turns; if they were already Sapped, they're also Ignited.

after.effect: Target enemy is Sapped and Confused for 2 turns. While they're Confused, full Sapped isn't spent: they generate 1 less energy every turn it stays at 3.

changes.why: Was an arc that spread Ignite and Sapped from an Ignited target; now a Cleave that shorts out channels, answering Snipes and Channels from any kit.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the target is Ignited, the arc carries it: the other enemy is Ignited and Sapped.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Any channel either of them holds is broken, and neither can start one until the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was Chainbreaker with Might in place of Immune; now gives Fire teams a new route to Might through Explosions.

before.effect: Usable while Stunned. Removes the user's Debuffs, and for 3 turns they gain 1 Might per Debuff removed (at least 1, max 3).

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and 1 more Might each time their side causes an Explosion (max 3 more).

changes.why: Was Float Noose with Ignite swapped in and a Rushing bonus; now bends Ignite so every skill the target uses fans the flame.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they take 10 Piercing damage and are Ignited, or 20 if they're Leaping or Rushing.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first skill target enemy uses Ignites them; after that, their Ignite also ticks each time they use a skill.

changes.why: Was Fireball with Immobile in place of Ignited; now a grappling hook that pins the target down, denying every escape status at once.

before.effect: 20 damage. Immobile targets Explode.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the end of their next turn, they're hooked: they lose Invulnerable, Untargetable and Stealth, and can't gain them.

changes.why: Ticked Ignites, twice if the user was mobile; now a Blast that builds pressure from the team's own sequencing, rewarding it for going last.

before.effect: 15 damage to all enemies. Every Ignite on them ticks at once, or twice if the user is Leaping or Rushing.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies, +10 for each ally of the user who used a damaging skill earlier this turn.

changes.why: Turned a consumed Ignite into Rushing; now a new outlet for Wind's banked Swiftness.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. If they're Ignited, the Ignite is consumed and the user begins Rushing.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, healing the user as much. The user burns all their Swiftness as fuel: 10 more healing per stack.

changes.why: Ignited targets from a Leap; now a pure Wind rule bend that lets a Leaper chip away while saving the landing blow.

before.effect: 10 damage, or 20 against targets at or below 60 HP. Used while Leaping, it doesn't end the Leap and Ignites the target.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Used while Leaping, it gets the Leap's 5 bonus damage without ending the Leap.

changes.why: Made Rushing allies Ignite; now bends Leaping so an ally keeps striking from the air until something hits them.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, their damaging skills Ignite.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their damaging skills don't end their Leap; it ends only when they take damage.

changes.why: Doubled the Ignite on mobile enemies; now protects a Fire player's Ignite from cleansing.

before.effect: Target enemy is Ignited and Confused for 2 turns. While they have a mobility buff, the Ignite deals double.

after.effect: Target enemy is Ignited and Confused for 2 turns. While they're Confused, their Ignite can't be removed.

changes.why: Spread an existing Ignite between its two targets; now a Fire trade-off that burns the user for extra damage, which Flameborn turns into healing.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If either is Ignited, the blades spread it to the other.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The user overheats: they're Ignited, and deal 5 more direct damage while they stay Ignited.

changes.why: Ignited Prey among those hit; now primes the enemy team for a Fire player's Explosions.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Prey among them are Ignited.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. For 2 turns, Explosions deal 10 more to each enemy it hit.

changes.why: Was Lunge plus double Ignites on Prey; now bends Poison's Toxin to tick an extra time.

before.effect: 10 damage. Through the user's next turn, every enemy is Prey, and Ignites deal double to Prey.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and the user gets 1 Focus for their next skill. Until the user's next turn, Toxin on the target also ticks at the start of the target's turn.

changes.why: Was an escape that handed out Sulfur; now smoke that blinds both sides, a gamble that scatters an enemy focus-fire at the cost of the user's own team's aim.

before.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every enemy gains 1 Sulfur.

after.effect: Unstunnable. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every other unit, ally or enemy, is Blinded for 1 turn.

changes.why: Added Toxin to each Ignite the ally applied; now bends Fire's Flameborn to feed on any Affliction the ally deals.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and each Ignite they apply also gives 1 Toxin.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and Flameborn, and their Flameborn heals them for all the Affliction damage they deal, not just their Ignites'.

changes.why: Was a Taunt that stacked Sulfur each turn; now a Taunt that hunts whoever supports the enemy team, pulling healers into the fight.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. They gain 1 Sulfur at the end of each turn they're Taunted.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever another enemy uses a Helpful skill meanwhile, the Taunt jumps to them.

changes.why: Was Earth's Worldquake with Ignite counted instead of minions, plus a Scorch rider; now it bends Fire's Scorch so it also starves Shield.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Costs 1 less per Ignited enemy, and Ignited enemies hit are Scorched for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For 2 turns, Scorch on any of them also halves the Shield they gain.

changes.why: Sacrificed a Seedling to Ignite and Scorch; now a new outlet for Earth's Seedlings, cashing in their Channel Earth for free.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Seedling, one is sacrificed and the target is Ignited and Scorched for 2 turns; otherwise, the user creates one.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Each allied Seedling ripens: it uses Channel Earth at no cost, then loses 5 HP.

changes.why: Was Earth's Stonepierce check with an Ignite tacked on; now primes the target so Fire's next Ignite ticks on arrival.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they have Shield or Armor, it first melts 10 Shield or 1 Armor, and they're Ignited.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. The next Ignite put on them before the user's next turn burns once the moment it lands.

changes.why: Was Earth's Stone Drill trading Armor for an Ignite; now magma that builds while the user holds back, a big hit for supports and patient builds.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user has Armor, they lose 1, and this deals 15 more and Ignites the target.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each of the user's turns since they last dealt direct damage (max +30).

changes.why: Was a bland 1 Corona; now a blessing that turns toward whoever needs it, a roaming Buff no other Bless has.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Corona.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Renew. At the start of each of the user's turns, both move to the ally with the least HP.

changes.why: Was Rampart that Ignites attackers; now feeds Earth's Boulders, and so Launch Stone, from the hits the user soaks.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Enemies who damage it are Ignited.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. Damage it absorbs is baked into a random allied Boulder, which gains that much HP.

changes.why: Turned the user's own Ignites into Anointed; now a rule bend for Holy players, making Condemned fire on every skill for a turn.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each Ignite on them burns out: it's removed and heals them 10, and they're Anointed if any were.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Until their next turn, an enemy's Condemned triggers each time they use a skill instead of ending.

changes.why: Paid off Condemned plus Ignite; now bends Fire's Ignite so it can't be cleansed and punishes healing.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Condemned. If they're Condemned and Ignited, their Ignite also burns once now.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, their Ignite can't be removed, and it burns once more whenever they're healed.

changes.why: Anointed the user while any enemy was Ignited; now turns Fire's Explosions into Might, a new payoff for Explode teams.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and is Anointed while any enemy is Ignited.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each Explosion their side causes gives them 1 Might until it ends.

changes.why: Was a big cleanse with an Ignite-to-Flameborn rider; now overhealing becomes a new way for Holy players to Anoint.

before.effect: Target ally heals 40 and loses their Debuffs; an Ignite removed this way gives them Flameborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: Target ally heals 40. If any of it is wasted past their max HP, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was Holy's Saving Grace with Ignite in place of Anointed; now the law protects the weak, forcing every enemy onto the sturdiest ally.

before.effect: All allies heal 10 and gain 10 Shield. It repeats at the start of each of the user's next 2 turns while an enemy is Ignited.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 1 turn, every enemy is Taunted by the ally with the most HP.

changes.why: Was a Shield whose breaker was Ignited and Condemned; now it postpones a killing blow, buying a turn for healers to answer it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. The enemy who breaks it is Ignited and Condemned.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. The first hit meanwhile that would kill them is stayed: its damage lands at the end of their next turn instead.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Grave Step plus an Ignite on whoever it saved them from; now spreads Unholy's Immortal to the allies closest to dying.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn; each hit that Immortal stops from killing them Ignites its dealer.

after.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and each ally at or below 30 HP becomes Immortal for as long.

changes.why: Horrified the Ignited enemies it hit; now bends Fire's Ignite to tick on both sides' turns while the dance lasts.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each Ignited enemy they damage is Horrified for 1 turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and Ignites they apply burn at the end of every turn, not only theirs.

changes.why: Ignited or drained a Soul Fragment depending on Ignite; now a bounty that pays the killer and the user, whoever lands the blow.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, allies who damage them Ignite them, or drain a Soul Fragment from them if they're already Ignited.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they die within 2 turns, whoever killed them has their cooldowns reset, and the user's player gains 1 random energy.

changes.why: Doubled Lifesteal against Ignited enemies; now gives Unholy's Horrified a new outlet, stealing the Buffs it blocks.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain Lifesteal for 1 turn; their Lifesteal heals double against Ignited enemies.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each Buff a Horrified enemy would gain goes to a random ally of the user instead.

changes.why: Was Oathbreaker Strike with Ignite on both teams; now a new way for Fire players to cause Explosions, from kills.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; then they and each of the user's allies take 10 and are Ignited (allies with Flameborn heal it instead).

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Any enemy it kills Explodes.

changes.why: Was Long Shadow with a Focus bonus against Ignited targets; now carries Fire's Ignite from one enemy to the user's next targets.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. Stealthy. If they're Ignited, the user also gains 1 Focus and their next skill is Stealthy too.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Focus. Any Ignite on them is carried off: it ends, and the user's next damaging skill Ignites its targets.

changes.why: Ignited Blinded targets and burned Sleepers; now a new source of Shadow's Isolated that reads whether the target's team is tending them.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. A Blinded target is Ignited; an Asleep one takes their Ignite's damage now without waking.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If no ally of theirs used a Helpful skill on them since the user's last turn, they're Isolated for 1 turn.

changes.why: Blinded every Ignited enemy; now bends Shadow's Sleep so damage can't wake anyone for a turn.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and every Ignited enemy is Blinded for 1 turn.

after.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and no enemy's Sleep can end before the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was Call Shade that Ignited the already Blinded; now a candle that grows 10, 20, 40 if the team keeps it safe.

before.effect: Summons a Candle Shade (15 HP) for 3 turns. Smother (r): 5 Affliction damage and Blinded for 1 turn; a target already Blinded is Ignited instead.

after.effect: Summons a Wick (15 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of your turns, it deals 10 damage to a random enemy, doubling each time; any damage to it resets it to 10.

changes.why: Blinded Ignited targets and doubled against Blinded ones; now cashes in every Fire Ignite on the enemy team at once.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if they're Blinded; an Ignited target is Blinded for 1 turn first.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy. Then every Ignite on the enemy team burns once now.

changes.why: Was Sap plus an Ignite that didn't wake them; now a primed hex that Stuns on the next hit, the reverse of Sleep.

before.effect: 10 damage; the target falls Asleep and is Ignited, and the Ignite's damage doesn't wake them.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. After this, the next time they take damage within 2 turns, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Nightwrap with an Ignite on the skill that ended it; now bends Fire's rule that Ignite doesn't stack.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; the skill that ends it Ignites its targets.

after.effect: For 2 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Ignites they apply can stack, up to 2.

changes.why: Was Shadowbrand plus Ignite from Stealthed allies; now a new way into Shadow's Stealth for whoever follows up.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. Allies who damage them from Stealth also Ignite them.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. The first ally who damages them before the user's next turn gains Stealth.

changes.why: Ignited the Blinded enemies it hit; now pushes Fire's anti-healing further, turning the enemy's heals into damage.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy and a random other enemy; Blinded ones are also Ignited.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, healing either of them receives is dealt to the other as damage instead.

changes.why: Gave Stealth if it held and Ignited its breaker; now rewards Shadow players for staying Stealthed by keeping the Shield up.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If it survives the turn, they gain Stealth; if it breaks, whoever broke it is Ignited.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield, which lasts for as long as they stay Stealthed (at least 1 turn).

changes.why: Was Holy's Decree that Horrified when it triggered; now an invisible Trap that makes any Condemnation on the target renew itself, a loop for Holy Condemn play.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns; when it triggers, they're also Horrified for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy has Trap 15, and each time their Condemned triggers, they're Condemned again for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was a drain that healed per Debuff and took a Soul Fragment from Horrified targets; now the user eats their allies' sins, taking every Debuff onto themselves.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user 10 per Debuff on them. A Horrified target also loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then the user takes every Debuff their allies have onto themselves, for the turns each had left.

changes.why: Was a hit that healed if the target was Sanctified; now Horrified also strips Buffs the bearer already has, a rule bend for Unholy Horrify play.

before.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user heals the damage dealt.

after.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, each Horrified enemy loses a random Buff at the start of their turn.

changes.why: Was Condemn that triggered twice on Horrified targets; now every Sanctify the team triggers heals the whole team a little, a rule bend for Holy Sanctify play.

before.effect: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns. If they're Horrified, it triggers twice.

after.effect: Target enemy is Sanctified for 2 turns. Meanwhile, whenever any Sanctify on an enemy triggers, every ally of the damager heals 5 too.

changes.why: Was an Invulnerable step that made skills Stealthy against Condemned or Sanctified enemies; now it gets an ally out too, at the cost of the user's next attack.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn; their next skill against a Condemned or Sanctified enemy is Stealthy too.

after.effect: The user and target ally become Invulnerable for 1 turn. The user can't use Harmful skills on their next turn.

changes.why: Was Blind-into-Condemn and Condemn-into-Blind; now following up on the Mark deputizes an ally with Anointed, new Anointed access for Holy play.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. A Blinded target is also Condemned for 2 turns; a Condemned one is also Blinded for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. The ally who spends the Mark is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Was a Shield whose breaker was Condemned while the user gained Stealth; now the Shield also soaks up Debuffs, which no other Withstand does.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If it breaks, its breaker is Condemned for 2 turns and the user gains Stealth.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. While it holds, each Debuff an enemy would give them is prevented and costs 10 of the Shield instead.

changes.why: Was a Stealthy dash that drained a Soul Fragment only from Blinded targets; now lets a Shadow Sleep player hit Sleepers twice without waking them.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. A Blinded target also loses a Soul Fragment to the user.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, without waking them. The user's next skill doesn't wake Sleeping enemies it damages either.

changes.why: Was Shadowstep that drained Soul Fragments from Blinded enemies; now the user hides behind their familiars and their Lifesteal drinks from the minions' hits too.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn and drains a Soul Fragment from each Blinded enemy.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. For 2 turns, their Lifesteal also heals them for damage their minions deal.

changes.why: Was a hit that Horrified Sleeping targets without waking them; now Soul Fragments are spent to strip Buffs, a new outlet for Unholy players.

before.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Asleep, it doesn't wake them, and they're Horrified for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user spends up to 3 Soul Fragments, and target enemy loses 1 random Buff for each. Then 30 Piercing damage to them.

changes.why: Was a hit that Horrified Blinded targets; now a spiteful dance that copies every Buff the enemy gains and shortens theirs.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Blinded, they're Horrified for 2 turns and the user gains 1 Swiftness.

after.effect: The user gains 1 Swiftness. For 3 turns, whenever an enemy gains a Buff, the user gains a copy, and the enemy's lasts 1 turn less.

changes.why: Moved Renew off twice-Chilled targets; now takes the enemy's freshest clock and gives them the user's, a cooldown swap no other kit has.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Chilled for 1 turn. If they were already Chilled, their Renew moves to a random ally of the user.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Their skill with the longest cooldown left and the user's other skill with the longest cooldown left swap cooldowns.

changes.why: Gave Renew per Frost debuff on the target; now an enabler that makes Ice's Frost debuffs stick through Immune and cleanses.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have a Frost debuff; the user gains 1 Renew per Frost debuff on them.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, Frost debuffs land on them through Immune and can't be removed.

changes.why: Gave Renew to allies hitting a Chilled target; now a timing bonus for Water teams, firing Renew early for free.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Chilled for 1 turn. For 2 turns, allies who damage them while they're Chilled gain 1 Renew.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them has their Renew heal once at once, without losing a stack.

changes.why: Turned allies' Frost debuffs into Renew, close to Alchemy's Panacea; now bends Ice's Frostbitten to lock out the enemy's healing too.

before.effect: All allies heal 20. Every Frost debuff on them melts: each is removed and becomes 2 Renew.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. For 2 turns, Frostbitten enemies can't use Helpful skills either.

changes.why: Gave Charge per Chilled enemy hit; now freezes the Frost debuffs already on the enemy team in place, which any Ice player can build around.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user gains 1 Charge for each Chilled enemy it hits.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Until the end of the user's next turn, Frost debuffs on everyone it hits can't wear off or be removed.

changes.why: Chilled the attacker and gave 3 Charge side by side; now locks Sapped onto the attacker so a Lightning team can push them to 3.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user is Chilled for 2 turns, and the user gains 3 Charge.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Its user is Sapped twice, and their Sapped can't be removed for 3 turns.

changes.why: Sapped on each skill, then Chilled at 3 Sapped; now a hidden guard on the target's Frost debuffs that punishes cleansing or waiting them out.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, each time target enemy uses a skill, they're Sapped. When that brings them to 3 Sapped, they're also Chilled for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first time a Frost debuff on target enemy would end or be removed, it lasts 2 more turns instead, and they take 15 Piercing damage.

changes.why: Stole energy only from Sapped or Chilled targets; now an unconditional energy theft, the only Consume in the game that drains a player's energy instead of HP.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. If they're Sapped or Chilled, their player loses 1 random energy and the user's player gains it.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Their player loses 1 energy of the color they hold most, and the user's player gains it.

changes.why: Spent Charge for damage only on Chilled targets; now turns the user's own Charge into Sapped on the enemy, a new outlet for Charge.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Chilled, it spends all the user's Charge for 10 more each; if not, the user gains 1 Charge.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. All the user's Charge pours into them: they're Sapped once for each Charge spent.

changes.why: Cleansed Sapped and Frost debuffs side by side; now a delayed heal that grows with how frozen the enemy team is, for Ice teams.

before.effect: Target ally heals 15 and loses their Sapped and Frost debuffs, healing 10 more for each one removed.

after.effect: Target ally heals 15. At the start of the user's next turn, they heal 5 more for each Frost debuff on the enemy team (max 30).

changes.why: Spent allies' Charge for Shield (the stock formula); now the only Prayer that speeds up the whole team's cooldowns.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Allies with Charge spend it for 10 more Shield each.

after.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield. Every skill on cooldown on the user's side comes 1 turn closer to ready.

changes.why: Chilled the target and gave Charge side by side; now bends Sapped so a Lightning team drains the Taunted enemy twice as fast.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns; they're Chilled while Taunted. Each skill they use on the user gives the user 1 Charge.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While Taunted, each Sapped they gain counts as 2.

changes.why: Was 15 Piercing, or 30 if Immobile; now cashes in the attacker's Frost debuffs as damage, a new outlet for Ice teams.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user, dealing 15 Piercing damage to its user, or 30 if they're Immobile.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user. Every Frost debuff on its user shatters: it ends, and they take 15 Piercing damage for each.

changes.why: Cold Jaws Isolated Immobile targets; the Wolf now gives Wind teams a payoff for staying airborne or Rushing.

before.effect: Summons a Winter Wolf (40 HP) permanently. Cold Jaws (S): 20 damage to target enemy; if they're Immobile, they're also Isolated for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons a Winter Wolf (40 HP) permanently. Cold Jaws (S): 20 damage to target enemy. Hunting Howl (r): each ally who is Leaping or Rushing gains 1 Might for 2 turns.

changes.why: Stitched Shardstorm's Frostbitten bonus onto Sonic Thrust's self-Stun; now the user freezes themselves to gain Frostborn, a trade-off only Ice offers.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Frostbitten. Unless the user is Rushing or Frostborn, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user is Frostbitten for 1 turn and gains Frostborn for 2.

changes.why: Countered more against Immobile targets and copied Wind Step's Rushing; now bends Leaping so it survives one hit.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters target enemy's Harmful skills, or all their skills if they're Immobile. When it triggers, the user begins Rushing.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and the user Leaps. That Leap isn't spent by the user's next damaging skill.

changes.why: Was Invigorating Breeze plus Freeze Wound; now a delayed heal that rewards the ally's own mobility.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20. If they're Immobile, they begin Rushing; if not, they gain 2 Armor for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 15. The next time they Leap or begin Rushing within 3 turns, they heal 20 more.

changes.why: Was Boreal Aegis plus Swiftwind with an Immobile rider; now makes an Ice ally's Frost debuffs stick longer.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Swiftness and Frostborn until the end of their next turn. Until then, Immobile enemies can't target them.

after.effect: Target ally gains Frostborn for 2 turns. While they're Frostborn, Frost debuffs they apply last 1 turn longer.

changes.why: Gave Shield per Immobile enemy; now the only Titan that shuts off healing for both teams.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Immune, and at the start of each of their turns, 10 Shield for each Immobile enemy.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and no unit in the battle can be healed, the user included.

changes.why: Was Viper Strike with a Frostbitten-per-Toxin bonus; now bends Toxin to tick on every skill the target uses, for Poison teams.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin. If they're Frostbitten, it deals 5 more for each Toxin they have.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, their Toxin also deals its damage each time they use a skill.

changes.why: Was Viper Stance with durations added; now the only Rage that suspends the user's cooldowns, then bills them all at once.

before.effect: All Might in the battle turns into as much Weakness. On allies, it ends at the end of the turn; on enemies, it lasts 3 turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and their skills don't go on cooldown. When it ends, each skill they used meanwhile goes on its full cooldown.

changes.why: Gave Toxin per Frost debuff; now a cheap extender that keeps an Ice team's Frost debuffs up.

before.effect: 5 Piercing damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin, +1 for each Frost debuff they have.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, and each Frost debuff on them lasts 1 turn longer.

changes.why: Was Numbing Needle with a Prey rider; now a new way to earn Frostborn that lasts as long as the Ice team keeps the enemy frosted.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and they gain 1 Toxin, 1 Weakness and 1 Vulnerable. These can't wear off while they're Prey.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user is Frostborn for as long as that enemy has a Frost debuff (max 3 turns).

changes.why: Was Cobra Stance with Shield in place of Armor, and not a mobility skill; now a real Dance that turns any Toxin tick into Prey.

before.effect: All Shield on enemies turns into Toxin, 1 stack per 10 Shield.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Each enemy whose Toxin ticks meanwhile counts as Prey until the user's next turn.

changes.why: Shield leftovers became Toxin; now the only Withstand that rewinds the user's HP to where it stood.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Armor and 20 Shield for 2 turns. When the Shield expires, each 10 left gives a random enemy 1 Toxin.

after.effect: The user gains 10 Shield for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn, they heal all the HP they lost since using this, up to 40.

changes.why: Redirected a skill into a Boulder, then Chilled; now the only Trap that watches every enemy and taxes repeating a skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, the first Harmful skill target enemy uses strikes a new allied Boulder instead. If that destroys the Boulder, they're Chilled for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, whenever any enemy uses the same skill they used on their previous turn, they take 20 damage.

changes.why: Tusk Toss Stunned only Chilled targets; the Mammoth now protects an Ice team's Frost debuffs from cleanses while it lives.

before.effect: Summons a Mammoth (55 HP) permanently. Trample (r): 15 damage to all enemies. Tusk Toss (S): 20 damage, and a 1-turn Stun if the target is Chilled.

after.effect: Summons a Mammoth (55 HP) permanently; while it stands, Frost debuffs on enemies can't be removed. Trample (r): 15 damage to all enemies.

changes.why: Regrowing Trolls with a Chilling club; now a new source of Boulders for Earth players when the Trolls fall.

before.effect: Summons 2 Trolls (20 HP) for 3 turns; each regrows 5 HP at the end of your turns. Club (r): 10 damage and Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons 2 Trolls (20 HP) for 3 turns. Club (r): 10 damage to target enemy. When a Troll dies or expires, it turns to stone: an allied Boulder with 20 HP.

changes.why: Was Stonepierce with Frostbitten-to-Shattered added; now pays off how long an Ice team has kept the target frozen.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they have Shield or Armor. Frostbitten targets are also Shattered for 1 turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, +5 for each turn left on their Frost debuffs (max 25 in all).

changes.why: Was Pitfall's Stun with a Frostbitten fallback; now locks the countered skill away for as long as the Ice team keeps them frosted.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn; if they don't, they're Frostbitten for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and its cooldown doesn't tick down while they have a Frost debuff.

changes.why: Condemned enemies with a Frost debuff; now a delayed second fall that rewards an Ice team for keeping the enemy frozen.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Enemies it hits with a Frost debuff are Condemned for 1 turn, and the user heals 5 for each.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. At the start of the user's next turn, the light falls again: 10 more to each of them who still has a Frost debuff.

changes.why: Chilled Helpful users and Sanctified their targets side by side; now a hidden Condemnation that keeps coming back, for Holy teams.

before.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, they're Chilled for 2 turns and everyone it helped is Sanctified for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, target enemy is Condemned; each time it triggers, it returns at the end of the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was Cloister plus immunity to Frostbitten or Condemned enemies; now the only Maneuver that echoes the user's previous skill.

before.effect: The user gains Immune for 1 turn, and for 2 turns can't be targeted by Frostbitten or Condemned enemies.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. At the start of their next turn, the last skill they used before this one repeats on the same targets, at no cost.

changes.why: Condemned enemies with no Buffs; now the only Blast that strips a Buff from the whole enemy team.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies; those with no Buffs are also Condemned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. Each of them loses the Buff with the most turns left.

changes.why: Healed per Frost debuff and Sanctify on one target; now cashes in every Sanctify the Holy team has spread, a new outlet for it.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. The user heals 10 for each Frost debuff and Sanctify on them.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy. Every Sanctify on the enemy side ends, and the user heals 15 for each.

changes.why: Sanctified Frostbitten targets; now a delayed Chill on whichever of the two moves first.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Each Frostbitten one it hits is Sanctified for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. The first of them to use a skill afterward is Chilled for 2 turns.

changes.why: Set Ice's no-Buffs volley beside Unholy's Soul Fragment sacrifice; now an Ice enabler that freezes every Frost debuff's clock while it stands.

before.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. Rime Volley (r): 10 damage to each enemy without Buffs. Final Offering (nc): it dies, giving the user 1 Soul Fragment per turn it had left.

after.effect: Summons a Skeletal Mage (25 HP) for 3 turns. While it stands, Frost debuffs on enemies don't count down. Bone Chill (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

changes.why: Paid off Numb and Horrified together; now a new outlet that cashes in the user's Frostborn for a Piercing finisher.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Numb or Horrified. If they're both, it's Piercing and the user heals 10.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If the user is Frostborn, it ends, and this deals 15 more and is Piercing.

changes.why: Was Swiftness per Horrified and Focus per Chilled enemy; now a Dance that feeds on any death, on either side, by resetting every cooldown.

before.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Swiftness per Horrified enemy and 1 Focus per Chilled one.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Each time any unit or minion dies meanwhile, all the user's cooldowns reset.

changes.why: Was Might plus healing against Buff-less enemies; now preserves an ally's Buffs in place, general utility no other Bless has.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and heals for half the damage they deal to enemies without Buffs.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their other Buffs don't count down.

changes.why: Heal and Shield plus more per Horrified enemy; now bends Frostborn so Chill and Numb also shut enemies out.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 10 Shield, plus 10 more Shield for each Horrified enemy.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain Frostborn for 1 turn. While it lasts, this Frostborn also makes them Invulnerable to Chilled and Numb enemies, not just Frostbitten ones.
