changes.why: Hurt allies without Frostborn and handed out Soul Fragments; now spreads the target's Frost debuffs to a second enemy.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each ally of the user without Frostborn loses 10 HP; every ally gains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy, who also gains a copy of each Frost debuff on the target, with its duration.

changes.why: Chilled Blinded enemies; now new access to Frostborn, fed by Ice's favorite condition, enemies without Buffs.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies; Blinded enemies hit are Chilled for 2 turns.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. The user gains Frostborn for 1 turn, plus 1 turn for each enemy hit who has no Buffs.

changes.why: Chilled every enemy hit from Stealth; now a Shadow rule bend that lets a Stealthed user attack freely for 3 turns.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Stealth; while Stealthed, every enemy they damage is Chilled for 1 turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and Immune, and using skills doesn't end their Stealth.

changes.why: Countered one enemy's Harmful Strategic skill; now a Trap laid under an ally that catches whichever enemy comes for them.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Harmful Strategic skill, it's countered and they're Chilled for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first enemy to use a Harmful skill on target ally breaks through: they take 20 Piercing damage and are Stunned for 1 turn.

changes.why: Isolated, with more if they had a Frost debuff; now the ally who follows up lands Frostbitten, a new trigger for an Ice status.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Isolated for 1 turn. If they have a Frost debuff, they take 10 more and the Isolation lasts 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Whoever spends the Mark also leaves them Frostbitten for 2 turns.

changes.why: A Wraith with Blind, Chill and Numb side by side; now a minion that always hunts the last enemy to hurt the team.

before.effect: Summons a Frost Wraith (20 HP) for 3 turns. Wail (r): Blinded and Chilled for 1 turn. Grave Chill (I): 15 damage; on a sleeper, it doesn't wake them, and Numbs for 2 turns.

after.effect: Summons a Rime Revenant (20 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, it deals 15 damage to the last enemy who damaged one of the user's allies.

changes.why: Traded Blinded for Frostbitten and Chilled for Blinded; now new access to Sleep that puts a wounded enemy down after the hit.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. Blinded targets are also Frostbitten for 2 turns; Chilled ones are also Blinded for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If it leaves them below 30 HP, they fall Asleep.

changes.why: Chilled when used from Stealth; now lets Stealthed allies strike this target without breaking Stealth.

before.effect: Stealthy. 20 damage and Sanctify for 1 turn; used from Stealth, it also Chills for 2 turns.

after.effect: Stealthy. 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. For 1 turn, allies who damage them keep their Stealth.

changes.why: Blinded any enemy with Swiftness; now an Ice enabler that lengthens every Frost debuff the team lands.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Any with Swiftness lose it all and are Blinded for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Frost debuff they gain lasts 1 turn longer.

changes.why: Turned Wind's Leaping into Lightning's Sapped; now lets a Wind player's Swiftness block every Stun for 2 turns without running out.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If the user is Leaping, they come down hard: every enemy it hits is Sapped.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For 2 turns, the user's Swiftness stops Stuns without being spent.

changes.why: Reflected instead of countering if the user was Rushing; now a new way for a Lightning player to Sap, scaled to what the enemy spent.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; if the user is Rushing, it's Reflected back at its user instead.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Sapped once for each energy it cost.

changes.why: Paid Lightning Charge for stabbing Immobile targets; now an enabler that lets any Wind skill's Immobile payoff land on anyone.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Immobile; stabbing an Immobile target also gives the user 1 Charge.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP, and they count as Immobile until the end of the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was nearly Wind's Sonic Thrust with a Charge rider; now lightning that always finds the tallest enemy, wherever they hide.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the user isn't Rushing, they spend 1 Charge for 15 more damage, or are Stunned for 1 turn if they have none.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to the enemy with the most HP, +15 if they're Stunned. It ignores Stealth, Untargetable and redirection.

changes.why: Stole both Charge and mobility buffs side by side; now bends Lightning's Sapped so a Lightning player's drain keeps biting.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While Taunted, any Charge or mobility buff they would gain goes to the user instead.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. While they're Taunted, reaching 3 Sapped doesn't use it up: they generate 1 less energy every turn it lasts.

changes.why: Scaled its splash by the target's Toxin; now wires the enemies hit into one circuit, so cleansing Toxin from one spreads it to the rest.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy, and 10 to each of their allies, +5 per Toxin the target has.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to each of their allies. For 2 turns, whenever one of them loses Toxin, each other enemy it hit gains 1 Toxin.

changes.why: Paid Charge only off Prey targets; now echoes for a Lightning user who gains Charge off-turn, as Stormborn does.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user gains 2 Charge; if not, they gain 1 Toxin.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. It strikes again at the start of the user's next turn if they gained any Charge in between.

changes.why: Sapped Prey targets up to 3; now bends Sapped itself so its next trigger lasts two turns.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, they're also Sapped until they have 3.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The next time their Sapped reaches 3, it isn't spent, so it cuts their energy for 2 turns in a row.

changes.why: Was a plain heal with a Discharge bonus; now pools the team's HP like cells in one battery, which no other Prayer does.

before.effect: All allies heal 15. Discharge: each heals 5 more per Cell.

after.effect: All allies heal 15. Then their HP is pooled: each ally's HP becomes the average of the team's.

changes.why: Sapped everyone and fed Toxin to Sapped users (a bridge); now punishes any expensive skill, a trigger no other Shout reads.

before.effect: All enemies are Sapped. For 2 turns, each Sapped enemy who uses a skill gains 1 Toxin.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each skill they use that costs 3 or more energy deals them 15 Affliction damage.

changes.why: Sapped enemies once per Armor they held; now a new Lightning outlet that turns the user's own Charge into Sapped on every enemy.

before.effect: 25 damage to all enemies, and each is Sapped once per Armor they have.

after.effect: 25 damage to all enemies. The user spends all their Charge, and each enemy is Sapped once per Charge spent.

changes.why: Was a Sapping swarm with a mobility lock; now a minion stuck to one enemy that can't be picked off on its own, which no other Summon does.

before.effect: Summons 2 Iron Filing swarms (15 HP) for 3 turns. Cling (r): target enemy is Sapped and can't gain mobility buffs for 1 turn.

after.effect: Summons an Iron Filing swarm (20 HP) for 3 turns, clinging to target enemy: only skills that also hit that enemy can damage it. Grind (r): 10 Piercing damage to that enemy.

changes.why: Hit every enemy holding Armor or Charge, reading both parents' statuses; now gives a Lightning user a new way to earn Charge from hits on the team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and to every enemy with Armor or Charge.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, they gain 1 Charge each time an ally takes damage.

changes.why: Was a Taunting Boulder that Sapped its attacker (both parents side by side); now a two-way lock that pins the user and one enemy to each other.

before.effect: Creates a Boulder; target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, and is Sapped each time they damage it.

after.effect: Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 2 turns, and the user's Harmful skills can target only them for as long.

changes.why: Absorbed Boulders with Stormborn tacked on; now the armor crumbles back into a Boulder when it ends, recycling Earth's ammunition.

before.effect: The user creates a Boulder, then absorbs every allied Boulder for 1 Armor per 15 HP it had, for 3 turns; they're Immune and Stormborn meanwhile.

after.effect: The user creates a Boulder, then absorbs every allied Boulder for 1 Armor per 15 HP it had, and is Immune, for 3 turns. When it ends, the Armor falls away as one Boulder with 10 HP per stack.

changes.why: Copied the target's Condemned and Sapped side by side; now bends Condemned so everyone it hit pays double when it triggers.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies; the target's Condemned and Sapped are copied onto each ally hit.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. For 2 turns, when any enemy it hit has their Condemnation trigger, they gain two of its Debuffs instead of one.

changes.why: Was Holy Nova with Sapped in place of Anointed; now a rule bend that lets a Lightning user cash in Charge early.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies; Sapped ones take it again at the start of the user's next turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. The user's Charge triggers at 2 instead of 3 until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Turned an ally's 3 Charge into Anointed; now gives Charge spending a healing outlet, whatever spends it.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 1 Charge; if that brings them to 3 Charge, they're also Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. Each time they spend Charge in the next 2 turns, they heal 10.

changes.why: Sapped and Condemned the target side by side on each hit; now a recoil curse that makes any damage they deal cost them, which no other Curse does.

before.effect: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy damages the user or an ally, they're Sapped and Condemned.

after.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each time they deal damage, they take half of it back as Affliction damage.

changes.why: Was Saving Grace's repeat paid with 3 Charge instead of Anointed; now pools the team's scattered Charge into one ally so it triggers.

before.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. If the user has 3 Charge, it's spent to repeat this at the start of their next turn.

after.effect: All allies heal 20 and gain 10 Shield. Then every ally's Charge moves to whichever ally has the most.

changes.why: Was Immortal with Charge and Horrify side by side; now a jolt that throws off a Stun and passes it to an enemy.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn; each hit that leaves them at 5 HP gives them 1 Charge and Horrifies its user for 1 turn.

after.effect: Usable while Stunned. The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and any Stun on them jumps to a random enemy for the turns it had left.

changes.why: Was an Imp that Sapped on death; now a minion stitched from the fallen that borrows a dead unit's skill, which no other Summon does.

before.effect: Summons a Stitched Horror (25 HP) for 3 turns. Gnash (r): 10 Affliction damage to target enemy. When it dies or expires, every enemy takes 10 damage and is Sapped.

after.effect: Summons a Patchwork Revenant (25 HP) for 3 turns with one random skill of the last unit to die, from either side, paid from the user's energy. If no one has died, it has Gnash (r): 10 Affliction damage.

changes.why: Stunned Horrified targets, the stock formula; now a user near death drains Soul Fragments, a new way into Unholy's resource.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP; if they're Horrified, their non-Strategic skills are also stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If the user is at or below 40 HP, it also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

changes.why: Gave Sapped targets permanent Vulnerable; now the Stun opens a window where a Lightning user's Saps land double.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun; if they're Sapped, they also gain 1 permanent Vulnerable.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. While they're Stunned, each Sapped they gain counts twice.

changes.why: Turned Buffs that Horrify blocked into Sapped; now a Horrified death feeds Soul Fragments to the whole team.

before.effect: Target enemy is Horrified for 2 turns; each Buff it stops them gaining Saps them instead.

after.effect: Target enemy is Horrified for 2 turns. If they die before it ends, every ally of the user gains 1 Soul Fragment.

changes.why: Sapped enemies and Horrified the already Sapped; now any death charges the user to full, a new way to earn Charge.

before.effect: All enemies are Sapped; those already Sapped are Horrified for 2 turns instead.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, whenever a unit on either side dies, the user's Charge fills to 3.

changes.why: Spent 3 Charge for Stealth; now lets a Shadow user who Blinds the enemy slip out of their random aim.

before.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn; if they have 3 Charge, it's spent to give them Stealth as well.

after.effect: Stealthy. The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn. Until their next turn, a Blinded enemy's skill can't land on them and goes to another target.

changes.why: Dealt 10 more to Sapped enemies; now grows with the user's own Charge rhythm, rewarding a Lightning user who keeps hitting 3.

before.effect: Channeled and Stealthy, up to 3 turns: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns, +10 to Sapped ones.

after.effect: Channeled and Stealthy, up to 3 turns: 10 damage to all enemies at the end of each of the user's turns, plus 10 for each time the user's Charge has triggered since it began.

changes.why: Was Nightwrap plus Charge per Stealthy skill; now bends Stealth so a hidden support can heal and buff without showing itself.

before.effect: Target ally gains Stealth; each Stealthy skill they use while it lasts gives them 1 Charge.

after.effect: Target ally gains Stealth. For 2 turns, Helpful skills they use don't break it.

changes.why: Blinded all enemies and Sapped them as they acted (both parents side by side); now jams each enemy's last skill, a denial no other Shout has.

before.effect: All enemies are Blinded for 1 turn; each skill a Blinded enemy uses Saps them.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, none of them can use the skill they used most recently.

changes.why: Was the common Shield-survives-into-Stealth pattern; now grounds incoming Sapped and turns it into the user's Charge.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn; if any of it is left at the end, they gain Stealth.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. While it holds, any Sapped they would gain becomes Charge instead.

changes.why: Turned allied Seedlings into Toxin; now locks a Poison player's Toxin onto the target until the Mark is spent.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and 1 Toxin per allied Seedling, Mushrooms included (max 3). If the user has no Seedling, they create one first.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the Mark is spent, their Toxin can't be removed.

changes.why: Hardened the user's Toxin into Armor; now an Earth summoner's minions feed the user Armor whenever they're hit.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. First, all Toxin on the user hardens into as much Armor for those turns.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. Whenever one of their minions takes damage meanwhile, it heals 5 and the user gains 1 Armor for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was heal, then if Toxin make a Seedling; now rewards an Earth player for spending Boulders and Seedlings, since fallen minions feed the heal.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and loses 1 Toxin. If they had any, the user creates a Seedling from the rot.

after.effect: Target ally heals 15, +15 for each allied minion that died since the user's last turn.

changes.why: Was 1 Armor per Toxin on the ally; now a symbiosis that doubles every Buff the pair receives, a buff-sharing link no other Bless has.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and 1 Armor per Toxin on them (max 3).

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and they and the user share Buffs: each Buff either of them gains is copied to the other.

changes.why: Was minions giving 2 Toxin; now a parasite that siphons the target's incoming healing to the user's team, a heal-theft brand no other Smite has.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each time a minion damages them, they gain 2 Toxin.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, half of all healing they receive goes to a random ally of the user instead.

changes.why: Condemned enemies with Toxin; now bends Sanctify so a Holy team's brands heal the whole side for a turn.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each one hit who has Toxin is Condemned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Until the user's next turn, Sanctify on any of them heals every ally of the damager, not only the damager.

changes.why: Anointed the user off Prey; now bends Toxin so a Poison stacker's stacks bite on the enemy's own turn too.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the end of their next turn, their Toxin also ticks each time they use a skill.

changes.why: Was Invulnerable, then if Toxin, Anointed; now marks every attacker as Prey, opening Poison's Prey payoffs without any Toxin.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If they had Toxin, they lose it and are Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Every enemy who uses a Harmful skill meanwhile counts as Prey for 2 turns.

changes.why: Resolved Condemned into all three Prey debuffs; now an antidote for Buffs: it switches off every Buff on the target without removing them.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they're Condemned, it resolves now with all three of Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion, making them Prey.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and Mark for 1 turn. Until the end of their next turn, their Buffs have no effect.

changes.why: Gave Sanctified targets Toxin; now widens Prey's HP line for one target, so a Poison player's Prey payoffs start on the wounded.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they're Sanctified, they also gain 2 Toxin.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. For 2 turns, being at or below 60 HP makes them Prey.

changes.why: Turned allies' Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion into Buffs; now rewards staying clean with faster cooldowns, a tempo engine no other Dance has.

before.effect: All Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion on allies turn into as much Might, Armor and Focus.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might, 2 Swiftness and 1 Focus. At the end of each of their turns, if they have no Debuffs, their other cooldowns drop by 1.

changes.why: Drained a Soul Fragment from Prey or gave Toxin; now lets an Unholy player's Horrified payoffs fire without landing Horrify first.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them; if not, they gain 1 Toxin.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill treats them as Horrified, whether they are or not.

changes.why: Drained Soul Fragments from Prey; now bends Toxin timing so a Poison player's stacks tick an extra time while they hide.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, they drain a Soul Fragment from each enemy that's Prey.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Until it ends, Toxin the user applied ticks at the end of every turn, not only theirs.

changes.why: Cleansed Toxin into Soul Fragments; now a new outlet for an Unholy team's Horrify, turning the enemy's fear into healing.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25 and loses their Toxin; the user gains a Soul Fragment per 2 stacks removed.

after.effect: Target ally heals 15, +10 for each Horrified enemy.

changes.why: Gave Lifesteal against Prey; now hands any ally Poison's Execute, so a Prey-building team gets a finisher on every skill.

before.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Lifesteal against Prey.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might and executes any Prey their skills leave at 15 HP or less.

changes.why: Horrified enemies with 3 Toxin; now the enemy team's support skills hurt whoever they help while it lasts.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; each one with 3 or more Toxin is also Horrified for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Helpful skill they use deals 10 Affliction damage to each of its targets.

changes.why: Drained HP from enemies with Toxin; now a new way for an Unholy player to earn Soul Fragments by being hit.

before.effect: The user drains 5 HP from each enemy with Toxin, then gains 20 Shield for 1 turn, plus twice the total drained.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. Whoever breaks it has a Soul Fragment drained by the user.

changes.why: Blinded the attacker and made them Prey while Blinded; now a new outlet that detonates a Poison player's Toxin stacks on whoever swings.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; its user is Blinded for 2 turns and counts as Prey while Blinded.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, counters the first Harmful skill used on the user; all Toxin on its user ticks twice at once.

changes.why: Was a dart, then if Blinded 2 Toxin; now locks a Poison player's stacks in place against cleanses.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Blinded, they also gain 2 Toxin.

after.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their Toxin, Weakness and Vulnerable can't be removed.

changes.why: Gave a healed ally the Death Mark; now the designer's trap that watches every enemy and punishes any skill at all.

before.effect: Invisible, 3 turns. The first time target enemy uses a Helpful skill on an ally, that ally gains your Death Mark and 2 Toxin.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, all enemies take 5 Affliction damage whenever they use any skill.

changes.why: Gave attackers Toxin and Blind side by side; now bends Stealth so a Shadow team can attack from hiding for a turn.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Each enemy who damaged them since their last turn gains 1 Toxin and is Blinded for 1 turn.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Meanwhile, Stealthed allies stay Stealthed whatever skills they use.

changes.why: Blinded 1 turn per 2 Toxin; now stretches a Shadow team's Blinds and Isolations across every enemy.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. They're Blinded for 1 turn per 2 Toxin they have (max 3).

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and every Blind and Isolation on the enemy team lasts 1 more turn.

changes.why: Ticked Toxin on Sleepers without waking them; now lets a Shadow player keep Stealth while carving up enemies who can't see them.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Asleep, and their Toxin ticks once now. None of this wakes them.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Against a Blinded or Sleeping target, it's Stealthy.

changes.why: Doubled Sanctify healing on Prey; now each ally's hit sours a Buff into Vulnerable, pushing the target toward Prey Poison-style.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 2 turns. While they're Prey, allies who damage them heal twice as much.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them turns 1 of their Buffs into 1 Vulnerable.

changes.why: Was Nightfall gated on Toxin; now bends Toxin so a Poison team's self-poisoning (Bad Stomach, Moonglove) becomes healing.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; those with Toxin lose it and gain Stealth.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, Toxin on the user's allies heals them instead of harming them.

changes.why: Gave Stealth or Toxin off a Shield; now a hidden Shield the enemy can't plan around that also slows the skills spent on it.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If it's intact when their next turn starts, they gain Stealth; if it breaks, the breaker gains 2 Toxin.

after.effect: Invisible. The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Each enemy skill that hits it has its cooldown raised by 1.

changes.why: Was a decoy giving Toxin and Blind side by side; now bends Stealth so a hidden Shadow player taunts, leaving the enemy's single-target skills nowhere to go.

before.effect: Creates a Venom Decoy (5 HP); target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn. If they hit it, they gain 2 Toxin and are Blinded for 1 turn.

after.effect: Stealthy. Target enemy is Taunted by the user for 1 turn, even while the user is Stealthed and can't be targeted.

changes.why: Condemned enemies if a Boulder stood; now an Earth trade-off that spends Boulder HP as extra quake damage.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. If an allied Boulder stands, each enemy hit is Condemned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Each allied Boulder loses 15 HP and adds 5 to every hit.

changes.why: Made a Boulder off Sanctified targets; now a new route to Anointed for a Holy healer who keeps supporting the team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user creates a Boulder.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user healed or shielded an ally since their last turn, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Anointed the user if they had a Seedling; now gives an Earth grower a one-at-a-time path to Worldsprouts without sacrificing the rest.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Seedling, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and one allied Seedling grows into a Worldsprout.

changes.why: Chiseled Armor and Condemned side by side; now lets a Holy player cash in Condemned on their own timing.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. If they have Armor, 1 is chiseled off and they're Condemned.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Their Condemned resolves now, as if they'd used a skill.

changes.why: Was Piercing, then if Condemned +10 per Boulder; now an Earth outlet that turns stacked Armor into damage at the cost of 1 Armor.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Condemned, each allied Boulder and Wardstone adds 10.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per Armor the user has. Then the user loses 1 Armor.

changes.why: Anointed allies with 2 Armor; now a sanctuary's rest that pays out big for a turn spent not attacking, a condition no other Heal reads.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25. If they have 2 or more Armor, they're also Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. If they use no Harmful skill on their next turn, they heal 30 more at its end.

changes.why: Gave Armor per Condemned enemy hit; now bends Sanctify so a Holy team's brands still pay out to allies at full HP.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. Each one hit that's Condemned gives the user 1 Armor for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, Sanctify on either one gives its damager 15 Shield instead of healing.

changes.why: Was a hit that drained a Soul Fragment if anything had died; now a fallen minion becomes a Boulder, new Boulder access for Earth players.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If a unit or minion died since the user's last turn, the user also drains a Soul Fragment from them.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, the next allied minion to die leaves a Boulder where it fell.

changes.why: Was a Stun bonus plus Horrified stripping Armor; now an Unholy user turns Immortal into fuel, spending HP they can't lose.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Stunned. A Horrified target loses all their Shield and Armor first.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. While the user is Immortal, it also costs them 20 HP and deals 20 more.

changes.why: Was Earth's Pitfall with minion hits added; now the countered skill stays locked until someone dies.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn, and each allied minion deals them 10 damage.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and buried: they can't use it again until a unit dies.

changes.why: Was Earth's Infuse Earth with an Immortal fallback; now a death passes the fallen ally's Buffs on as an inheritance.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random; below 30 HP, they're Immortal for 1 turn instead.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might for 3 turns. If they die meanwhile, each of their allies gains a copy of every Buff they had, for its remaining duration.

changes.why: Was a Boulder plus a Stun on Blinded enemies, side by side; now the quake wakes every Seedling's Channel Earth for free, a new outlet for Earth minion play.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. It creates a Boulder for the user, and Blinded enemies hit are Stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to their allies. Then every allied Seedling uses Channel Earth at no cost.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Blinding Shade plus Untargetable Earth minions; now the Moths bend Blind so a Blinded enemy's attacks are wasted on them, a rule bend for Shadow Blind play.

before.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. Dust (r): target enemy is Blinded for 1 turn. While a Moth lives, allied Boulders and Seedlings are Untargetable.

after.effect: Summons 2 Moon Moths (10 HP) for 3 turns. While one lives, Blinded enemies' single-target skills always strike a Moth. Flutter (r): 10 damage to target enemy.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Backstab with a Boulder in place of Blind; now it converts a Shadow Blind into Isolation, cutting a low target off from their healers.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is Stealthed or has an allied Boulder to strike from behind.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Their Blind ends, and they're Isolated for the turns it had left.

changes.why: Was Shadow's Blinding Powder with a minion-Stun rider; now a tidal rhythm locks half the target's kit each turn, alternating which half.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns; each time their skill lands on a minion instead of their target, they're Stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target enemy's skills are Stunned in alternation: non-Strategic ones on their first and third turns, Strategic ones on their second.

changes.why: Was Shadow Mockery with a bigger Boulder and Stealth; now the Taunt moves like moonlight to whoever struck last, so any teammate can pull the enemy.

before.effect: Creates a Stone Double: a Boulder (20 HP) in the user's likeness. Target enemy is Taunted by it for 2 turns, and the user gains Stealth.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Each time an ally of the user damages them, the Taunt passes to that ally.

changes.why: Was Invulnerable plus a mass Explosion of Ignited enemies, Fire's default payoff; now a rule bend that makes the user's Ignites tick twice while they're out of reach.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. When it ends, every Ignited enemy Explodes.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. While it lasts, each Ignite the user applied also deals its damage at the start of its bearer's turn.

changes.why: Was a counter that Ignited or Stunned by formula; now watches every enemy for their big play and steals energy from it, which no other Mislead does.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. If they're Ignited, they're also Stunned for 1 turn; otherwise they're Ignited.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, the first enemy skill that costs 3 or more energy is countered, and its gold is taken: next turn, its user generates 1 less energy and the user 1 more.

changes.why: Was a Stun plus Intimidated if Ignited; now gives Explosion builds a new outlet, turning their next Explosion into a second Stun.

before.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun. Ignited targets are also Intimidated for 2 turns.

after.effect: 15 damage and a 1-turn Stun to target enemy. For 2 turns, the first Explosion the user's side causes Stuns them again for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was a Dance that spread Ignite if any enemy was Ignited; now lets a burn-heavy Fire character heal the team from their Ignites, a support role Fire lacks.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus. At the end of each of their turns, if any enemy is Ignited, a random enemy that isn't is Ignited too.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus, and each time an Ignite they applied deals damage, the ally with the least HP heals as much.

changes.why: Was Intimidated plus Scorched on Ignited enemies; now a new trigger that earns Ignite whenever enemies heal, punishing the sustain Scorched only halves.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; Ignited ones are also Scorched for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. For as long, each time one of them is healed, they're Ignited.

changes.why: Was a Taunt on every Ignited enemy plus Armor; now a territorial Taunt that also taxes every other enemy for attacking anyone but the dragon.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy and every Ignited enemy for 2 turns. The user gains 1 Armor for each enemy Taunted, for 2 turns.

after.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns. Meanwhile, any other enemy who uses a Harmful skill on the user's allies takes 10 damage.

changes.why: Was Water's Dunk with Numb in place of Confusion; now a rule bend that turns every Chill on the enemy team into a cost increase, not just a cap on discounts.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Numb for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered. For 2 turns after it triggers, every Chilled enemy's skills cost 1 more.

changes.why: Was a heal plus Numb on the last attacker; now it caps how much HP the ally can lose in a turn, which no other Heal does.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the enemy who last damaged them is Numb for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, they can't lose more than 25 HP in a single turn.

changes.why: Was a Shield sized by enemies with Frost debuffs; now one Shield shared by the whole team, a team-wide pool no other Withstand has.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns, plus 10 for each enemy with a Frost debuff (Brittle counts).

after.effect: The user gains 30 Shield for 2 turns, linked to every ally: damage any ally takes comes out of it first.

changes.why: Was Water's Quiet Fury (Flow and Might) with rising Might; now carries Water's Stun extension onto every hit, so a Stun-lock team wants it.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains Flow, and 1 Might at the start of each of their turns, rising like the tide (up to 3).

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might, and the first time they damage each Stunned enemy, that enemy's Stuns last 1 turn longer.

changes.why: Was a Shield-strip drain unrelated to Water's play; now a new outlet that turns Water's Confusion into healing for the user.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy; their Shield washes away, and the user heals as much as it held, up to 30.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, and the user heals 5. For 2 turns, each extra energy their Confusion makes them pay heals the user 10.

changes.why: Was Water's Call Rain with healing that ramps; now a rule bend that holds every ally's Renew at full while the tide stands still.

before.effect: Channeled, up to 4 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, all enemies take 5 damage and all allies heal 5; both rise by 5 each turn it continues.

after.effect: Channeled, up to 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies. While it channels, allies' Renew doesn't lose stacks when it heals.

changes.why: Already revealed enemy Invisible effects once; now its echolocation keeps revealing new ones for 2 turns, a Shout that answers counters and Traps.

before.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns, and every Invisible effect they own is revealed.

after.effect: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable for 2 turns. Every Invisible effect they own is revealed, and any they create in the next 2 turns is revealed as it's made.

changes.why: Was Invulnerable plus 2 Charge, an upgrade of Lightning's Blink; now lightning strikes twice: it readies the user's last skill again, cooldown utility no other Maneuver has.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 2 Charge.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and the last skill they used before this comes off cooldown.

changes.why: Was 25 Piercing plus 15 more if the target had a counter or Trap; now a rule bend that makes Sapped bite sooner and stick.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage. If the target has an active counter, reflect or Trap, it's destroyed and they take 15 more.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, their Sapped can't be removed, and it takes effect at 2 stacks instead of 3.

changes.why: Was a heal that ended Stuns and gave Charge if it did; now a rule bend on the Charge cap, so a Charge build can bank a bigger turn.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20, and their Stuns and Sleep end; if they had any, they also gain 1 Charge.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20. For 2 turns, their Charge can build past 3 to 5; at 5, it's spent and they generate 2 extra energy next turn.

changes.why: Was 2 Charge and Stormborn, more of Lightning's own Buffs; now lets an ally discharge their own Sapped into enemies through their attacks.

before.effect: Target ally gains 2 Charge and Stormborn for 2 turns.

after.effect: For 2 turns, each time target ally damages an enemy, one of the ally's Sapped stacks moves onto that enemy; if the ally has none, the enemy gains 1 Sapped.

changes.why: Was Stormborn, Armor and a flat damage reflect, close to Lightning's EXO-Armor; now a lightning rod that pulls every area attack onto the user.

before.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Stormborn, and anyone who damages them takes 10 damage.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immune, and draws the storm: enemy skills that would hit more than one of the user's allies hit only the user instead.

changes.why: Was Invulnerable plus Debuff removal, like Ocean's Sounding and Crystal Cocoon; now a rule bend that lets a Wind character hold Rushing through idle turns.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn, and all their Debuffs evaporate.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and begins Rushing. For 3 turns, their Rushing doesn't end after a turn with no skill used.

changes.why: Was a counter that made the user and an ally Untargetable, unrelated to Wind; now an enabler that switches on Wind's Immobile payoffs against any enemy.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and the user and a random ally become Untargetable for 1 turn.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered, and for 2 turns they count as Immobile even if they have mobility skills or buffs.

changes.why: Was a formula (Confusion if Immobile, else lose mobility buffs); now delays every skill the enemy uses by a turn, so their Invulnerability, heals and counters all arrive late.

before.effect: If target enemy is Immobile, they gain 2 Confusion for 2 turns; otherwise they lose all mobility buffs.

after.effect: For 2 turns, target enemy's skills Drift: each lands at the start of their next turn instead of when it's used.

changes.why: Was Lunge plus Focus per Prey enemy; now turns any single-target Toxin skill into a spread onto every Prey enemy.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus for their next skill per enemy already Prey (max 2); then every enemy counts as Prey through the user's next turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. The user's next skill that gives Toxin also gives it to every Prey enemy.

changes.why: Was Devour with a bigger threshold per Debuff; now cashes a Toxin stack in as an execute or as healing.

before.effect: Executes target enemy below 15 HP, +5 per stack of Toxin, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion they have. The threshold is doubled for minions.

after.effect: Removes all Toxin from target enemy. They die if their HP is at most 5 per stack removed; otherwise the user heals 5 per stack.

changes.why: Was a Prey-gated Swiftness and Focus formula; now the user adapts to each skill that hits them, a lasting per-skill resistance no other kit has.

before.effect: For 3 turns, at the start of each of the user's turns, they gain 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus if any enemy is Prey. Prey enemies can't gain Swiftness.

after.effect: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Swiftness at the start of each of their turns. Each enemy skill that damages them meanwhile deals 5 less to them for the rest of the match (max 15 per skill).

changes.why: Was Viper's Crest plus Antidote's Remission conversion; now lets self-Toxin play (Bad Stomach and the like) feed the ally instead of hurting them.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness for 3 turns, and their Weakness and Vulnerable turn into as many Might and Armor.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and Toxin on them heals them for its damage instead of harming them.

changes.why: Was Swamp Toxins with more Toxin per skill; now bends the Prey count so any Poison Debuff turns the target into Prey sooner.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Toxin and 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Each skill they use while Confused gives them 1 more Toxin.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns. Meanwhile, each Debuff stack on them counts as 2 toward Prey.

changes.why: Was Bad Stomach plus Intimidate on new Prey; now locks every enemy's Toxin in place against cleanses and transfers.

before.effect: The user gains 1 Toxin; then every enemy gains as much Toxin as the user has (max 3). Enemies this makes Prey are Intimidated for 2 turns.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. While it lasts, their Toxin can't be removed, moved or reduced.

changes.why: Was Coil with Toxin on Shield hits; now doubles the Weakness that Viper Stance and Sting spread, but only against the user.

before.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and 1 Armor for 2 turns. Each time an enemy damages the Shield, they gain 1 Toxin.

after.effect: The user gains 15 Shield and 1 Armor for 2 turns, during which each Weakness on an enemy lowers their damage to the user by 10 instead of 5.

changes.why: Was Tunnelmaker scaling per minion, Worldfist's trick again; now the wind-up itself tends every allied Seedling.

before.effect: Channeled. In 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy, +10 per allied minion still alive when it lands.

after.effect: Channeled. At the end of each of the user's turns while it channels, Channel Growth. In 2 turns, 50 damage to target enemy.

changes.why: Was a generic anti-healing Stab with nothing Earth in it; now gives spare Seedlings a cheap outlet as ammunition.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they were healed since the user's last turn.

after.effect: Sacrifices the user's Seedling with the least HP, if they have one, to deal 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; otherwise 10 damage.

changes.why: Was Pitfall with Armor per energy; now turns the user's minions into cover that soaks the enemy's skill.

before.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and they're Stunned for 1 turn; the user gains 1 Armor per energy it cost, for 2 turns.

after.effect: Invisible. For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it lands on the user's minion with the most HP instead of its targets. With no minion to take it, it's countered and the user creates a Boulder.

changes.why: Was Infuse Earth with a Flourish rider (bland core row); now it grafts 20 max HP onto an ally for 3 turns, which no other Bless does.

before.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor at random, or both if they're above their starting max HP.

after.effect: For 3 turns, target ally gains 1 Might, and their max HP rises by 20; the extra HP arrives filled and leaves when it ends.

changes.why: Was Weakness plus more Weakness while the user had a Seedling; now shields a young garden from one enemy until it Blooms.

before.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Weakness, and 1 more at the start of each of their next 2 turns while the user has a Seedling.

after.effect: Target enemy gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns, and meanwhile their skills can't target or damage the user's minions.

changes.why: Was Verse of Nurturing with Armor per Seedling; now the whole side shares every hit through its roots, so burst on one ally is spread across the team.

before.effect: Channel Growth twice, then all allies heal 20 and gain 1 Armor for 2 turns per allied Seedling (max 3).

after.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, damage dealt to any unit on the user's side is split evenly among all of them, minions included.

changes.why: Was a Helpful-skill counter that Condemned; now it steals the enemy's first Helpful skill for the user's weakest ally.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a Helpful skill, it's countered and they're Condemned.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, the first Helpful skill target enemy uses is diverted: its effects land on the user's ally with the least HP instead.

changes.why: Was double damage against Condemned targets; now lets a Holy player cash Anointed skills like Sunbeam repeatedly for a turn.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage. Against a Condemned target, it ends the Condemn without triggering it and deals double.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. Until the end of the user's next turn, their skills don't spend their Anointed.

changes.why: Was Excoriate retargeted onto recent attackers with a Sanctify rider; now a battle-wide ceasefire that only Helpful play survives.

before.effect: Bypass. Every enemy who used a Harmful skill since the user's last turn is Condemned for 2 turns; Sanctified ones are also Intimidated for 2 turns.

after.effect: Bypass. For 1 turn, no unit on either side can use Harmful skills.

changes.why: Was the stock shield that marks its breaker (Vigilante, Ritual, Assassin); now a new source of Anointed that lasts as long as the Shield holds.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, the enemy who broke it is Sanctified for 2 turns.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 2 turns, and is Anointed while any of it remains.

changes.why: Was Soul Lance doubled against healed targets; now a long-fuse doom that the enemy's own healing hurries along.

before.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, doubled if they were healed in the meantime. If they end below 50 HP, the user drains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. In 3 turns, 70 Affliction damage to target enemy. Each time they're healed meanwhile, it lands a turn sooner.

changes.why: Was Drain Soul with healing per Fragment held; now harvests every Horrified enemy at once, an outlet for Horrify spread.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, draining a Soul Fragment; then the user heals 5 per Soul Fragment they have.

after.effect: Every Horrified enemy takes 5 damage and loses a Soul Fragment to the user; the user heals 10 per enemy reaped.

changes.why: Was Grisly Spectacle plus damage per Confusion; now flips the self-Confusion Unholy dances pile up into a discount.

before.effect: 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per Confusion the user has; then the user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking). Every Horrify on enemies lasts 1 turn longer.

after.effect: 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, and the user gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns (stacking). For those 2 turns, the user's Confusion lowers their skill costs instead of raising them.

changes.why: Was Consume Lesser pointed at any ally; now a big heal on credit that the ally repays in HP unless they keep attacking.

before.effect: Target ally heals 25; the other ally with the most HP loses 15 to pay for it.

after.effect: Target ally heals 35. At the end of each of their next 2 turns, they lose 10 HP unless they damaged an enemy that turn.

changes.why: Was Profane Chant with team lifesteal; now a team heal whose overflow becomes Soul Fragments for allies who didn't need it all.

before.effect: 20 damage and 2 Weakness for 1 turn to all enemies; the user's allies split the damage dealt as healing.

after.effect: All allies heal 25. Then each ally at full HP gives 10 of it back to gain 1 Soul Fragment.

changes.why: Was bonus damage and Stealth against Isolated targets; now lets a Sleep player hit Sleepers and deepen their sleep.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. If they're Isolated, 10 more, and the user gains Stealth.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. It doesn't wake a Sleeping target, whose Sleep lasts 1 turn longer instead.

changes.why: Was passing Stealth on if Stealthed; now a new, board-read way into Stealth after an attack.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. If the user is Stealthed, they pass their Stealth to a random ally and gain 1 Focus for their next skill.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, Bypassing. The user gains Stealth at the start of their next turn unless an enemy targets them first.

changes.why: Was Night of Knives with more Might while Stealthed; now rewards breaking Stealth, so each ambush out of it hits harder.

before.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, +1 Might each time they use a skill while Stealthed (max 3).

after.effect: Stealthy. For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness, and whenever their Stealth ends, their next skill deals 15 more.

changes.why: Was doubled against evasive targets; now lets a Stealthed user snipe without leaving Stealth.

before.effect: Channeled. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy, Bypassing Invulnerable, doubled if they're Stealthed, Untargetable or Invulnerable when it lands.

after.effect: Channeled, hidden target. On the following turn, 40 damage to target enemy. Channeling and landing it don't end the user's Stealth.

changes.why: Was Nightsong with Isolation each turn; now folds the two sides together, swapping one Debuff for one Buff every turn.

before.effect: Channeled. 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns, and each turn a random enemy is Isolated for 1 turn. If it completes, every Isolated enemy falls Asleep.

after.effect: Channeled, 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, 10 damage to all enemies, and a random ally's Debuff trades places with a random enemy's Buff.

changes.why: Was doubled against Isolated targets then Isolating an ally; now stretches the Shadow Debuffs already on the target.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage, doubled if the target is Isolated; then a random ally of theirs is Isolated for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy; any Blind or Isolation on them lasts 2 turns longer.

changes.why: Was redirecting the countered skill onto the enemy's own ally, Faerie's friendly-fire trick; now the ambushed allies slip into Stealth.

before.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and used instead on a random ally of theirs.

after.effect: Invisible, 1 turn. If target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it's countered and each of its targets gains Stealth.

changes.why: Was bonus damage per Blind, Isolation or Sleep; now an echo that pays for staying in Stealth.

before.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, +10 to each who is Blinded, Isolated or Asleep.

after.effect: Stealthy. 10 damage to all enemies, repeated at the start of the user's next turn if they're still Stealthed.

changes.why: Was a Shield that gave Stealth when broken; now what the Shield absorbs reappears as Shield on the weakest ally.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 2 turns. When it breaks, the user gains Stealth.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. Damage it absorbs is folded across: the ally with the least HP gains that much Shield for 1 turn.

changes.why: Paid off Renew or Charge and stripped one of each; now new access to Charge from being targeted, for Lightning kits that spend it.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they have Renew or Charge; they lose 1 of each.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. For 1 turn, the user gains 1 Charge each time an enemy skill targets them.

changes.why: Sapped Stunned targets per turn of Stun; now a new outlet that turns the user's Renew into cooldown recovery.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Stunned, they also gain 1 Sapped per turn of Stun left.

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. The user spends up to 3 Renew, and each one spent cuts their other cooldowns by 1.

changes.why: Cleansed Sapped for extra healing; now a Water rule bend that holds every Renew stack on the ally for 2 turns.

before.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 2 Renew. Their Sapped is removed, and they heal 10 more per stack.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20 and gains 2 Renew. For 2 turns, their Renew heals without losing stacks.

changes.why: Healed on Charge gains, a bridge; now a team heal that swells over three turns unless the user is hit, which no other Prayer does.

before.effect: All allies heal 15 and gain 2 Renew. For 2 turns, each time an ally gains Charge, they heal 10.

after.effect: All allies heal 10. The healing repeats at the start of each of the user's next 2 turns, 10 more each time (20, then 30), and stops once the user takes damage.

changes.why: Confused Immobile enemies hit; now a new outlet that turns banked Swiftness into splash damage for Wind kits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. Each enemy hit who is Immobile gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to their allies. The user spends all their Swiftness; each stack spent adds 10 to every hit.

changes.why: Stripped Swiftness or gave Confusion; now a Water timing trick that fires the whole team's Renew early for free.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. They lose 1 Swiftness, or gain 1 Confusion if they have none.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. Every ally's Renew heals once now, without losing a stack.

changes.why: Stripped Swiftness and Renew side by side; now a Water rule bend where Confusion also slows the enemy's cooldowns.

before.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. Each loses all Swiftness and Renew, and takes 5 more per stack lost.

after.effect: 20 damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, each Confusion an enemy gains comes with 1 Intimidated for as long.

changes.why: Paid off Immobile with Rushing; now a Consume that drinks back whatever healing the enemy just received.

before.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. If they're Immobile, the user heals 15 more and begins Rushing.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. The user also heals as much as that enemy was healed since the user's last turn, up to 30.

changes.why: Paid off Confusion with Rushing; now a new outlet that steals Water's Weakness and turns it into the user's Might.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're Confused; on 20, the user begins Rushing.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 if they're at or below 60 HP. The user takes 1 Weakness from them and gains it as 1 Might for 1 turn.

changes.why: Stunned all skills only when Confused; now a full Stun whose dodged Swiftness is stolen, new access for Wind kits.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and stuns their Strategic skills for 1 turn, or all their skills if they're Confused.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. Any Swiftness they spend to ignore it goes to the user.

changes.why: Turned stripped mobility buffs into Confusion; now a Wind enabler that makes anyone Immobile for Wind's many Immobile payoffs.

before.effect: Target enemy loses all mobility buffs and gains 1 Confusion for 2 turns, +1 per buff lost (max 3).

after.effect: Target enemy counts as Immobile for 2 turns, whatever skills or buffs they have, and gains 1 Weakness.

changes.why: Gave Confusion beside Rushing for attackers; now reshapes Sanctify into Renew, new access for Water kits.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 1 Confusion for 1 turn. For 1 turn, each ally who damages them begins Rushing.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn; it gives allies who damage them 3 Renew instead of healing 15.

changes.why: Kept a Leap and added Confusion if Leaping; now steals mobility buffs off both enemies hit.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. If the user is Leaping, the Leap isn't spent and both gain 1 Confusion.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each loses 1 mobility buff, which the user gains.

changes.why: Taunt with Confusion beside Rushing; now the only Invisible Taunt: the enemy doesn't know their skills are being drawn to the user.

before.effect: Taunts target enemy for 2 turns, and they gain 1 Confusion each time they damage the user. The user begins Rushing.

after.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, target enemy's single-target Harmful skills hit the user instead, whoever they aim at.

changes.why: Gave Renew only against Prey; now a Water-style cooldown push on the user's next skill, with no status needed.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus, or 2 Focus and 2 Renew if the target is Prey.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user gains 1 Focus, and the next skill they use has its cooldown cut by 1.

changes.why: Scaled with Toxin and Renew side by side; now a Stab split into four small doses over time, which no other Stab does.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, +5 per Toxin and Renew on them (max +15).

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy now and at the start of each of their next 3 turns. Each dose is 15 instead while they're at or below 60 HP.

changes.why: Gave Renew per Toxin to attackers; now new access to Poison's Execute for the whole team.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and 1 Toxin. For 1 turn, allies who damage them gain 1 Renew per Toxin on them (max 3).

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and Sanctify for 1 turn. For 1 turn, an ally who damages them executes them if it leaves them below 15 HP.

changes.why: Was the stock 'hit, then if they used a Helpful skill, Isolate and more'; now makes a Water player's Stuns stick against Swiftness and cleanses.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy. If they used a Helpful skill since the user's last turn, they're Isolated for 1 turn and this deals 10 more.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy, and silt settles on them for 2 turns: Swiftness can't stop Stuns on them, and those Stuns can't be removed.

changes.why: Turned Water's Weakness into Might; now bends Earth's Armor so an Armor-stacking Earth player is covered against Piercing hits too.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For each Weakness either has, the user gains 1 Might for 2 turns.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Until the user's next turn, their Armor also reduces Piercing damage.

changes.why: Was a bridge that Isolated Stunned enemies; now a cost floor that bogs down every cheap, spammable enemy skill, which no other kit does.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Stunned ones are buried as well: Isolated for 2 turns, so their allies can't reach them.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. For as long, each of their skills costs at least 2 energy; cheaper ones gain random costs to make up the difference.

changes.why: Was Dive plus Cloister with an 'if they lost Debuffs, Anointed' rider; now a new way for a Holy player to spread Condemned while untouchable.

before.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and loses all Debuffs; if they lost any, they're Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: The user becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Every enemy who uses a Harmful skill during it is Condemned.

changes.why: Was a healer that Anointed the team on death; now a killable font that freezes every Debuff in the fight while it stands.

before.effect: Summons a Font Spirit (20 HP) for 3 turns. Pour (nc): target ally heals 10. If the Spirit is killed, every ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

after.effect: Summons a Baptismal Font (25 HP) for 3 turns. Pour (nc): target ally heals 10. While it stands, no unit on either side can gain Debuffs.

changes.why: Was a neutral 'more Debuffs than the user' check; now keeps a Water player's short Weakness bursts on the target longer.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they have more Debuffs than the user.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Each Weakness on them lasts 1 turn longer.

changes.why: Was a generic Buff-stripper close to other kits' Ravages; now bends Water's Flow so it also cuts through Shield.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each Buff it washes off them (up to 2).

after.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, the user's Flow also lets their skills ignore Shield.

changes.why: Was a bridge that Condemned them if a Debuff was cleansed; now tithes the extra energy any Confusion costs them to the user's player.

before.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. If any of their Debuffs is removed before then, they're Condemned.

after.effect: Target enemy is Confused for 2 turns. Each time Confusion raises the cost of a skill they use, the user's player gains 1 random energy per energy it added.

changes.why: Was Grave Step plus Water's Renew side by side; now a new way for an Unholy player to harvest Soul Fragments from whoever hits them.

before.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn, then gains 1 Renew for every 10 HP they lost during it.

after.effect: Invisible. The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn and drains a Soul Fragment from each enemy who damages them during it.

changes.why: Spent Water's Renew to drain an Unholy Soul Fragment; now an extra, free Renew tick for any Water player who keeps Renew up.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If the user has 3 or more Renew, they spend 3 to deal 15 more and drain a Soul Fragment from them.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. The user's Renew heals them once now, without losing a stack.

changes.why: Was a bridge that tied the Stun to Unholy's Horrify; now a Stun the enemy can only end early by spending a heal on the fainted unit.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. If they're Horrified, the Stun lasts as long as the Horrify does.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, and they faint: Stunned until they're healed, up to 2 turns.

changes.why: Was a bland Blood Price heal; now the ally's last attacker pays for the healing in their own blood.

before.effect: Blood Price. Target ally heals 30.

after.effect: Target ally heals 20, and the enemy who damaged them most recently loses as much HP.

changes.why: Was 'hit, then heal off targets with Weakness or Confusion'; now bends Unholy's Lifesteal to feed on damage over time as well.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The user heals for the damage dealt to any that have Weakness or Confusion.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. For 2 turns, the user's Lifesteal also heals them for their ticking and Affliction damage.

changes.why: Was Unholy's Misery with Water's Renew stitched on; now bends Renew for a Water player so it ticks on the enemy's turns too.

before.effect: The user drains 10 HP from each other ally and gains 20 Shield plus the total. At the end of the user's next turn, each of those allies gains 3 Renew.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. While it holds, their Renew also heals at the end of each enemy turn.

changes.why: Was 'if Stealthed, cut cooldowns'; now bends Shadow's Stealth so a Stealthed user can support allies without being revealed.

before.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. If the user is Stealthed, their other cooldowns drop by 1.

after.effect: Stealthy. 15 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, Helpful skills the user uses don't break their Stealth.

changes.why: Was Blackbolt plus 'if already Blinded, stun'; now a new way to earn Water's cooldown cuts by following up on the Mark.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns. If they were already Blinded, the glare also stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. The ally who spends the Mark has their other cooldowns cut by 1.

changes.why: Was the same 'bonus on Asleep, doesn't wake them' Stab as Night's; now a new outlet that cashes a Water player's Confusion into damage.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if they're Asleep; it doesn't wake them.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. Any Confusion on them shatters: it ends, and they take 10 Affliction per stack.

changes.why: Turned Shadow's Sleep into Water's Confusion; now each wake-up passes the Sleep along, so a Shadow player's Sleep keeps rolling.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Sleep. When they wake, they're groggy: 2 Confusion for 2 turns.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and Sleep. When they wake, the ripple spreads: a random ally of theirs falls Asleep.

changes.why: Was Nightfall and Rainsong split by a Stealth check; now a new, board-reading way for a Shadow team to earn Stealth.

before.effect: All allies heal 20. Each ally already Stealthed gains 3 Renew; the rest gain Stealth.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each ally who takes no damage in a turn gains Stealth at its end.

changes.why: Was 'hit, then Blinded ones gain Weakness'; now a trade-off that turns a Water team's spare Renew into damage.

before.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; any Blinded one it hits also gains 2 Weakness for 1 turn.

after.effect: 25 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. Each ally with Renew gives up 1 stack to add 5 to both hits.

changes.why: Was the stock 'Intimidate, then Blinded or Asleep ones take more'; now flips every enemy's cooldowns, a gamble no other kit offers.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns; those already Blinded or Asleep also take 15 Affliction.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns. Each enemy's cooldowns are mirrored: their ready skills go on cooldown for 1 turn, and those on cooldown become ready.

changes.why: Was Rushing with a Toxin rider side by side; now a Wind Leap that survives one extra hit, so a Leap player gets its bonus twice.

before.effect: The user begins Rushing. For 2 turns, each enemy they damage also gains 1 Toxin.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy, then the user Leaps. The first damaging skill they use afterwards doesn't end the Leap.

changes.why: Turned Immobile targets into Prey; now bends Wind's Rushing so its turn-start gifts are shared with the team.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. If they're Immobile, they also count as Prey for 2 turns.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. For 2 turns, whenever the user's Rushing grants them Swiftness and Focus, a random ally gains the same.

changes.why: Was a Toxin cash-in gated on Rushing; now a drain that trades a Debuff for a Buff, which no other Consume does.

before.effect: Target enemy takes 5 Affliction damage per Toxin on them and loses it; the user heals that much. If the user is Rushing, the Toxin stays.

after.effect: 5 damage to target enemy, healing the user for it. Then a changeling swap: the user's newest Debuff moves to them, and their newest Buff moves to the user.

changes.why: Ticked Toxin now, twice if Rushing; now a Poison rule bend that makes any team's Toxin tick on the victim's turn too.

before.effect: 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, and their Toxin ticks once now, or twice if the user is Rushing.

after.effect: Target enemy takes 10 Piercing damage, and until the user's next turn their Toxin ticks at the end of each of their own turns as well.

changes.why: Was 'Leap if Prey, else Toxin'; now a new outlet that turns Wind's stockpiled Swiftness into damage.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Prey, the user Leaps; otherwise they gain 2 Toxin.

after.effect: The user spends all their Swiftness, then deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 per stack spent.

changes.why: Paid extra damage off Prey; now a new way to create Prey, reading the board instead of stacks.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; each Prey it hits sends another 10 at a random enemy.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 10 to a random other enemy; whichever of the two has less HP afterwards is marked as Prey for 2 turns.

changes.why: Gave Toxin to attackers, doubled if Rushing; now an untouched shield becomes a Leap, new Leap access for Wind players.

before.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn; each enemy who damages it gains 1 Toxin, or 2 if the user is Rushing.

after.effect: The user gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. If any of it is left when the turn ends, the user Leaps.

changes.why: Was '15 damage; against a Leaper, Bypass and end the Leap'; now new Leap access for a Wind player who stays untouched.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Against a Leaping target, it Bypasses and ends their Leap.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. The user Leaps if no enemy has damaged them since their last turn.

changes.why: Armor or Shield stripped mobility buffs; now an Earth minion payoff that turns Seedlings and Boulder launches into a finisher.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. If they have Armor or Shield, they're weighed down: they lose their mobility buffs and can't gain any for 1 turn.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. When an allied minion's hit spends the Mark, it deals 20 more instead of 10.

changes.why: Was guards that leave Boulders; now a minion that banks unspent energy for later, an escort the enemy must choose to kill.

before.effect: Summons 2 Caravan Guards (20 HP) for 3 turns; a Guard that dies leaves a Boulder. Spear (r): 10 damage.

after.effect: Summons a Pack Mule (25 HP) for 3 turns. At the end of each of the user's turns, it stores 1 unspent energy (max 3); when it expires, the user's player gets it all back. If killed, it's lost.

changes.why: Stripped Armor and Shield from Immobile targets; now a Wind trade-off that cashes the user's own speed into one hit.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If they're Immobile, the sand scours them first: they lose all Armor and Shield.

after.effect: The user gives up all their mobility buffs; then 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +10 for each one given up.

changes.why: Gave Earth's Might and Armor while Rushing; now each move a mobile ally makes gives an Earth player a Boulder.

before.effect: Target ally begins Rushing, and has 1 Might and 1 Armor for as long as their Rushing lasts.

after.effect: Target ally gains 1 Might for 3 turns. Each time they use a mobility skill meanwhile, the user creates a Boulder.

changes.why: Made Boulders from Immobile enemies; now an Earth Boulder used as bait that punishes whoever shoots at it.

before.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and the user creates a Boulder for each enemy that is Immobile.

after.effect: All enemies are Intimidated for 2 turns, and the user creates a Boulder. Each time an enemy damages that Boulder, they're Intimidated for 1 more turn.

changes.why: Was a Shield that stripped attackers' mobility buffs; now an undisturbed camp heals the whole team, a new 'no damage' trigger.

before.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn; each enemy who damages it loses their mobility buffs.

after.effect: The user gains 25 Shield for 1 turn. If nothing hits it, every ally heals 15 at the start of the user's next turn.

changes.why: Was 'Leap if Sanctified'; now a Holy rule bend that turns one Sanctify into a team heal.

before.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. If they're Sanctified, the user Leaps.

after.effect: 15 damage to target enemy. Until the user's next turn, a Sanctify on them heals the damager's whole team, not just the damager.

changes.why: Condemned enemies that were Leaping or Invulnerable; now lets a Holy player's Condemns fire on every skill for 2 turns.

before.effect: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies, Bypassing Invulnerable; each one who was Leaping or Invulnerable loses it and is Condemned.

after.effect: 20 Piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, their Condemnations don't end when they trigger.

changes.why: Was +15 if Condemned and a Leap if Anointed; now a Wind sequencing hit: rise out of reach, then strike.

before.effect: 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +15 if they're Condemned. If the user is Anointed, they spend it to Leap afterwards.

after.effect: The user Leaps. At the start of their next turn, they dive onto target enemy for 30 Piercing damage, with the Leap's bonus.

changes.why: Condemned, stunning only Immobile targets; now a real Stun that hands Anointed to whichever ally follows up.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and they're Condemned; if they're Immobile, they're also Stunned for 1 turn.

after.effect: Target enemy is Stunned for 1 turn. The first ally to damage them before it ends heals 15 and is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

changes.why: Made the user Anointed while Rushing; now the user's Swiftness protects the whole team from Stuns.

before.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness and begins Rushing; while they're Rushing, they're Anointed.

after.effect: For 4 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 2 Swiftness. Whenever an ally would be Stunned meanwhile, the user spends 1 Swiftness to shrug it off for them.

changes.why: Gave Swiftness for Sanctified hits; now new Leap access that shields the weakest ally with a Leap's Invulnerability.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; for each Sanctified one hit, every ally gains 1 Swiftness.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy. The downdraft lifts the ally with the least HP: they Leap.

changes.why: Gummed up a mobility buff for a Soul Fragment; now links the target to their team's pain, so every hit on any enemy also reaches them.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they have a mobility buff, it's gummed up: they lose it, and the user gains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, whenever one of their allies takes direct damage, they take 5 Affliction damage too.

changes.why: Was Horrify plus mobility-buff denial side by side; now new Soul Fragment access for any ally who follows up.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Horrified for 2 turns; they lose their mobility buffs and, being Horrified, can't regain them.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. Whoever spends the Mark drains a Soul Fragment from them.

changes.why: Was Affliction plus a drain against Immobile targets; now a cheap knife that reaches enemies no other skill can target.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy. If they're Immobile, it's Affliction damage and drains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. It ignores Taunt, and it can target Stealthed or Untargetable enemies.

changes.why: Healed the user if Leaping or Rushing; now an Unholy rule bend that stretches Horrified from blocking Buffs to blocking healing.

before.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy; if the user is Leaping or Rushing, they heal for the damage dealt.

after.effect: 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, a Horrify on them also stops them from being healed.

changes.why: Gave Soul Fragments to Leaping or Rushing allies; now a Wind rule bend that lets Swiftness break Taunts as well as Stuns.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; each one who is Leaping or Rushing also gains a Soul Fragment.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. For 2 turns, each ally's Swiftness also shrugs off a Taunt, spending 1 stack.

changes.why: Leapt if either was Horrified; now Wind's Isolation cuts the healthier enemy off from their allies' help.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; if either is Horrified, the user Leaps.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and 15 to a random other enemy; whichever of them has more HP is Isolated for 1 turn.

changes.why: Punished mobility with Sleep; now a Trap that watches Buffs instead of skills, wearing down every Buff the target gains.

before.effect: Invisible. For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a mobility skill or gains a mobility buff, they take 20 Piercing damage and fall Asleep.

after.effect: Invisible. For 3 turns, whenever target enemy gains a Buff, they take 10 Piercing damage and the Buff lasts 1 turn less.

changes.why: Made Blinded targets count as Immobile; now pins them in place, feeding Wind's anti-mobility play without any Shadow status.

before.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Blinded for 2 turns, during which they count as Immobile.

after.effect: 20 damage to target enemy and Marked for 1 turn. Until the Mark is spent, they can't gain mobility buffs, and their Swiftness doesn't stop Stuns.

changes.why: Was Backstab with a Rushing-into-Stealthy rider; now an echo that rewards keeping Wind's Rushing alive.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 25 if the user is Stealthed. If the user is Rushing, it's Stealthy.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, or 20 at or below 60 HP. If the user is still Rushing at the start of their next turn, it strikes the same enemy again for 10.

changes.why: Immobile targets couldn't be woken; now grounds a Rushing or Leaping target, a Wind player's answer to mobility.

before.effect: 10 damage to target enemy, and they fall Asleep; if they're Immobile, damage can't wake them for 1 turn.

after.effect: 10 damage to target enemy and a 1-turn Stun. If they were Rushing or Leaping, it ends, and their mobility skills go on cooldown for 1 turn.

changes.why: Was Blind plus mobility-buff loss side by side; now a Shadow rule bend that stretches Blind over area skills.

before.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns and loses a mobility buff each time they use a skill.

after.effect: Target enemy is Blinded for 2 turns. Their Blind also scatters multi-target skills: each hits only one random unit.

changes.why: Split allies into Stealth or Leap by mobility buffs; now reactive Stealth access that makes focus fire vanish into the shadows.

before.effect: All allies heal 20; each ally with no mobility buff gains Stealth, and the rest Leap.

after.effect: All allies heal 20. For 1 turn, each ally hit by a single-target enemy skill gains Stealth once it resolves.
